66123.recognize_zh: 臨床照片顯示雙側腳底散布多發、邊界不清的深棕色斑點並融合成斑片，位於足弓、前足與足跟，無明顯紅腫或水泡，僅有輕度乾燥脫皮；在接受免疫調節藥物治療的病人，符合藥物相關色素沉著。
features: Bilateral plantar hyperpigmentation with multiple dark-brown macules coalescing into patches
Asymmetric, poorly demarcated distribution over forefoot, arch and heel; toes also darkened
No blistering, erosion or marked erythema visible
Mild dry scaling of plantar skin
66123.describe_en: Clinical photograph of both soles shows asymmetric, poorly demarcated dark-brown macules coalescing into patches across the forefoot, midfoot and heel, with mild dry scaling. No blistering, erosion or prominent inflammatory erythema is evident. In a patient treated with an immunomodulatory drug, the appearance is consistent with drug-associated acral hyperpigmentation; the diagnosis is clinical and depends on medication history.

ddx.vs: Hand-foot syndrome shows painful erythema, edema and desquamation on pressure areas rather than painless brown macules.
Melanoma is usually a solitary, asymmetric, variegated lesion that enlarges, whereas these are multiple bilateral symmetric-distribution macules.

ddx.dx: Addison disease or vitamin B12 deficiency pigmentation
ddx.vs: These cause similar acral pigmentation but are identified by systemic findings and laboratory testing (cortisol/ACTH, B12 level).
Syphilis produces copper-red scaly papules with systemic signs and positive serology, not flat dark-brown macules.

65931.recognize_zh: 紅血球之間有兩群紫色、短而粗、兩端鈍圓的桿菌（bacilli）成簇分布於細胞外，旁邊伴隨淡粉紅色的無定形物質；形態可確認為桿菌性菌血症樣表現，但菌種需靠培養鑑定。
features: Two extracellular clusters of short, plump, purple-staining rods with rounded ends
Rods uniform in size, arranged singly, in pairs and short chains
Pale pink amorphous material adjacent to clusters, possibly degenerated cell remnants
No intracellular organisms within neutrophils in this field (no leukocytes present)
Background red cells with occasional crenated forms and scattered platelets
65931.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with occasional crenated forms and scattered platelets. Two extracellular clusters of short, plump, uniformly sized rod-shaped bacteria are present, some in pairs and short chains, associated with pale pink amorphous material. No leukocytes, and therefore no phagocytosed organisms, are present in this field. Findings indicate circulating bacilli, suggestive of high-grade bacteremia in an immunocompromised patient; species identification (Klebsiella pneumoniae per history) requires blood culture, and contamination or delayed processing should be excluded.

ddx.dx: Specimen contamination or delayed processing overgrowth
ddx.vs: Contaminants appear only extracellularly and are not accompanied by clinical sepsis or positive paired blood cultures; intracellular organisms in neutrophils favor true bacteremia.
Stain precipitate forms irregular granular deposits of variable size rather than uniform rods with parallel sides and rounded ends.

ddx.dx: Other gram-negative or gram-positive bacilli (e.g., Capnocytophaga, Clostridium)
ddx.vs: Wright stain cannot separate bacilli by species; Gram stain and culture are required (Clostridium is gram-positive and larger, Capnocytophaga is fusiform).
Platelet clumps are granular aggregates of anucleate fragments of variable size, not discrete regular rods.

65675.recognize_zh: 腎臟切片的 PAX5 免疫染色：間質內密集浸潤的小淋巴球幾乎全部呈棕色核染色，腎小管上皮則為陰性；表示這片浸潤主要是 B 細胞，支持 B 細胞淋巴瘤浸潤。
features: Dense interstitial lymphoid infiltrate with strong diffuse nuclear PAX5 staining
Nearly all infiltrating small cells are positive, indicating a B-cell population
Residual tubules and vessels are negative and entrapped within the infiltrate
Uninvolved renal parenchyma at the edges is negative
65675.describe_en: PAX5 immunohistochemistry on the kidney core biopsy shows strong, diffuse nuclear staining in nearly all cells of the dense interstitial lymphoid infiltrate. Entrapped tubules, vessels, and adjacent uninvolved parenchyma are negative. The sheet-like PAX5-positive population indicates that the infiltrate is composed predominantly of B cells. In combination with CD5 co-expression, the findings support renal involvement by CLL/SLL.

ddx.vs: Reactive interstitial infiltrates are T-cell predominant with only scattered PAX5-positive B cells, not a sheet of B cells.
Mantle cell lymphoma is also PAX5- and CD5-positive but expresses cyclin D1 and SOX11.
Marginal zone lymphoma is PAX5-positive but typically CD5-negative and LEF1-negative.

65547.recognize_zh: 這是一張正面胸部 X 光（AP erect）：兩側下肺野呈均質不透亮陰影、肋膈角變鈍、左側橫膈輪廓被遮蔽，符合兩側肋膜積液；這是影像而非形態學圖片。
features: AP erect chest radiograph
Bilateral dependent homogeneous basal opacities with blunting of the costophrenic angles
Left hemidiaphragm silhouette obscured; right basal opacity with a meniscus-like upper margin
Cardiomediastinal silhouette partly obscured by the basal opacities
No morphologic (cytologic) information; etiology of effusion cannot be determined from the image
65547.describe_en: Anteroposterior erect chest radiograph shows bilateral homogeneous opacities at the lung bases with blunting of both costophrenic angles and obscuration of the left hemidiaphragm, consistent with bilateral pleural effusions. The aerated upper and mid lung zones show no discrete mass on this single view. The radiograph cannot establish the cause of the effusions; in a patient with plasma cell myeloma, thoracentesis with cytology (cytospin for plasma cells), flow cytometry, or cell block immunostains is required to distinguish myelomatous effusion from cardiac, renal, infectious, or amyloid-related causes. Findings are consistent with bilateral pleural effusions.

65419.recognize_zh: 血中大型芽細胞染色質細緻，核膜多處深凹成花瓣狀（flower petal）或杯狀，電子顯微鏡也見核膜皺褶；流式為 CD7+、CD2+、CD5+、CD10+、CD34+，屬未成熟 T 細胞表型，而非成熟 ATLL 的花形細胞。
features: Panels A-D: large blasts with high N:C ratio and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Deeply indented, multilobated flower petal and cup-like (cyanthiform) nuclear contours
Fine, dispersed chromatin with visible nucleoli
Panels E-F: electron microscopy showing deep nuclear membrane invaginations producing petal-like lobation
Panel G: blasts with dim CD45 and low side scatter, CD7+, CD2+, CD5+, surface CD3-negative, CD10+ and CD34+
65419.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a predominance of large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli, and scant basophilic cytoplasm. Many nuclei are deeply indented and lobated, producing flower petal and cup-shaped (cyanthiform) contours, and electron microscopy confirms deep nuclear membrane invaginations. Flow cytometry shows a dim CD45 blast population expressing CD2, CD5, CD7, CD10, and CD34 and lacking surface CD3; cytoplasmic CD3, myeloid markers CD13/CD33 and dim TdT were reported. Findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia with a near early T-precursor immunophenotype and marked flower petal nuclei.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells have condensed mature chromatin without nucleoli and a mature CD4+/CD25+ phenotype lacking CD34, TdT and CD1a, with HTLV-1 serology positive.
ETP-ALL lacks CD1a and CD8 and has CD5 negative or dim in <75% of blasts, whereas bright CD5 on most blasts here defines near-ETP.
Monocytic blasts have folded nuclei but abundant gray cytoplasm and express MPO/CD64/CD14 and lack cytoplasmic CD3.
Sezary cells are small to medium mature CD4+ T cells with cerebriform condensed chromatin, lacking CD34, TdT and CD7.

65163.recognize_zh: 這是示意圖（Panel A）而非病人資料：正常紅血球體積直方圖為單一對稱的鐘形峰，紅色箭頭與中線標示 MCV（約 90 fL），實線之間為分布寬度（RDW），虛線分別設在 60 fL 與 120 fL，用來計算小球性與大球性紅血球比例，作為判讀 TTP 病人連續直方圖的對照。
features: Schematic RBC volume histogram with frequency on the y-axis and cell volume (fL, 20-200) on the x-axis
Single symmetric bell-shaped peak centered near 90 fL, marked as the MCV
Solid vertical lines bracketing the central population, with a double-headed arrow labeled RDW
Dashed vertical lines at 60 fL and 120 fL used to quantify microcytic and macrocytic fractions
65163.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic schematic of a normal red cell volume histogram. It shows a single, symmetric, unimodal population centered at the MCV of about 90 fL, with solid lines delimiting the central distribution used to derive the RDW. Dashed reference lines at 60 fL and 120 fL allow quantification of microcytic and macrocytic red cell fractions. It serves as the baseline against which a left-shifted fragment population (schistocytes) or a right-sided macrocytic shoulder (reticulocytes) can be recognized in the patient's serial histograms.

65099.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑間的造血空間被流水狀排列的梭形纖維母細胞與膠原取代，其間散布成群、核深染的巨核細胞，脂肪細胞稀少，呈明顯骨髓纖維化，符合 TAFRO 症候群常見的骨髓表現。
features: Intertrabecular marrow space replaced by streaming spindle cells and collagenous stroma
Scattered, loosely clustered megakaryocytes, some with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei
Reduced residual hematopoietic elements and scattered small adipocytes
Extravasated red cells and edematous stroma between fibrotic bands
Bony trabeculae without obvious osteosclerosis in this field
65099.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at 10x shows intertrabecular spaces largely replaced by streaming spindle cells in a fibrotic stroma. Megakaryocytes are readily identified and loosely clustered, some with hyperchromatic nuclei, while other hematopoietic elements are reduced and fat is sparse. No infiltrate of atypical lymphoid or epithelial cells is evident at this magnification. In the context of TAFRO syndrome, these findings are consistent with the reticulin fibrosis and megakaryocytic hyperplasia described in that entity; reticulin and trichrome stains are needed to grade the fibrosis.

ddx.vs: PMF shows markedly atypical megakaryocytes with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei in tight clusters, osteosclerosis and dilated sinuses with intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis, plus JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations and a leukoerythroblastic smear, which TAFRO lacks.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma with desmoplastic marrow reaction
ddx.vs: Carcinoma shows cohesive epithelial nests within the fibrosis that are keratin positive, whereas the spindle cells here are bland stromal cells.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin lymphoma or hairy cell leukemia involving marrow
ddx.vs: These show a fibrotic marrow containing Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30/CD15) or a diffuse infiltrate of small cells with fried-egg cytoplasm (CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E), which are not seen here.

65035.recognize_zh: 淋巴結右側被膜明顯增厚，由成束、細胞稀少的粉紅色緻密膠原構成，外側可見被膜外脂肪與出血；被膜下方淋巴組織內有一個具套區的反應性次級濾泡，屬淋巴結發炎性偽瘤的被膜纖維化表現。
features: Markedly thickened nodal capsule composed of dense, hypocellular, parallel collagen bands
Perinodal adipose tissue and fresh hemorrhage outside the thickened capsule
Fibrous extension along the subcapsular region with a slit-like vessel
Reactive secondary follicle with germinal center and mantle zone near the lower field
Adjacent lymphoid parenchyma with mixed small lymphocytes and small vessels, no atypical infiltrate
65035.describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows marked fibrous thickening of the capsule by dense, hypocellular bands of collagen, with perinodal fat and hemorrhage beyond it. Beneath the capsule, the nodal parenchyma is preserved and contains a reactive secondary follicle with a germinal center and mantle zone, surrounded by mixed small lymphocytes and small vessels. No atypical cells are identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with the capsular fibrosis of nodal inflammatory pseudotumor, which characteristically begins in the capsule and trabeculae before extending into the parenchyma.

ddx.vs: NSCHL also thickens the capsule but forms collagen bands that encircle cellular nodules containing lacunar/Hodgkin cells (CD30+, CD15+), which are not present here.
IgG4-related disease shows storiform fibrosis with obliterative phlebitis and markedly increased IgG4+ plasma cells, whereas this case had only a mild IgG4+ increase.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific capsular fibrosis from prior inflammation or chronic lymphadenitis
ddx.vs: Nonspecific fibrosis is thin and lacks the fibroinflammatory spindle-cell and plasma cell-rich expansion of trabeculae and paracortex that defines inflammatory pseudotumor on other fields.

64907.recognize_zh: 低倍視野中幾乎全是單調的母細胞，許多核內有明顯淡染的杯狀凹陷，染色質細緻、胞質稀少，背景紅血球皺縮，符合伴杯狀母細胞的急性骨髓性白血病（高白血球）。
features: Monotonous sheet of medium-sized blasts replacing normal leukocytes
Frequent cup-like pale nuclear invaginations
Fine chromatin with high N:C ratio
Scant pale basophilic cytoplasm; no Auer rods identified
Crenated background erythrocytes
64907.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at lower magnification shows marked leukocytosis with a monotonous population of blasts and no evident maturing granulocytes. The blasts have fine chromatin, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, and scant cytoplasm, and a large proportion exhibits cup-like nuclear invaginations. Red cells show crenation artifact. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, suggestive of NPM1 and/or FLT3-ITD mutation; confirmation by flow cytometry and molecular studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: APL variant blasts have bilobed nuclei and faint granules with Auer rods and need PML::RARA exclusion rather than showing uniform nuclear cups.
ALL blasts are MPO negative and TdT positive without cup-like nuclear invaginations.

ddx.dx: Blast phase of chronic myeloid leukemia
ddx.vs: CML blast phase usually shows basophilia and residual myelocytes and is BCR::ABL1 positive.

exam.answer_en: AML with cup-like blasts — monotonous blasts with frequent cup-like nuclear invaginations and marked leukocytosis
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍全片 blast 時問「高白血球 AML，形態提示哪個突變、要擔心什麼急症」；答 NPM1/FLT3-ITD 與 leukostasis、TLS。
FLT3-ITD 與高白血球相關；新診斷需在短時間內取得 FLT3 結果，以決定誘導化療是否加 midostaurin。
高白血球 AML 急症：leukostasis（呼吸衰竭、神經症狀）、tumor lysis syndrome、DIC；避免不必要的紅血球輸注增加黏稠度。
分類：NPM1 mutation 在 WHO 5th 與 ICC 2022 皆為獨立的遺傳定義 AML 類別。
exam.pitfall_zh: 低倍下易誤認為 ALL 或 CML blast phase：ALL blast 為 MPO−、TdT+ 且無杯狀核；CML blast phase 常見 basophilia 與殘存 myelocyte，BCR::ABL1 陽性。

quiz.q: 這種以杯狀核 blast 為主、白血球極高的 AML，送檢時哪個分子檢測結果會直接影響誘導化療是否加標靶藥？
quiz.a: FLT3（ITD/TKD）突變檢測；陽性可加 midostaurin。

64267.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片中絕大多數是深藍色細胞質的大型原始細胞，常見細胞質泡突與沿細胞邊緣排列的一圈小空泡，並有較小的成熟紅血球母細胞散在，呈現以原紅血球樣原始細胞為主的族群。
features: Predominant population of large blasts with high N:C ratio, round nuclei and fine chromatin
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs
Rows of small cytoplasmic vacuoles, often at the cell periphery
Scattered smaller dark-nucleated erythroid precursors and occasional binucleate blasts
Few mature granulocytes; background erythrocytes and some disrupted cells
64267.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate magnification shows a markedly increased population of large blasts with high N:C ratio, round nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with blebs and conspicuous peripheral vacuolization. Smaller, more mature erythroid precursors are scattered among them, whereas maturing granulocytes are scant. The morphology suggests a predominance of proerythroblast-like blasts; with confirmation of erythroid lineage by E-cadherin, CD71 or glycophorin and quantification of erythroid precursors (at least 80%, with at least 30% proerythroblasts), the findings are consistent with pure erythroid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts can look identical with blebby basophilic cytoplasm, so CD61/CD42b versus E-cadherin/CD71 immunophenotyping is required.
Burkitt cells show numerous punched-out vacuoles across the whole cytoplasm with a CD10+/CD19+/sIg+ B-cell phenotype and MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation or myelodysplastic neoplasm with excess blasts
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are less basophilic, may contain granules or Auer rods, and are MPO/CD34 positive, with a non-dominant erythroid component.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Solid tumor cells form tight cohesive clumps or rosettes and are negative for hematopoietic markers.

64587.recognize_zh: 許多紅血球失去中央淡染區、呈緻密小圓形，表面伸出數量不一、長短與間距不規則的尖刺突起，這就是棘狀紅血球（acanthocyte），在嬰兒要想到無β脂蛋白血症。
features: Numerous acanthocytes: dense, spheroidal red cells lacking central pallor with 2–10 irregularly spaced spicules of variable length
Some cells with more regular crenation resembling echinocytes admixed
Remaining red cells normocytic with preserved central pallor
Occasional larger polychromatic red cells (reticulocytes)
Platelets present, no schistocytes or red cell agglutination
64587.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a prominent population of acanthocytes, which are small dense red cells without central pallor bearing irregularly spaced projections of unequal length. The remaining red cells are largely normocytic and normochromic, with a few polychromatic cells indicating reticulocytosis. Platelets are present and leukocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with acanthocytosis, which in an infant with failure to thrive and fat-soluble vitamin deficiency suggests abetalipoproteinemia.

ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10–30 short, evenly spaced blunt projections around a cell that retains its size and often central pallor, whereas acanthocytes have fewer irregular spicules on a dense cell.

ddx.dx: Spur cell anemia of severe liver disease
ddx.vs: Spur cells are morphologically similar acanthocytes, so separation relies on clinical context and lipid studies (absent apoB/LDL in abetalipoproteinemia).
These show similar acanthocytes but normal lipoproteins; McLeod is identified by weak Kell antigens and XK gene testing.
PK deficiency shows prickle-cell echinocytes with enzyme deficiency on assay, not hypolipidemia.

exam.answer_en: Acanthocytosis — dense RBCs lacking central pallor with few irregularly spaced spicules of unequal length; in an infant suggests abetalipoproteinemia
pearls_zh: 考法：指缺中央淡染、刺不規則的紅血球問「acanthocyte 還是 echinocyte？」並追問嬰兒脂肪吸收不良要想到哪個病——答 abetalipoproteinemia。
Abetalipoproteinemia：MTTP 基因缺陷，體染色體隱性；血中含 apoB 的脂蛋白（chylomicron、VLDL、LDL）幾乎缺如，膽固醇極低。
臨床：脂肪瀉、生長遲滯，脂溶性維生素（尤其 vitamin E）缺乏致脊髓小腦退化與視網膜色素病變；治療為低脂飲食與高劑量維生素 E、A 補充。
其他 acanthocyte 病因：嚴重肝病（spur cell anemia）、McLeod phenotype（XK）、chorea-acanthocytosis（VPS13A）、脾切除後。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 echinocyte（burr cell，含乾燥假影）混淆；echinocyte 有 10–30 個短而均勻的鈍突、多保留中央淡染，acanthocyte 刺少、長短間距不一且細胞緻密。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球形態為何？在嬰兒合併脂肪瀉時，最可能的疾病與缺陷基因是什麼？
quiz.a: Acanthocytes；abetalipoproteinemia，MTTP

64459.recognize_zh: 抹片中一顆大型雙核細胞，兩個大小相近、互相對稱的圓形細胞核並排（鏡像核），染色質細緻、細胞質灰藍且邊緣不規則，呈 Reed-Sternberg 細胞樣外觀；但核仁在此圖中不明顯，需組織切片與 CD30/CD15 免疫染色確認。
features: Large binucleate cell, much larger than adjacent erythroid precursor and small lymphocyte
Two round to oval, similarly sized nuclei positioned side by side in mirror-image fashion
Finely granular, relatively open chromatin; large inclusion-like nucleoli are not clearly resolved in this image
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm with irregular, focally pseudopod-like borders and a small vacuole
Background of marrow-type smear with erythroid precursors, a small lymphocyte and scattered platelets
64459.describe_en: Smear shows a large binucleate cell with two round, similarly sized nuclei arranged in a mirror-image configuration, finely dispersed chromatin and a moderate amount of grey-blue cytoplasm with irregular borders. Distinct eosinophilic macronucleoli are not well visualized at this focus. Surrounding cells include an erythroid precursor and small lymphocytes. The cell has the configuration of a Reed-Sternberg cell and, in a patient with classic Hodgkin lymphoma, is suggestive of marrow involvement; however, binucleate cells of other lineages can appear similar on smears, and confirmation on trephine biopsy with CD30/CD15/PAX5 immunostaining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells show eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof, and osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a hof away from the nucleus, unlike a central mirror-image pair with open chromatin.
Binucleate erythroblasts are smaller with dense chromatin and deeply basophilic or polychromatic cytoplasm, and occur with other erythroid dysplasia.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or immunoblast
ddx.vs: ALCL hallmark cells have horseshoe or wreath-like nuclei and are CD30+/CD15-/PAX5-, while immunoblasts are mononuclear with a single central nucleolus.
Megakaryocytes have connected lobulated nuclei and granular cytoplasm with platelet budding, and are CD61-positive.

exam.answer_en: Binucleate Reed-Sternberg-like cell with mirror-image nuclei on marrow smear — suggests classic Hodgkin lymphoma involvement; confirm by biopsy/IHC
pearls_zh: 考法：指雙核大細胞問名稱與典型外觀（owl's eye：鏡像雙核、各有大型嗜酸性核仁）；本圖核仁不明顯，作答宜保守寫「RS-like cell」。
cHL 的 HRS 細胞 IHC：CD30+、CD15+（多數）、PAX5 弱陽性、CD45−、CD20 多為陰性或弱且不一，OCT2/BOB1 常至少一個缺失。
對照 NLPHL（ICC 2022 改稱 NLPBL）的 LP cells（popcorn cells）：CD20+、CD45+、PAX5 強、OCT2/BOB1+，CD30−、CD15−。
骨髓侵犯屬 Ann Arbor stage IV；現今分期多以 PET-CT 評估骨髓，確診骨髓侵犯需切片而非抹片。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把雙核漿細胞、骨母細胞或雙核紅血球母細胞當成 RS 細胞；RS 細胞核仁巨大如包涵體、無核周 hof，確診需 CD30/CD15/PAX5 染色。

quiz.q: 若此雙核大細胞為 cHL 的 HRS 細胞，典型免疫表型為何？
quiz.a: CD30+、CD15+、PAX5 弱陽性、CD45−、CD20 多為陰性。

64395.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的中性球核只分成兩葉，兩個圓形核葉以細絲相連呈「眼鏡狀」（pince-nez），染色質粗糙濃縮、細胞質淡而顆粒少，符合 MDS 的假性 Pelger-Huët 異常。
features: Mature-sized neutrophils with bilobed nuclei composed of two round lobes (spectacle/pince-nez configuration)
Lobes connected by a thin chromatin strand or closely apposed
Coarsely clumped, condensed nuclear chromatin indicating a mature cell
Pale cytoplasm with reduced/fine granulation (possible hypogranularity)
An adjacent band/segmented neutrophil with normal-appearing nucleus for comparison (upper panel)
64395.describe_en: Smear shows neutrophils with abnormal nuclear segmentation, consisting of two round, symmetrical lobes with coarsely condensed chromatin arranged in a pince-nez configuration (arrows). The cytoplasm is pale with sparse fine granules, suggesting hypogranularity. A neighboring neutrophil with a band-shaped nucleus is present for comparison. Findings are consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huet (acquired hyposegmented) neutrophils, a dysgranulopoietic feature supporting myelodysplastic syndrome in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: The inherited LBR-related anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils with normal granulation and no cytopenias, whereas pseudo-Pelger cells are a subset often with hypogranularity in MDS.
Drugs such as mycophenolate, valproate, taxanes or tacrolimus can produce identical cells, which is distinguished only by medication history and reversibility.
Band neutrophils have a curved, non-segmented U- or C-shaped nucleus of uniform width, rather than two discrete round lobes.

ddx.dx: Binucleated myelocyte or reactive binucleate cell
ddx.vs: Binucleate precursors have finer chromatin with two separate nuclei and more immature granular cytoplasm, not condensed lobes joined by a filament.

exam.answer_en: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët neutrophils — bilobed pince-nez nuclei with clumped chromatin and hypogranulation, indicating dysgranulopoiesis (MDS)
pearls_zh: 考法：指眼鏡狀雙葉核中性球問名稱與意義；答 pseudo-Pelger-Huët，屬 dysgranulopoiesis，最常連結 MDS 及骨髓發育不良相關 AML。
MDS 判定單一系列有 dysplasia 的門檻為該系列 dysplastic cells ≥10%（WHO 5th 與 ICC 2022 相同）。
藥物也會造成相同變化：mycophenolate、tacrolimus、valproate、taxanes 等，停藥後可恢復；判讀前必問用藥史。
遺傳性 Pelger-Huët anomaly 為 LBR 基因異常（autosomal dominant），幾乎所有中性球受影響、功能正常，屬良性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與遺傳性 Pelger-Huët anomaly 或 band neutrophil 混淆；遺傳性者幾乎全部中性球雙葉且顆粒正常，band 核為粗細一致的 C/U 形而非兩顆圓葉。

quiz.q: 在 MDS 中判定顆粒球系有 dysplasia，dysplastic neutrophils 需佔多少比例？

64139.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆大型巨核細胞，核為單一、圓形不分葉且偏心，細胞質豐富帶細顆粒，屬於單葉小核型（non-lobated）巨核細胞，是 del(5q) MDS 的特徵異常。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular lilac cytoplasm
Single, round, non-lobated eccentric nucleus with relatively fine chromatin
Nucleus small relative to the large cytoplasmic volume
Adjacent smaller cells with granular cytoplasm and a lymphocyte
Somewhat thick, blurred background with red cells and debris, limiting detail
64139.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular cytoplasm and a single, round, non-lobated, eccentrically placed nucleus. Adjacent cells include granulocytic precursors and a lymphocyte. The background is thick and slightly blurred, which limits assessment of other lineages in this field. Findings are consistent with a monolobated (non-lobated) megakaryocyte, the characteristic dysplastic form of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q); the diagnosis requires cytogenetic confirmation of del(5q) with fewer than 5% marrow blasts.

ddx.dx: Micromegakaryocyte in other MDS or CML
ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small, about the size of a promyelocyte, with scant cytoplasm, whereas 5q- megakaryocytes are normal-sized or large with a non-lobated nucleus.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocytes in essential thrombocythemia or MDS/MPN-RS-T
ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large with hyperlobated staghorn nuclei, not the round monolobated nuclei of del(5q).
Osteoblasts and plasma cells have basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and are much smaller, without fine azurophilic platelet granules.
Immature megakaryocytes have scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a high N:C ratio, whereas this cell has abundant mature granular cytoplasm with a disproportionately small unlobed nucleus.

exam.answer_en: MDS with isolated del(5q) — monolobated megakaryocyte with a single round eccentric non-lobated nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：指這顆大細胞問名稱與關聯的細胞遺傳異常；答 non-lobated（monolobated）megakaryocyte，聯想 del(5q)。
WHO 5th 稱 MDS with low blasts and isolated 5q deletion（MDS-5q）：骨髓 blast <5%、周邊 <2%，del(5q) 單獨或合併一個非 -7/del(7q) 的異常。
典型臨床：中老年女性較多、大球性貧血、血小板正常或增加；lenalidomide 對輸血依賴貧血有效。
機轉與預後：RPS14 haploinsufficiency 與紅血球生成不良相關；合併 TP53 突變者對 lenalidomide 反應較差、進展風險較高。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 micromegakaryocyte（其他 MDS 或 CML）：micromegakaryocyte 體積接近 promyelocyte 或更小、核常為一或二小葉；del(5q) 典型的是體積中等偏大、單一圓核的巨核細胞。

quiz.q: 這顆單一圓核、不分葉的巨核細胞最典型對應哪個 MDS 亞型？首選藥物為何？
quiz.a: MDS with isolated del(5q)（MDS-5q）；lenalidomide。

64011.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量母細胞與核摺疊的單核球樣細胞，中央可見一顆嗜酸性球前驅細胞，細胞質內充滿粗大、暗紫黑色（嗜鹼樣）的異常顆粒；「單核球分化母細胞＋異常嗜酸性球」是 AML 合併 inv(16)/t(16;16)（CBFB::MYH11）的典型組合。
features: Sheets of large blasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Monocytoid cells with folded, indented, or reniform nuclei and grayish cytoplasm
Abnormal eosinophil precursor packed with large, dark purple-violet (basophilic-appearing) granules
Additional eosinophil lineage cells with mixed orange and dark granules
Background of released granules from ruptured cells, vacuoles, and smudged nuclei (imprint/crush artifact)
64011.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate/imprint smear shows sheets of blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with monocytoid cells showing folded and reniform nuclei. Increased eosinophil lineage cells are present, including abnormal eosinophils containing large, dark purple, basophilic-appearing granules. The background contains numerous free granules and disrupted cells. Findings are suggestive of acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, as seen in AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16)/CBFB::MYH11; confirmation by cytogenetics, FISH, or RT-PCR is required.

ddx.vs: t(8;21) blasts have salmon-colored cytoplasm with a single long Auer rod and perinuclear hof, and eosinophils are not dysplastic with dark granules.
These show mature eosinophilia with mast cells or lymphoblasts rather than abnormal immature eosinophils with basophilic granules among monocytic blasts.
CMML has fewer than 20% blasts/promonocytes with persistent monocytosis, not sheets of blasts.
Monocytic AML lacks the dysplastic eosinophils with large basophilic granules and requires cytogenetics to exclude CBFB::MYH11.

exam.answer_en: AML with CBFB::MYH11 [inv(16)/t(16;16)] — myelomonocytic blasts with abnormal eosinophils bearing large dark basophilic-appearing granules
pearls_zh: 考法：指中央含暗紫黑粗大顆粒的嗜酸性球前驅細胞，問遺傳異常；答 inv(16)(p13.1q22) 或 t(16;16)，CBFB::MYH11。
細胞化學：異常嗜酸性球 naphthol AS-D chloroacetate esterase 陽性（正常嗜酸性球為陰性）；blast 可 MPO 陽性，單核成分 NSE 陽性。
inv(16) 在傳統 karyotype 可能隱微被漏看，需 FISH 或 RT-PCR 確認；常合併 +22、KIT 突變。
屬 core-binding factor AML，ELN 2022 favorable；WHO 5th 不設 blast 門檻，ICC 2022 要求 ≥10%；RT-PCR 可追蹤 MRD。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 t(8;21) AML 或 myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia：t(8;21) 嗜酸性球多為正常形態且無單核分化；PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 腫瘤嗜酸性球較成熟、不含嗜鹼樣異常顆粒。

quiz.q: 圖中含暗紫粗大顆粒的異常嗜酸性球，對應哪個融合基因？

64075.recognize_zh: 一顆大型組織球，胞質淡灰藍色帶空泡，內含數個完整的圓形深染小細胞核，其中左下方一顆被透明吞噬泡包住；組織球吞下完整的血球細胞，是噬血現象，本例為 COVID 感染後、全血球減少合併高 ferritin 的次發性 HLH。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant pale gray-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Several engulfed intact cells with small round dense nuclei (lymphocytes or nucleated red cells), one lying within a clear phagocytic vacuole
Larger nuclei with open, reticular chromatin at the upper left and right may represent the histiocyte nucleus or overlapping adjacent cells; the plane of focus limits separation
Possible engulfed red cell material near the right margin
Background red cells and small platelet clumps; mild image blur limits fine detail
64075.describe_en: Smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm containing several intact cells with small, round, dense nuclei, at least one of which lies within a clear phagocytic vacuole. Larger nuclei with open chromatin at the periphery may belong to the histiocyte or to overlapping adjacent cells, which cannot be resolved with certainty at this image quality. The engulfment of whole hematopoietic cells represents hemophagocytosis. In a young patient with pancytopenia and elevated ferritin after COVID-19 infection, the findings support secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, which must be confirmed by HLH-2004 criteria or HScore.

ddx.vs: Tingible-body macrophages contain fragmented apoptotic nuclear debris, whereas here the ingested cells are intact with preserved nuclear outlines.

ddx.dx: Cell overlap on a thick smear
ddx.vs: Overlying cells lack a surrounding clear vacuole and lie in a different focal plane; true engulfment shows a halo within the histiocyte cytoplasm.
Emperipolesis involves passage of intact cells through a megakaryocyte with granular cytoplasm and a large lobulated nucleus, not a histiocyte with foamy cytoplasm.
Morphology of the hemophagocyte is identical; a search for an underlying lymphoma (atypical lymphoid infiltrate, EBV status) is needed.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis in post-COVID-19 secondary HLH — histiocyte engulfing intact small hematopoietic cells within phagocytic vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：給年輕病人感染後全血球低下、ferritin 很高，問這顆細胞；答吞噬完整造血細胞的 histiocyte（hemophagocyte），支持 secondary HLH。
Ferritin 是篩檢 HLH 最常用的指標；兒童 ferritin 極度升高（>10,000 ng/mL）高度提示 HLH，但成人特異度較低，需配合其他準則。
HScore 用於成人 reactive HLH 的機率評估，項目包含已知免疫抑制、體溫、器官腫大、血球低下、ferritin、TG、fibrinogen、AST 與骨髓 hemophagocytosis。
病毒感染（包括 EBV、CMV、SARS-CoV-2）皆可誘發 secondary HLH；治療需同時控制誘因與過度發炎（如 corticosteroid，嚴重者 etoposide-based 治療）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把周邊重疊的細胞核或組織球自己的核當成被吞噬細胞；只計算位於胞質內、有清楚吞噬空泡的完整細胞，無法確認時不要過度判讀。

quiz.q: 圖中大型細胞在做什麼？除了骨髓形態，列出兩項 HLH-2004 的實驗室準則。
quiz.a: Hemophagocytosis（histiocyte 吞噬完整血球）；例如 ferritin ≥500 ng/mL、sCD25 升高、高 TG/低 fibrinogen、NK 活性低下（任兩項）。

63947.recognize_zh: 這是臨床照片而非顯微鏡圖：前胸、腹部、背部與上肢廣泛分布的暗紅棕色、邊界清楚的斑塊，部分融合並伴脫屑，其間夾雜未受侵犯的正常皮膚區塊，符合進展期蕈狀肉芽腫（mycosis fungoides）的皮膚表現。
features: Four clinical photographs (A-D) of the anterior trunk, back and upper limbs of an adult man
Widespread well-demarcated violaceous to red-brown patches and plaques, many confluent
Scaling and desquamation over plaques, with some darker crusted or eroded areas
Islands of uninvolved (spared) skin between lesions
Involvement extends to arms and scalp/neck; no discrete tumor nodules are clearly visible
63947.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic clinical photograph series of the trunk, back and upper limbs. There are extensive, sharply demarcated, violaceous to red-brown patches and plaques with scaling and desquamation, forming large confluent areas with intervening islands of spared skin, involving well over half of the body surface. Distinct exophytic tumor nodules are not clearly identified in these views. The appearance is consistent with extensive patch/plaque-stage cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (mycosis fungoides) progressing despite therapy, and a biopsy is required to exclude large-cell transformation or a drug reaction.

ddx.vs: Psoriatic plaques have silvery micaceous scale on extensor surfaces, and biopsy shows regular acanthosis with neutrophilic microabscesses rather than epidermotropic atypical CD4+ T cells.
Drug rash can mimic MF clinically, but biopsy shows interface or granulomatous dermatitis without clonal atypical T cells, and TCR gene rearrangement is polyclonal.
Sezary syndrome presents with diffuse erythroderma, lymphadenopathy and a circulating clonal CD4+ CD26- or CD7- population on flow cytometry.
Eczema shows spongiosis without Pautrier microabscesses or atypical cerebriform lymphocytes, and responds to topical steroids.

63883.recognize_zh: 同一淋巴結有兩種成分：上方 SLL 為密集小淋巴球，CD5、LEF-1、PAX5 陽性；下方 HS 為大型、細胞質豐富粉紅的異型細胞，CD4、CD11c、CD56 陽性而 LEF-1 陰性；右側 IGH FR2 片段分析兩區皆出現約 254.6–254.9 bp 的相同單株峰，證明同一克隆的跨譜系轉化。
features: SLL H&E: diffuse sheets of small round lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm
SLL IHC: tumor cells positive for CD5, LEF-1 and PAX5
HS H&E: cohesive-appearing sheets of large atypical cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei, small nucleoli and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
HS IHC: positive for CD4, CD11c and CD56, negative for LEF-1 (and PAX5 per description); CD5 highlights only interspersed background T cells
IGH FR2 capillary electrophoresis: dominant clonal peak at 254.86 bp in the SLL sample and 254.62 bp in the HS sample, essentially identical size
63883.describe_en: Composite figure from a pelvic lymph node biopsy. One component consists of diffuse small lymphocytes with round nuclei, clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm that express CD5, LEF-1 and PAX5, consistent with small lymphocytic lymphoma. A second component is composed of large atypical cells with vesicular oval nuclei, small nucleoli and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm that express CD4, CD11c and CD56 and lack LEF-1, consistent with histiocytic sarcoma. IGH FR2 fragment analysis shows a dominant clonal peak of the same size (about 254.6–254.9 bp) in both microdissected components, indicating a shared B-cell clone. Findings are consistent with small lymphocytic lymphoma with clonally related transdifferentiation to histiocytic sarcoma.

ddx.dx: Richter transformation to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: DLBCL-type Richter cells retain B-cell markers (PAX5, CD20, CD79a) and lack histiocytic markers, whereas this large-cell component is PAX5-negative and CD4/CD11c-positive.
ALCL cells are strongly CD30-positive with T-cell markers or ALK and have hallmark horseshoe nuclei, rather than a histiocytic CD11c/CD163 profile.
Langerhans cell neoplasms have grooved nuclei and express CD1a and langerin (CD207), which are not part of this profile.
These are CD45-negative and express keratin or S100/SOX10/melan-A, and would not share the IGH clone with the SLL.

63883.stain: H&E; IHC: CD5, LEF-1, PAX5, CD4, CD11c, CD56; IGH PCR

63755.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結的淋巴組織被推擠，被膜下、中間及髓質竇（sinus）被大量充血的血管腔擴張取代；高倍可見吻合狀的血管裂隙、平扁內皮與纖維化基質，但細胞無明顯異型、未侵犯被膜，符合淋巴結竇血管轉化（VTS）。
features: Lymph node with expansion of subcapsular, intermediate and medullary sinuses by a vascular proliferation (low power, panel a)
Anastomosing vascular channels of variable size, many engorged with red blood cells
Channels lined by flat to plump endothelial cells without nuclear atypia or mitoses
Stromal sclerosis/fibrosis between slit-like vessels; focal plexiform and solid spindle-cell areas
Residual lymphoid follicles and parenchyma preserved outside the sinuses; capsule not breached
Thickened, congested perinodal vessels (panel e, black arrow)
63755.describe_en: Sections of an axillary lymph node show a vasoproliferative process confined to and expanding the subcapsular, intermediate and medullary sinuses, with compression of the residual lymphoid parenchyma. At higher power, the sinuses are replaced by a complex network of anastomosing vascular channels of variable caliber, some slit-like within sclerotic stroma and others dilated and engorged with red blood cells. The channels are lined by flat to plump endothelium without significant nuclear atypia, multilayering or mitotic activity, and focal solid areas of bland spindle cells are present. There is no capsular or extranodal extension, and perinodal vessels are congested. Findings are consistent with vascular transformation of lymph node sinuses.

ddx.vs: Kaposi sarcoma begins in the capsule and extends into parenchyma with atypical spindle cells, extravasated RBCs, hyaline globules and HHV8 (LANA) positivity, whereas VTS is sinus-confined and HHV8 negative.
Angiosarcoma shows dissecting vessels with endothelial atypia, multilayering, mitoses and destruction of nodal architecture and capsule.
These form well-circumscribed lesions usually in the hilum or capsule rather than diffusely filling the sinus system.
Bacillary angiomatosis has lobular capillaries with epithelioid endothelium, neutrophils and granular Warthin-Starry positive bacterial clumps.

63691.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指細胞的細胞質呈深藍色、核膜消失，濃縮的染色體排成一條橫過細胞中央的帶狀（中期板，metaphase plate），為有絲分裂中期的側面觀。
features: Medium-large cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Condensed chromosomes aligned as a dense band across the cell equator (metaphase plate, side view)
No nuclear membrane or nucleolus; cytoplasm on either side of the plate
Cytoplasmic basophilia suggests an early erythroid precursor
Cellular background with erythroblasts, immature myeloid cells, and a smeared cell fragment
63691.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field with erythroid precursors at different stages, immature myeloid cells, and a smeared cell fragment. The arrowed cell has deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a band of condensed chromosomes aligned across its equator without a nuclear membrane, representing a side view of metaphase. The cytoplasmic basophilia suggests an early erythroid precursor. No multipolar configuration or lagging chromosomes are seen. Findings are consistent with a normal metaphase mitotic figure.

ddx.dx: Band neutrophil or metamyelocyte with folded nucleus
ddx.vs: These have an intact nuclear outline with chromatin texture and pinkish granular cytoplasm rather than a linear chromosome plate in a basophilic cell.
Anaphase shows two separated chromosome groups moving to opposite poles instead of a single equatorial band.
Pyknosis produces a smooth, homogeneous dense nuclear mass without filamentous chromosome edges.

63563.recognize_zh: 四格高倍影像中都可見大型組織球，胞質淡藍、充滿空泡，內含被吞噬的紅血球、有核細胞（淋巴球、顆粒球或有核紅血球）及碎片，這種大量噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）配合臨床指標提示噬血性淋巴組織球增生症（HLH）。
features: Large activated histiocytes with abundant pale blue, foamy to vacuolated cytoplasm in all four panels
Engulfed erythrocytes seen as pale pink-grey round profiles within phagocytic vacuoles
Phagocytosed nucleated cells (lymphocytes, granulocytes and/or nucleated red cells) and nuclear debris
Histiocyte nuclei eccentric, oval to elongated, with fine chromatin, often compressed by ingested material
Background of red cells, small lymphocytes and neutrophils without overt blasts or lymphoma cells in these fields
63563.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa), shown as a four-panel composite, demonstrates multiple enlarged histiocytes with abundant pale blue, vacuolated cytoplasm. The histiocytes contain phagocytosed erythrocytes as well as engulfed nucleated hematopoietic cells, including lymphocytes, granulocytes and nucleated red cells, and nuclear debris. No blasts or overtly malignant lymphoid cells are identified in these fields. Findings are consistent with prominent hemophagocytosis, supportive of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis when correlated with HLH-2004 criteria (ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, sCD25, cytopenias) and evaluation for triggers such as EBV and T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Occasional hemophagocytosis is nonspecific, so the diagnosis of HLH rests on meeting clinical/laboratory criteria rather than morphology alone.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma-associated HLH (e.g. T/NK-cell lymphoma, intravascular lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical hemophagocytosis requires a search for atypical lymphoid cells, flow cytometry, EBER-ISH and clonality studies.
MAS is a rheumatologic-associated form of secondary HLH distinguished by the underlying autoimmune disease rather than morphology.
Emperipolesis shows intact viable lymphocytes within S100+ histiocytes with pale nuclei, rather than degraded ingested red cells in CD68+/S100- macrophages.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (supportive) — activated marrow histiocytes engulfing RBCs and nucleated hematopoietic cells
pearls_zh: 考法：四格影像要辨識被吞的內容物：紅血球、淋巴球、顆粒球、有核紅血球；吞入有核細胞比單純吞紅血球更支持 HLH。
HLH-2004：8 項中符合 5 項（或有 HLH 相關基因突變）；其中 ferritin ≥500 ng/mL、sCD25 ≥2400 U/mL。
誘因必查：EBV PCR、T/NK 細胞淋巴瘤、自體免疫（MAS）；原發性 HLH 相關基因如 PRF1、UNC13D、STX11。
成人常用 HScore 估計 HLH 機率；ferritin 極度升高是重要線索，但不具完全專一性。
治療以 etoposide + dexamethasone（HLH-94 為基礎）並處理誘因；病情進展快，不應等所有標準都符合才治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 單見噬血易過度診斷 HLH，輸血或敗血症後也會出現，需配合 HLH-2004 標準；也要與 Rosai-Dorfman 的 emperipolesis（被包入的淋巴球完整存活）區分。

quiz.q: 這些組織球胞質內含紅血球與有核細胞，代表什麼現象？
quiz.a: Hemophagocytosis（噬血現象）

63499.recognize_zh: 低倍迴腸切片的 CD20 免疫染色中，大片瀰漫浸潤的腫瘤細胞全部呈強棕色陽性，填滿腸壁並包圍殘存的黏膜與腺體（棕色背景下的淡色結構呈陰性），證實為 B 細胞來源的淋巴瘤。
features: Low-power view of small bowel wall with a large, diffuse infiltrate
Strong, uniform brown CD20 membranous staining in sheets of lymphoma cells
Residual mucosa/villi and glands on the left are CD20 negative
Infiltrate expands the wall in broad confluent sheets with interspersed negative vessels/spaces
Scattered positive cells extend into surrounding tissue at the edges
63499.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain for CD20 on an ileal resection shows a diffuse, sheet-like lymphoid infiltrate expanding the bowel wall. The neoplastic cells show strong, uniform membranous CD20 expression, while residual mucosa and glandular epithelium are negative. Individual cell size cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings confirm B-cell lineage of the infiltrate and, together with the large atypical cells on H&E, are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving the ileum.

ddx.vs: Also CD20+ and common in the ileocecal region but composed of monotonous medium-sized cells with starry-sky pattern, CD10+/BCL2-, Ki-67 near 100%, and MYC rearrangement.
CD20+ but composed of small centrocyte-like/monocytoid cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and a low proliferation index.
CD20+ but co-expresses CD5 and cyclin D1/SOX11 and shows small to medium cells with irregular nuclei.
Tumor cells would be keratin positive and CD20/CD45 negative, arising from the mucosal epithelium.

63371.recognize_zh: 這是腦部 MRI 軸切面 FLAIR：右顳葉與左顳枕葉各有一個高訊號病灶，中央有較低訊號的圓形區，周圍水腫明顯。移植後免疫低下病人出現多發病灶，要想到弓漿蟲（toxoplasmosis）。
features: Axial FLAIR MRI of the brain (non-microscopic image)
Bilateral hyperintense lesions in the right temporal lobe and left temporo-occipital region
Central rounded lower-signal focus within each lesion producing a target-like appearance
Surrounding vasogenic edema without marked midline shift
Contrast enhancement pattern cannot be assessed on this single FLAIR slice
63371.describe_en: Axial FLAIR MRI of the brain shows two separate hyperintense lesions involving the right temporal lobe and the left temporo-occipital region, each with a central rounded focus of lower signal and surrounding edema. No significant midline shift is seen on this slice. Enhancement characteristics cannot be evaluated without post-contrast images. In a post-HSCT patient with seizures, multifocal lesions of this type are suggestive of cerebral toxoplasmosis, to be confirmed by Toxoplasma PCR, serology and response to therapy.

ddx.dx: Primary or secondary CNS lymphoma / PTLD
ddx.vs: Lymphoma is more often solitary, periventricular or subependymal with homogeneous enhancement and restricted diffusion, and is thallium/PET-avid, unlike toxoplasmosis.
Angioinvasive fungal lesions tend to be hemorrhagic and at gray-white junctions; distinction requires CSF/tissue studies such as galactomannan.
PML involves subcortical white matter without mass effect or target-like enhancement and is JC virus PCR-positive.

63307.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液抹片中，嗜中性球吞入一團均質、淡粉紅色無結構的變性核物質（hematoxylin body），自身分葉核被擠壓成新月形貼在周邊（箭頭），即 LE 細胞（Hargraves cell）。
features: Neutrophils containing a large, round, homogeneous, smooth pink-purple inclusion (denatured nuclear material, hematoxylin body) occupying most of the cell
Phagocyte's own lobulated nucleus compressed into a thin crescent at the cell periphery (arrows)
Engulfed material lacks chromatin pattern, nucleolus or nuclear membrane detail
Background of numerous segmented neutrophils and occasional macrophages with pale, granular cytoplasm
Pale, somewhat faded staining with limited nuclear detail
63307.describe_en: Cytospin/smear of cerebrospinal fluid (panels A-C) shows a neutrophil-rich cellular sample with scattered macrophages. Several neutrophils (arrows) contain a single large, round, homogeneous and structureless inclusion of denatured nuclear material that displaces and compresses the neutrophil's lobulated nucleus into a peripheral crescent. No intact chromatin pattern is identified within the ingested material. The staining is pale, limiting fine detail. Findings are consistent with LE cells in cerebrospinal fluid, which should prompt serologic confirmation of systemic lupus erythematosus (ANA, anti-dsDNA).

ddx.vs: In a tart cell the phagocytosed nucleus retains visible chromatin structure and a nuclear outline, whereas the LE cell inclusion is homogeneous and structureless.
Ingested apoptotic cells show fragmented, dense pyknotic nuclear pieces within a macrophage rather than one smooth homogeneous mass inside a neutrophil.
Signet-ring cells have mucin vacuoles with a nucleus showing malignant chromatin and occur singly or in clusters, not a segmented neutrophil nucleus draped around a homogeneous mass.

exam.answer_en: LE cells in cerebrospinal fluid — neutrophils engulfing homogeneous denatured nuclear material with the host nucleus compressed into a crescent
pearls_zh: 考法：指嗜中性球內均質大團物問名稱，並要求與 tart cell 區分：LE body 無染色質紋路，宿主分葉核被擠成新月形。
形成機轉：抗核抗體（針對 DNA-histone 複合物）結合受損細胞的核，使其腫脹均質化，經調理後被嗜中性球吞噬。
LE cell test 已被 ANA、anti-dsDNA、anti-Smith 取代；藥物性狼瘡（procainamide、hydralazine）以 anti-histone 抗體為特徵。
在胸水、心包液或 CSF 中意外看到 LE cells 時提示 SLE 相關漿膜炎或神經精神狼瘡，應主動回報臨床並建議血清學檢查。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 tart cell 混淆：tart cell 的吞噬物仍保留核染色質結構，宿主多為單核球/巨噬細胞；LE body 則均質無結構，宿主為嗜中性球。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指的細胞稱為什麼？其吞入物質的本質為何？
quiz.a: LE cell（Hargraves cell）；經抗體調理後變性的細胞核物質（LE/hematoxylin body）

63243.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E（2a、2b）在骨小樑之間可見疏鬆纖維間質中瀰漫浸潤的多形性異型細胞，核深染、梭形至卵圓，取代正常造血組織；IHC（2c、2d）腫瘤細胞呈棕色陽性（myoD1、desmin），肌源性標記陽性指向轉移性橫紋肌肉瘤。
features: Panels 2a-2b (H&E): interstitial to diffuse infiltrate of atypical cells between bony trabeculae, replacing hematopoietic marrow
Tumor cells are pleomorphic, oval to spindled and angulated, with hyperchromatic nuclei and scant to moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Loose, edematous fibrous/myxoid stroma; occasional larger bizarre cells
Panel 2c: brown nuclear staining of tumor cells (reported as myoD1)
Panel 2d: brown staining of tumor cells (reported as desmin); cytoplasmic versus nuclear localization is difficult to resolve at this resolution
63243.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy sections (H&E) show an interstitial to diffuse infiltrate of pleomorphic, oval to spindle-shaped atypical cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and scant eosinophilic cytoplasm, set in a loose fibrous stroma between bony trabeculae, with effacement of normal hematopoiesis. Immunohistochemical stains show the tumor cells to be positive for myoD1 (nuclear) and desmin. Image resolution limits assessment of fine cytologic detail and the precise staining pattern. Findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by rhabdomyosarcoma.

ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma infiltrates are small round blue cells with neuropil, positive for PHOX2B/synaptophysin and negative for myoD1 and desmin.
Ewing sarcoma consists of monotonous small round cells with CD99 membranous and NKX2-2 nuclear positivity and lacks myogenic markers.

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia with marrow fibrosis (e.g., acute megakaryoblastic leukemia)
ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are CD45/CD34/CD117 or CD61-positive and desmin/myoD1-negative, and are less spindled and pleomorphic.
Carcinoma is cytokeratin-positive and melanoma is SOX10/S100-positive, whereas this tumor expresses myoD1 and desmin.

63179.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中成群的大型單核母細胞，核呈泡狀、染色質開放並有明顯核仁，可見分裂象（中央偏右）；周邊混有粉紅顆粒的成熟中骨髓細胞與嗜中性球，提示仍保有成熟分化的 AML。
features: Clusters of large mononuclear blasts with vesicular nuclei, open chromatin and distinct nucleoli (arrows)
Moderate amounts of pale amphophilic cytoplasm
Mitotic figure present among the blasts
Admixed maturing granulocytic precursors and neutrophils, including cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm
Scattered brown hemosiderin-laden macrophages and black granular pigment deposits (likely fixation artifact)
Intervening adipocytes; section appears to be of marrow particles/clot with some processing artifact
63179.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (H&E) shows hypercellular marrow with clusters of large blasts having vesicular nuclei, open chromatin, prominent nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm; a mitotic figure is identified. Maturing myeloid precursors, including cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and segmented neutrophils, are present adjacent to the blast clusters. Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages and black granular pigment, likely fixation artifact, are noted. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation, in keeping with AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1; blast enumeration on aspirate and confirmation by cytogenetics are required.

ddx.dx: Regenerating marrow with left shift (post-chemotherapy or G-CSF)
ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows synchronized promyelocyte/myelocyte waves with abundant granular cytoplasm and paratrabecular maturation, not clusters of agranular nucleolated blasts.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These form cohesive or sheet-like non-hematopoietic infiltrates negative for MPO/CD34 and positive for cytokeratin or B/T-cell markers.
Pronormoblasts have deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round dark nuclei and are E-cadherin/CD71 positive rather than MPO positive.

63051.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中 CD3 陽性的小型 T 細胞沿著竇狀隙排成線狀並散布於間質，TIA1 在同一群細胞呈細顆粒狀胞質陽性、聚成小簇，符合 T 細胞大顆粒淋巴球白血病的間質及竇內浸潤型態。
features: CD3: small to medium lymphocytes with membranous/cytoplasmic positivity arranged in linear intrasinusoidal chains and scattered interstitially
Positive cells lining vascular spaces between adipocytes, forming single-file strands
TIA1: dense granular cytoplasmic staining in clustered interstitial lymphocytes
No discrete nodular lymphoid aggregates
Background trilineage hematopoietic cells negative for both markers
63051.describe_en: Paired immunohistochemical stains on a bone marrow core biopsy show an increased population of small CD3-positive T cells arranged in a linear intrasinusoidal pattern and scattered singly and in small clusters within the interstitium. TIA1 highlights the same population with granular cytoplasmic positivity, indicating a cytotoxic phenotype. No nodular lymphoid aggregates are seen and residual hematopoietic cells are negative. Findings are consistent with involvement by T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia, supported by CD8 expression, loss of CD5/CD7 and clonal TR gene rearrangement or STAT3 mutation.

ddx.dx: Reactive cytotoxic T-cell expansion (viral infection, post-transplant)
ddx.vs: Reactive expansions are polyclonal and usually lack intrasinusoidal linear chains, so clonality (TRG/TRB, STAT3) is needed to separate them.
HSTCL cells are medium-sized, CD4-/CD8-, gamma-delta TCR positive with isochromosome 7q and massive hepatosplenomegaly, versus small CD8+ alpha-beta LGL cells.

ddx.dx: Aggressive NK-cell leukemia / chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-cell processes lack surface CD3 (CD3 epsilon cytoplasmic only) and express CD56, with ANKL being EBV-positive.
SMZL sinusoidal cells are CD20+ B cells, not CD3+/TIA1+ T cells.

62987.recognize_zh: 油鏡下可見卵圓至略長形核、染色質呈細顆粒狀、偶見明顯核仁的細胞，細胞質豐富淡染透亮並含稀疏的深色嗜鹼性顆粒，其間混有具紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球，符合非典型肥大細胞。
features: Medium to large cells with round-oval to elongated nuclei and finely granular chromatin
Occasional single prominent nucleolus
Abundant pale to clear cytoplasm containing sparse, coarse dark basophilic granules
Admixed eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and bright eosinophilic granules
Background of residual marrow cells, red cells and a thin fibrous septum
62987.describe_en: Oil-immersion H&E shows an infiltrate of medium to large cells with oval to elongated nuclei, finely granular chromatin and occasional single prominent nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant, pale to clear, and contains sparse coarse basophilic granules. Eosinophils are admixed, and a thin fibrous septum traverses the field. Findings are consistent with atypical mast cells of systemic mastocytosis; tryptase, CD117 and CD25 confirm lineage and aberrant phenotype.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have round to bean-shaped nuclei with a clear halo but no cytoplasmic basophilic granules, and are CD20+/annexin A1+.
Monocytes/histiocytes have folded nuclei and fine cytoplasm without metachromatic granules and are tryptase-negative.
Basophils are smaller with segmented nuclei and dense granules obscuring the nucleus, and are tryptase-low and CD117-negative.
Mast cell leukemia requires >=20% mast cells on the aspirate smear, which cannot be assessed on a biopsy section alone.

62923.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片可見三個小而深染圓核的有核紅血球（NRBC），背景紅血球嚴重大小不均與異形，包括標靶細胞、碎片、淚滴與鋸齒狀細胞，另見嗜中性球與淋巴球；大量 NRBC 加上嚴重異形紅血球是重型乙型地中海貧血的抹片表現。
features: Three nucleated red blood cells with small dense round nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Marked anisocytosis with microcytes and occasional macrocytes
Poikilocytosis including target cells, fragments, teardrop and elongated cells, and crenated forms
Hypochromic red cells with irregular central pallor
A segmented neutrophil, a lymphocyte, and a smudged leukocyte; scattered platelets
62923.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with microcytic hypochromic red cells, target cells, fragments, teardrop cells, and crenated forms. Three nucleated red blood cells with small dense nuclei are present in this field, along with a segmented neutrophil, a lymphocyte, and a smudged leukocyte. The image is slightly out of focus. Findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia major; the numerous NRBCs falsely elevate automated WBC counts, which must be corrected.

ddx.vs: Immune hemolysis shows spherocytes and marked polychromasia rather than microcytic hypochromic target cells.
Smear appearance is similar; hemoglobin analysis showing Hb E is required to separate it.
Marrow infiltration shows NRBCs with immature granulocytes and teardrops but red cells are generally normochromic without prominent target cells.

exam.answer_en: Beta-thalassemia major — numerous nucleated red cells with marked anisopoikilocytosis, target cells and microcytic hypochromic red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：數視野中 NRBC 數目，問校正白血球：校正 WBC = 原 WBC × 100 /（100 + 每 100 顆白血球中的 NRBC 數）。
切脾後的 thalassemia major，周邊血 NRBC、Howell-Jolly bodies 與標靶細胞會更明顯。
β-thalassemia major 通常在出生後 6–24 個月出現症狀，因 HbF 轉換為 HbA 時 β-globin 不足。
長期輸血併發鐵沉積，以 cardiac T2* MRI 評估心臟鐵負荷，心衰竭為主要死因之一。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 NRBC 誤認為小淋巴球：NRBC 核更圓更緻密、染色質塊狀濃縮，胞質帶粉紅/多染性而非淡藍色。

quiz.q: 圖中三顆小而緻密圓核的細胞是什麼？如何校正白血球計數？
quiz.a: NRBC；校正 WBC = WBC × 100 /（100 + NRBC/100 WBC）

62859.recognize_zh: 紅血球呈雙相性（dimorphic）：一群小而淡染、中央蒼白區擴大的低色素小紅血球，混雜正常大小正色素紅血球，並有淚滴狀與橢圓形紅血球；雙族群紅血球是 X 性聯鐵粒母細胞性貧血的周邊血線索。
features: Dimorphic red cell population: microcytic hypochromic cells with widened central pallor alongside normocytic normochromic cells
Moderate anisopoikilocytosis
Teardrop cells (dacrocytes) and elliptocytes present
Occasional fragmented/irregular cells and a ghost-like cell
No nucleated red cells or leukocytes in this field
62859.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a dimorphic red cell population composed of microcytic, hypochromic red cells with widened central pallor admixed with normocytic, normochromic red cells. There is moderate anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells, elliptocytes and occasional irregular fragments. Leukocytes and nucleated red cells are not present in this field. A dimorphic picture of this type is suggestive of sideroblastic anemia, consistent with X-linked sideroblastic anemia in this case, and should prompt a bone marrow iron stain for ring sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: Iron deficiency anemia after partial treatment or transfusion
ddx.vs: Also dimorphic, but iron studies show low ferritin and marrow iron is absent rather than increased with ring sideroblasts.
Thalassemia shows uniform microcytosis with target cells and basophilic stippling, a raised RBC count and increased HbA2 rather than two distinct populations.
MDS-RS usually shows macrocytic or dimorphic indices in older adults with SF3B1 mutation and dysplasia in other lineages.

exam.answer_en: Sideroblastic anemia (X-linked) — dimorphic red cell population of microcytic hypochromic and normochromic cells
pearls_zh: 考法：指兩群不同色素與大小的紅血球，問「dimorphic picture」的鑑別，下一步為骨髓鐵染色找 ring sideroblasts。
X-linked sideroblastic anemia：ALAS2 突變，為血紅素合成第一步酵素，需 pyridoxal 5'-phosphate 為輔因子，部分病人對 pyridoxine（B6）有反應。
常合併鐵過載（ferritin、transferrin saturation 升高），可需放血或鐵螯合，即使有貧血。
女性帶因者因 X 染色體不活化偏移，也可出現 dimorphic 紅血球。
後天性原因需排除：酒精、isoniazid、銅缺乏/鋅過量、鉛中毒，以及 MDS with SF3B1 mutation。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為缺鐵性貧血部分治療或輸血後的雙族群：缺鐵者 ferritin 低、骨髓鐵缺乏；鐵粒母細胞性貧血 ferritin 高、骨髓有 ring sideroblasts。

quiz.q: X 性聯鐵粒母細胞性貧血的致病基因是什麼？哪種維生素可能有效？
quiz.a: ALAS2；pyridoxine（vitamin B6）

62795.recognize_zh: 油鏡下可見兩端尖細、細長彎曲的鐮刀型紅血球（sickle cells），夾雜多顆橢圓形紅血球與卵圓形紅血球，另有少數邊緣有棘突的紅血球，符合鐮刀型貧血的周邊血液抹片。
features: Elongated, curved sickle cells with tapered pointed ends (center of field)
Numerous elliptocytes and ovalocytes with smooth contours
Several crenated red cells with short regular spicules (echinocytes, likely artifact)
Some target-like/folded cells; red cells show loss of uniform central pallor
Scattered platelets; no nucleated cells in this field
62795.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high magnification shows marked poikilocytosis with scattered elongated sickle cells having tapered pointed ends, together with numerous elliptocytes and ovalocytes. Several crenated cells with regular short spicules are present and likely represent drying artifact. Platelets are present, and no nucleated cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with sickle cell disease.

ddx.vs: Hereditary elliptocytosis shows uniform smooth elliptocytes without any crescent-shaped cells with pointed ends.
HbSC shows fewer classic sickle cells and many target cells with straight-edged 'boat' or intracellular HbC crystal forms.
Pencil cells are thin, hypochromic and blunt-ended with accompanying microcytosis rather than dense curved sickle forms.

exam.answer_en: Sickle cell disease — elongated crescent-shaped sickle cells with pointed ends on peripheral smear
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指「兩端尖細的彎月形紅血球」問名稱，並問分子缺陷：β-globin 第 6 胺基酸 glutamate → valine（HbS）。
Solubility／sickling test 只證明含 HbS，無法區分 trait 與 disease；需 Hb electrophoresis 或 HPLC 定量 HbS、HbF、HbA2。
抹片常見伴隨：Howell-Jolly bodies（autosplenectomy 功能性無脾）、target cells、有核紅血球；無脾者易受莢膜菌感染。
急症：acute chest syndrome、中風（兒童以 transcranial Doppler 篩檢）、splenic sequestration、aplastic crisis（parvovirus B19）。
Hydroxyurea 可提高 HbF、減少疼痛危機與 acute chest syndrome。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 elliptocytes 或 pencil cells 當成鐮刀型細胞；sickle cell 緻密、彎曲且兩端尖細，elliptocyte 兩端圓鈍，pencil cell 細長低色素。

quiz.q: 圖中兩端尖細的彎月形紅血球是什麼？其 β-globin 的胺基酸替換為何？
quiz.a: Sickle cell；β6 Glu→Val（HbS）

62667.recognize_zh: CD45 染色中，小型淋巴球呈強烈膜狀陽性，而細胞質淡、界線清楚、核大有核仁的大型腫瘤細胞則陰性或極弱；PEL 常見 CD45 表現減弱或缺失，需小心不要誤判為癌或非造血腫瘤。
features: Sheets of large polygonal cells with abundant pale cytoplasm, distinct borders and vesicular nuclei with nucleoli
Large tumor cells are CD45-negative to very weak
Strong membranous CD45 staining of interspersed small lymphocytes (internal control)
Positive small lymphocytes form streaks and clusters between tumor cell groups
Cohesive growth of tumor cells around a vascular/sinus space mimicking a non-hematopoietic tumor
62667.describe_en: CD45 immunohistochemistry shows cohesive sheets of large polygonal cells with abundant pale cytoplasm, distinct cell borders and vesicular nuclei with nucleoli that are negative to only very weakly stained. Interspersed small lymphocytes show strong membranous CD45 staining and serve as an internal positive control. The cohesive growth and CD45 loss can mimic carcinoma or melanoma, a recognized pitfall in primary effusion lymphoma. Findings show absent to weak CD45 in the neoplastic cells, consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma when combined with MUM1/CD138 and HHV8 positivity.

ddx.vs: CD45-negative cohesive cells as well, but cytokeratin-positive and HHV8/MUM1-negative.
CD45-negative with S100/SOX10/melan-A expression and HHV8 negativity.
Can be CD45-weak and cohesive, but is strongly CD30 and ALK or T-cell antigen positive and HHV8-negative.
Also CD45-weak with plasmacytic phenotype, but HHV8 (LANA-1)-negative.

62603.recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交的全切片低倍影像：左上方實質性腫瘤結節整體呈較深的紫色，相較右側與下方的淡粉色軟組織；但此倍率無法確認個別細胞核的訊號。
features: Scanning-magnification view of an ISH-stained section
Large solid cellular nodule (upper left) with diffuse purple-grey tone
Adjacent pale pink layered/folded soft tissue with little signal
Small detached cellular fragment at upper right with similar darker tone
Individual nuclear EBER signal cannot be resolved at this resolution
62603.describe_en: Low-power whole-section image of EBER in situ hybridization shows a solid, densely cellular nodule that is diffusely darker than the adjacent pale soft tissue, suggesting widespread signal within the lesional cells. However, at this scanning magnification discrete nuclear staining cannot be confirmed and interpretation depends on higher-power fields. In conjunction with high-power EBER images from the same case, the findings support an EBV-associated lesion, consistent with EBV-positive plasmacytoma-like post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.dx: EBV-negative PTLD or plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: EBV-negative lesions lack nuclear EBER signal in tumor cells, which must be confirmed at high power rather than by low-power tone.

ddx.dx: Non-specific chromogen background or thick section
ddx.vs: True EBER positivity is crisp nuclear staining sparing cytoplasm and stroma, whereas background produces a diffuse smudgy tint.

62539.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片高倍下紅系前驅細胞體積偏大、染色質呈細點狀開放（megaloblastoid change），且細胞核與細胞質成熟度不一致，屬於紅系發育不良，是 RCC 抹片中常見的線索。
features: Enlarged erythroid precursors with open, finely stippled (megaloblastoid) chromatin
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony: nuclei immature relative to more hemoglobinized cytoplasm in some cells
Several large cells with deeply basophilic or gray-blue cytoplasm and round nuclei
Admixed granulocytic precursors, including a cell with granular cytoplasm and a bilobed/band-like nucleus
No convincing increase in blasts in this field
62539.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows erythroid precursors that are enlarged, with finely stippled, open chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, consistent with megaloblastoid change. Admixed granulocytic precursors show maturation without obvious excess of blasts in this field. Findings indicate dyserythropoiesis; in a child with persistent cytopenia and less than 2% blasts in blood and less than 5% in marrow, this supports refractory cytopenia of childhood after exclusion of nutritional and inherited causes.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia also shows giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils and is excluded by normal vitamin levels, rather than morphology alone.
Parvovirus produces giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions and a paucity of maturing erythroid forms rather than megaloblastoid change across stages.
CDA shows striking binucleation or internuclear bridging confined to the erythroid lineage with isolated anemia, not multilineage cytopenias.

62475.recognize_zh: 脾臟低倍 Bcl-2 染色中，擴大的白髓結節與周圍紅髓的淋巴細胞大多陽性，結節外圍陽性較深，中央較淡而不均；未見整片陰性的反應性生發中心，支持腫瘤性 B 細胞（脾邊緣區淋巴瘤）表現 Bcl-2。
features: Low-power view of expanded, confluent white pulp nodules
Bcl-2 positivity in most lymphoid cells within nodules, with darker staining at the nodule periphery and paler, heterogeneous staining centrally
No sharply demarcated Bcl-2-negative reactive germinal centers
Positive lymphoid cells also infiltrating intervening red pulp/perivascular areas
62475.describe_en: Bcl-2 immunohistochemical stain on spleen at low power shows expanded, partly confluent white pulp nodules in which the majority of lymphoid cells are Bcl-2 positive. Staining is stronger at the periphery of the nodules and paler and heterogeneous centrally, which may reflect colonized residual follicle centers. Positive cells also extend into the intervening red pulp. Because Bcl-2 is also expressed by normal T cells and mantle and marginal zone B cells, the stain supports but does not establish a neoplastic process; findings are compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma in context.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma shows Bcl-2 co-expressed with CD10 and BCL6 in the follicle centers, whereas SMZL is CD10 negative.
Reactive germinal centers are sharply Bcl-2 negative with a Bcl-2-positive mantle rim, and the white pulp is not diffusely expanded.
Mantle cell lymphoma is Bcl-2 positive but also CD5 and cyclin D1 positive.

62411.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD138 免疫染色中，細胞膜呈棕色陽性的漿細胞單顆或成小群散佈於脂肪空隙之間，背景大多數造血細胞為陰性（藍色）；漿細胞數量增加且成小群，是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤中漿細胞分化成分的表現。
features: Bone marrow section with interspersed fat spaces and a moderately cellular hematopoietic background
Increased CD138-positive plasma cells with crisp membranous/cytoplasmic staining
Plasma cells arranged singly and in small clusters, some adjacent to fat cells
Background hematopoietic and lymphoid cells are CD138-negative with blue hematoxylin counterstain
No sheets or large nodules of plasma cells in this field
62411.describe_en: CD138 immunostain on a bone marrow core biopsy highlights an increased number of plasma cells with strong membranous staining, arranged singly and in small clusters among fat spaces. The background hematopoietic and lymphoid cells are CD138-negative, and no sheets of plasma cells are present. This pattern of scattered and clustered plasma cells accompanying a small lymphoid infiltrate supports plasmacytic differentiation of a B-cell lymphoma; light-chain ISH is needed to confirm clonality. Findings are compatible with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are perivascular, polytypic by kappa/lambda ISH and not associated with a clonal small B-cell infiltrate.
Myeloma usually forms interstitial sheets or nodules of plasma cells with a high percentage, often CD56-positive or CD19-negative, and lacks an accompanying clonal lymphocyte population.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: CD138 staining is similar, so pattern of infiltration, clinical features and MYD88 L265P status are used for separation.
Carcinoma cells are also CD138-positive but form cohesive epithelial clusters that are cytokeratin-positive, unlike single plasma cells.

62347.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結內有數個縮小的生發中心，中央可見透明化粉紅色物質與血管，外圍小淋巴球排列成一圈圈同心環狀的洋蔥皮（onion skinning）外套區，濾泡間血管增生，是透明血管型 Castleman 病的典型低倍表現。
features: Multiple small regressed germinal centers, one containing hyalinized eosinophilic material and a vessel
Broad mantle zones with small lymphocytes in concentric rings (onion-skin pattern)
Interfollicular areas with prominent small vessels and hyalinized vessel walls
Monotonous small mature lymphocytes throughout without large atypical cells
Nodal architecture shows follicles crowded without distinct sinuses in this field
62347.describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows follicles with small, atretic germinal centers, one of which contains hyalinized eosinophilic material and a central vessel. The surrounding mantle zones are expanded, with small lymphocytes arranged in concentric rings imparting an onion-skin appearance. The interfollicular stroma shows increased small vessels with hyalinized walls, and no sinuses are evident in this field. No atypical large cell population is seen. Findings are consistent with Castleman disease, hyaline vascular type.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma has back-to-back neoplastic follicles with attenuated mantles and BCL2-positive germinal centers, not small regressed centers with thick onion-skin mantles.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL mantles consist of cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, CD5-positive clonal cells, whereas Castleman mantle cells are polyclonal and cyclin D1-negative.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific reactive hyperplasia with regressed follicles
ddx.vs: Reactive nodes lack the consistent concentric mantle layering, penetrating hyalinized vessels and hypervascular interfollicular stroma across the node.

exam.answer_en: Hyaline vascular Castleman disease — small regressed germinal centers with concentric onion-skin mantle zones and interfollicular hypervascularity
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍問三大特徵：regressed/atretic germinal centers、onion-skin 同心圓外套層、濾泡間透明化小血管增生；典型為 lollipop 與 twinning。
UCD 臨床：通常單一淋巴結腫大、症狀少、CRP 與血球多正常；若有發燒、貧血、低白蛋白、器官腫大，應考慮 MCD 並重新分類。
iMCD 需先排除感染（含 HHV-8、EBV）、自體免疫與淋巴瘤；TAFRO 表現為血小板低下、全身水腫、發燒、骨髓纖維化、器官腫大。
HHV-8 相關 MCD 需 LANA-1 IHC 與血中 HHV-8 viral load；可合併 Kaposi sarcoma 與 HHV-8 相關淋巴瘤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 萎縮生發中心與同心圓外套層並非 Castleman 專屬，也見於 HIV 淋巴結病、自體免疫疾病與 IgG4 相關淋巴結病等：需結合單一病灶臨床與排除其他病因。

quiz.q: 圖中外套層小淋巴球排列成同心圓的外觀稱為什麼？此組織型態最常對應哪一種 Castleman 臨床型？
quiz.a: Onion-skin（onion skinning）；unicentric Castleman disease

62283.recognize_zh: PD-1 染色在大型結節內可見多個不規則、密集的深棕色陽性區塊與條帶，分布於被打散的生發中心位置，右下方小濾泡也有陽性聚集，背景散在較淡的陽性 T 細胞，符合 PTGC 中的濾泡輔助 T 細胞分布。
features: Irregular, dense bands and clusters of strongly PD-1-positive cells within the large nodule
Distribution follows the fragmented germinal center remnants rather than a single round germinal center
Separate PD-1-positive aggregate in a small follicle at the lower right near the capsule
Moderate background of scattered weaker PD-1-positive T cells
Capsule and vessels at the right; no interfollicular sheets of PD-1-positive cells
62283.describe_en: PD-1 (CD279) immunohistochemistry shows irregular dense clusters and bands of strongly positive follicular helper T cells distributed within the enlarged nodule in the pattern of fragmented germinal center remnants, with a separate positive aggregate in a small follicle near the capsule. Scattered weaker positive T cells are present in the background, without interfollicular sheets. Rosettes around large cells cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: NLPHL shows PD-1-positive T cells forming rosettes around scattered LP cells throughout the nodules, which needs high-power confirmation.
AITL has PD-1-positive atypical T cells spreading into the expanded paracortex with clear cells and arborizing vessels, rather than PD-1 cells confined to follicular structures.

62219.recognize_zh: 在厚重紅血球背景中，一條黏著成片的大細胞群，核圓、染色質細緻並有核仁，細胞質淡藍帶空泡，其中可見疑似核分裂像；右下一顆大細胞有多個核仁，屬於骨髓中的轉移性癌細胞團。
features: Cohesive band-like cluster of large cells with shared pale blue cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli; some nuclear overlap
Vacuolated cytoplasm at the cluster edges
Probable mitotic figure within the cluster and a large cell at lower right with multiple nucleoli
Thick red cell background with rare platelets
62219.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive, band-like cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells set in a thick red cell background. The cells have round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli, moderate pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm and focal nuclear overlap; a probable mitotic figure is present, and a large cell at lower right shows multiple nucleoli. Normal hematopoietic cells are not evident within the cluster. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma in the bone marrow, compatible with the known breast primary.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts are loosely arranged with eccentric nuclei and a hof separate from the nucleus, lacking nuclear overlap, mitoses and prominent nucleoli.
Erythroid islands center on a macrophage with surrounding erythroblasts showing deeply basophilic cytoplasm and progressive maturation, not uniform vacuolated epithelial cells.
Lymphoma cells are discohesive and CD45/CD20 positive, whereas carcinoma forms true cohesive groups that are cytokeratin positive.

62155.recognize_zh: H&E 可見淋巴濾泡被同心圓排列的套區淋巴球包圍（洋蔥皮樣，onion skinning）；免疫染色中散在的漿母細胞呈 HHV-8 點狀核染色、胞質 IgM 強陽性並 lambda 限制，符合 HHV-8 相關多中心 Castleman 病。
features: Regressed follicle with a broad mantle zone of small lymphocytes in concentric onion-skin layers
Hyalinized penetrating vessels within the follicle center
CD20 highlights the follicle and scattered B cells
HHV-8 (LANA-1) shows scattered nuclear-positive cells mainly within the mantle zone
Scattered large cells with strong cytoplasmic IgM staining in the mantle zone
Lambda-positive large cells with essentially negative kappa staining, indicating lambda restriction
62155.describe_en: Lymph node excision (A, H&E) shows a regressed follicle surrounded by an expanded mantle zone of small lymphocytes arranged in concentric layers, with hyalinized vessels penetrating the follicle. CD20 (B) highlights the follicular B-cell compartment. HHV-8 LANA-1 immunostain (C) shows scattered nuclear-positive cells, predominantly within the mantle zone. These cells show strong cytoplasmic IgM (D) and lambda light chain (E) expression, with kappa (F) essentially negative. Findings are consistent with HHV-8-associated multicentric Castleman disease with IgM lambda plasmablasts.

ddx.vs: iMCD can show similar follicular changes but the LANA-1 immunostain is negative and there are no IgM lambda plasmablasts.

ddx.dx: HHV-8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: HHV-8+ DLBCL forms confluent sheets of IgM lambda plasmablasts effacing architecture rather than scattered cells within mantle zones.
Unicentric disease shows similar onion-skin mantles and lollipop vessels but lacks HHV-8-positive plasmablasts and systemic inflammatory symptoms.
Kaposi sarcoma shows HHV-8-positive spindle cells forming slit-like vascular spaces rather than LANA-positive plasmablasts in mantle zones.

62155.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, HHV-8 LANA-1, IgM, lambda, kappa

exam.answer_en: HHV-8-associated multicentric Castleman disease — regressed follicles with onion-skin mantles and LANA-1+ IgM-lambda plasmablasts in the mantle zone
pearls_zh: 考法：H&E 指濾泡問「onion skinning、穿入性玻璃樣血管」，免疫染色問 HHV-8 LANA-1 點狀核陽性細胞位於何處（套區）與其輕鏈表現。
HHV-8+ plasmablasts 典型為 IgM lambda，但分子上多為多克隆或寡克隆；形成成片融合時要考慮進展為 HHV-8+ DLBCL, NOS。
機轉：病毒 vIL-6 等造成全身發炎；臨床為發燒、淋巴結腫大、脾腫大、血球低下、低白蛋白、CRP 升高，常合併 Kaposi sarcoma。
治療：rituximab 為主（嚴重者合併 etoposide），HIV 患者同時給予抗反轉錄病毒治療；監測血漿 HHV-8 viral load。
需與 KSHV inflammatory cytokine syndrome（KICS）鑑別：KICS 有類似症狀與高 HHV-8 病毒量，但淋巴結無 MCD 病理變化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 idiopathic MCD 或 plasmablastic lymphoma：iMCD 為 HHV-8 LANA-1 陰性；plasmablastic lymphoma 為成片 CD20− 細胞、常 EBV+ 且多 HHV-8 陰性。

quiz.q: 套區中散在的大細胞 HHV-8 LANA-1 呈核陽性，這些細胞典型表現哪種免疫球蛋白重鏈與輕鏈？
quiz.a: IgM lambda（plasmablasts）

62091.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被大片單調的中型母細胞佔滿：核圓、核質比極高、細胞質僅一圈淡藍色，染色質細緻、部分可見小核仁，沒有顆粒或 Auer 桿，也看不到成熟的骨髓或紅血球系前驅細胞，符合 ALL 骨髓取代。
features: Sheets of monotonous medium-sized blasts with virtually no residual normal hematopoiesis
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular/indented nuclei with fine, finely stippled chromatin
Small, occasionally visible nucleoli; no Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Occasional smudged cells and a few small mature lymphocytes; scattered red cells
62091.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a densely cellular field replaced by sheets of monotonous medium-sized blasts. The blasts have round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small inconspicuous to occasionally visible nucleoli, and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm, without Auer rods. Residual maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements are not identified, and occasional smudged cells are present. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; immunophenotyping (reported as precursor B-ALL here) and cytogenetic/molecular risk stratification are required.

ddx.dx: AML with minimal differentiation or acute megakaryoblastic leukemia
ddx.vs: These can look agranular and lymphoid-like, so MPO and flow cytometry for myeloid (CD13/CD33/CD117) or megakaryocytic (CD41/CD61) markers are needed to exclude them.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are TdT-negative with surface light chain expression.
Blastoid MCL is TdT/CD34-negative, CD5+ with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression and surface light chain restriction.

exam.answer_en: B-lymphoblastic leukemia — sheets of monotonous medium-sized lymphoblasts with thin agranular cytoplasm replacing normal hematopoiesis
pearls_zh: 考法：問「這些母細胞是骨髓系還是淋巴系」；型態無顆粒、無 Auer rod 只能提示淋巴系，必須以 MPO 陰性與 flow 證明。
Flow 系別判定：B 系看 CD19 強陽性合併 CD79a、cCD22、CD10 之一；T 系看 cytoplasmic CD3；mixed phenotype 需同時符合兩系條件。
L1/L2 型態分類已無臨床意義；L3 型（深藍細胞質、空泡）實為 Burkitt lymphoma，必須區分，後者 TdT−、表面輕鏈陽性。
成人 B-ALL 新藥：blinatumomab（CD19 BiTE）、inotuzumab ozogamicin（CD22）、CD19 CAR-T；治療前需確認 CD19/CD22 表現。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 AML without maturation（M1）或 blastoid mantle cell lymphoma：M1 為 MPO ≥3% 陽性；blastoid MCL 為 cyclin D1+、TdT−、表面輕鏈陽性。

quiz.q: 此骨髓大片單調、無顆粒的母細胞，做 MPO 染色預期結果為何？要證實 B 系應看哪個 flow 標記最關鍵？
quiz.a: MPO 陰性；CD19（配合 CD79a／CD22／CD10）

61963.recognize_zh: Granzyme B染色可見多個中大型細胞的細胞質呈顆粒狀棕色陽性，陽性顆粒聚集於核周，而多數小細胞為陰性；表示腫瘤細胞帶有細胞毒性表型，常見於ALCL。
features: Coarse granular cytoplasmic granzyme B staining in scattered intermediate-to-large cells
Granules concentrated in a perinuclear distribution
Variable proportion of positive cells with many negative cells
Fine dot-like extracellular granular background staining
61963.describe_en: Granzyme B immunostain shows coarse granular cytoplasmic staining in a subset of intermediate-to-large cells, often perinuclear, with many cells negative. The granular pattern is characteristic of cytotoxic granule protein expression. Expression of cytotoxic markers supports a T-cell (cytotoxic) phenotype in anaplastic large cell lymphoma, which is useful when pan-T-cell antigens are lost.

ddx.dx: Reactive cytotoxic T cells or NK cells
ddx.vs: Reactive cytotoxic cells are small and few, whereas positivity in large atypical CD30+ cells indicates neoplastic expression.
ENKTL is also cytotoxic but is EBER-positive, CD56-positive and angiocentric with necrosis, and CD30 is not uniform.
DUSP22-rearranged cases are usually negative for cytotoxic markers, so strong granzyme B favors a non-DUSP22 subtype.

61899.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中左側額顳部髮際線附近（紅色箭頭）有一個數毫米大小、深色結痂的小丘疹，位於日光暴露部位；單看照片不具特異性，需配合病理與 EBER 原位雜交才能診斷 HV 樣淋巴增生性疾病（HVLPD）。
features: Clinical photograph of the left face and temple (facial features masked)
Solitary small dark crusted papule at the frontotemporal hairline (red arrow)
Lesion size a few millimeters without visible surrounding erythema or ulcer at this resolution
No facial edema or widespread vesicles visible in this view
Sun-exposed location compatible with hydroa vacciniforme-type lesions
