61899.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the left face with the eyes masked shows a small, dark, crusted papule at the frontotemporal hairline (red arrow). The surrounding skin appears unremarkable, without evident facial edema, vesicles or varioliform scarring in this view. The appearance is nonspecific on its own, but in a sun-exposed site it is compatible with a crusted papulovesicular lesion of hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoproliferative disorder. Diagnosis requires biopsy with demonstration of an EBV-positive (EBER) T- or NK-cell infiltrate.

ddx.vs: Classic HV is a self-limited photodermatosis of childhood without systemic symptoms or persistent EBV-positive clonal infiltrate, whereas HVLPD can have systemic disease and high EBV DNA load.
Bite reactions show a wedge-shaped infiltrate with eosinophils and are EBER negative.
Herpetic lesions show multinucleated keratinocytes with viral inclusions (Tzanck/PCR positive) rather than an EBER-positive lymphoid infiltrate.
PLEVA shows interface change with parakeratosis and a CD8-predominant infiltrate that is EBER negative.

61835.recognize_zh: 這是 Sanger 定序色譜圖，比較正常對照與病人的正反股；箭頭標示 c.857C>T（p.Ala286Val），在異合子的樣本中同一位置出現 C（藍）與 T（紅）重疊的雙峰（標為 Y），用來確認 GATA2 點突變。
features: Four Sanger chromatogram panels labeled normal and patient, forward and reverse strands
Arrow marks c.857C>T (p.Ala286Val) position
Overlapping double peak (blue C and red T, base call 'Y') at the arrowed position, indicating heterozygosity

The double peak is seen in the panels labeled 'Patient forward' and 'Normal reverse', while 'Normal forward' and 'Patient reverse' show a single C peak, suggesting a possible panel-label inconsistency
Clean baseline with well-resolved flanking peaks
61835.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic figure showing Sanger sequencing chromatograms of the GATA2 region in a normal control and the patient, on forward and reverse strands. At the arrowed nucleotide (c.857C>T, p.Ala286Val), overlapping blue (C) and red (T) peaks of roughly comparable height with a 'Y' base call indicate a heterozygous substitution, whereas a single C peak indicates the reference sequence. Of note, as labeled, the double peak appears in the 'Patient forward' and 'Normal reverse' panels but not in 'Patient reverse', which suggests the lower two labels may be transposed; the interpretation should be verified against the original data. A heterozygous missense variant in the GATA2 zinc-finger region confirmed in germline tissue supports myeloid neoplasm with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Germline origin requires detecting the variant at heterozygous levels in non-hematopoietic DNA such as cultured skin fibroblasts.
An artifact typically appears on one strand only with broad, non-base-shaped peaks, whereas a true variant is reproducible on both strands with sharp overlapping peaks.
Variant pathogenicity must be classified using population frequency, functional domain location, and ClinVar/ACMG criteria rather than chromatogram appearance.

61771.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 下深藍色的淋巴細胞區之間，有一片片淡粉紅、細胞質豐富的組織球區（右下角最明顯），在淋巴結中呈擴張竇狀分佈；低倍下 Rosai-Dorfman disease 常呈這種深淺交錯的外觀，需高倍確認 emperipolesis。
features: Low-power view with dense sheets of small lymphocytes interrupted by pale eosinophilic zones
Pale zones (especially lower right) composed of large histiocytes with abundant pink cytoplasm, in a sinusoidal-like distribution
Interspersed plasma cells and small vessels within the lymphoid areas
No follicles with germinal centers evident in this field
Emperipolesis is not resolvable at this magnification
61771.describe_en: Low-power sections show a lymphoid tissue in which sheets of small lymphocytes and plasma cells alternate with pale eosinophilic areas composed of large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm, imparting a light-and-dark pattern suggestive of expanded sinuses. No well-formed germinal centers are identified in this field. Emperipolesis and nuclear details cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The architecture is suggestive of Rosai-Dorfman disease, to be confirmed on high power and with S100 immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Sinuses contain smaller S100-negative histiocytes without emperipolesis and normal nodal architecture is preserved.
Sinus involvement by grooved CD1a+ cells with eosinophils and necrosis rather than large pale S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma with histiocyte-rich background
ddx.vs: Contains CD30/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells and often capsular fibrosis, identified on high power.
Epithelioid histiocytes form compact granulomas with multinucleated giant cells, not loose sheets of large histiocytes with engulfed lymphocytes.

61707.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中紅血球在薄區仍一個疊一個排成短鏈或堆疊（像一疊銅板），這就是錢串狀排列（rouleaux），提示血中有大量單株免疫球蛋白（M protein）。
features: Red cells stacked in short chains and linear aggregates (rouleaux) throughout the thin area of the smear
Individual red cells are normocytic and mostly normochromic
Scattered platelets of normal size
Few leukocytes: segmented neutrophils and small lymphocytes; no circulating plasma cells seen in this field
Faint bluish background staining is not clearly appreciable at this magnification
61707.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-medium power shows prominent rouleaux formation, with red cells arranged in stacked chains even in the thin area of the smear. Red cells are otherwise normocytic, and platelets appear adequate in number. Scattered neutrophils and lymphocytes are present, and no circulating plasma cells are identified in this field. Findings are suggestive of increased plasma proteins, such as a monoclonal paraprotein, and are consistent with plasma cell myeloma in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Agglutination forms irregular, grape-like three-dimensional clumps without linear stacking and disperses with warming, whereas rouleaux forms coin-stack chains.
Overlapping red cells in the thick part of a smear mimic rouleaux, so rouleaux should be confirmed in the monolayer as seen here.
Polyclonal protein increase can cause similar rouleaux, so serum protein electrophoresis/immunofixation is needed to demonstrate a monoclonal protein.

exam.answer_en: Rouleaux formation in peripheral blood — stacked red cell chains in the thin area, indicating increased plasma protein such as a myeloma paraprotein
pearls_zh: 考法：指一疊銅板狀排列的紅血球問名稱：rouleaux；並問機轉：血漿中大量帶正電蛋白（M protein、fibrinogen、多株 Ig）降低紅血球間 zeta potential。
必須在抹片薄區判讀，厚區本來就會堆疊；常同時可見抹片背景偏藍（蛋白質增加），ESR 明顯升高。
後續檢查：SPEP、serum immunofixation、serum free light chain；確診骨髓瘤需骨髓檢查與 CRAB/SLiM 評估。
若血片見到循環漿細胞需計數；IMWG 2021 以血中克隆漿細胞 ≥5% 定義 primary plasma cell leukemia。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與紅血球凝集（cold agglutinin）混淆：rouleaux 為線性堆疊、加生理食鹽水可分散；凝集為不規則團塊、食鹽水不散、37°C 回溫可消失並伴 MCHC 假性升高。

quiz.q: 這張血片紅血球排列成一疊銅板狀，稱為什麼？和紅血球凝集如何用簡單操作區分？
quiz.a: Rouleaux formation；加生理食鹽水稀釋後 rouleaux 會分散，凝集則不會。

61643.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片幾乎全為細胞、脂肪極少，並可見多處顏色較深藍、呈結節或片狀的細胞聚集散布在較淡的骨髓中；這些深染聚集在高倍下為未成熟紅系前驅細胞群，是 PCM1::JAK2 腫瘤的線索，但低倍本身不具特異性。
features: Bone marrow core with near 100% cellularity and markedly reduced fat
Multiple darker basophilic nodular to sheet-like aggregates of immature cells
Paler intervening areas of mixed hematopoiesis with red cells
Bony trabeculae of normal thickness without osteosclerosis
Low magnification precludes cytologic assessment
61643.describe_en: Low-power view of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near 100% cellularity and minimal fat. Multiple darker basophilic nodular and sheet-like aggregates of immature-appearing cells are distributed among paler areas of mixed hematopoiesis. Bony trabeculae appear unremarkable. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification; higher power and immunostains (glycophorin, CD34, CD117) are needed to characterize the aggregates. In the context of PCM1::JAK2 fusion, the aggregates correspond to expanded islands of immature erythroid precursors.

ddx.vs: Blast aggregates are CD34/CD117 positive and glycophorin negative on immunohistochemistry.
Lymphoid aggregates are composed of CD20 or CD3 positive lymphocytes and may be paratrabecular or nodular.
CML marrow is hypercellular with granulocytic predominance and small megakaryocytes, and requires BCR::ABL1 rather than erythroid islands.
Tumor nests show cohesive epithelial or other non-hematopoietic morphology with desmoplasia and lineage-specific markers.

61579.recognize_zh: 流式圖中紅色母細胞群 CD10 一致陽性（10^1–10^2）、CD58 弱至中度陽性，形成與紫色 CD10 陰性正常細胞分開的緊密群；CD58 常用於 B-ALL 殘存疾病（MRD）與正常 hematogone 的區分。
features: Bivariate dot plot: CD10-APC700 (x-axis) versus CD58-FITC (y-axis), log scales
Red (blast-gated) population forms a tight cluster that is uniformly CD10-positive
Blasts express CD58 at dim-to-moderate intensity with a diagonal upward trend
Purple CD10-negative background population with overlapping CD58 intensity
Scattered red events in the CD10-negative region (likely gating overlap)
61579.describe_en: This flow cytometry dot plot displays CD10 versus CD58. The gated blast population (red) forms a tight, uniformly CD10-positive cluster with dim-to-moderate CD58 expression, clearly separated from the CD10-negative background events (purple), which show similar to slightly lower CD58. The homogeneous CD10-positive population supports a precursor B-cell phenotype. CD58 overexpression relative to normal hematogones is a recognized leukemia-associated aberrancy in B-ALL MRD panels, but without a normal B-precursor reference population on this plot, the degree of overexpression cannot be judged from this image alone.

ddx.vs: Normal B precursors show a maturation continuum of CD10 with relatively lower CD58, whereas leukemic blasts tend to show brighter CD58 in a compact cluster.
CD10-positive mature B cells with bright CD20 and surface light-chain restriction, lacking CD34/TdT.
May be CD10-positive but expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and lacks CD19/cCD79a.

61515.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片一小群細胞：左上為核染色質細緻、細胞質嗜鹼性的母細胞；中間兩顆未成熟細胞含大而粗、深紫黑色的嗜鹼性顆粒（異常嗜酸性前驅細胞），下方為含典型橘紅色小顆粒、核分葉不足的嗜酸性球；粗大紫黑色顆粒的異常嗜酸性球是 AML with inv(16) 的招牌。
features: Blast (top) with fine chromatin, slightly irregular nucleus, and a rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Two immature granulocytic cells containing abnormally large, coarse, dark purple-basophilic granules
Mature hypolobated eosinophil (bottom) with typical small orange-red eosinophilic granules
Immature cells have oval, eccentric nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Background red cells without notable abnormalities
61515.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a small cluster comprising a blast with fine chromatin and basophilic agranular cytoplasm, two immature granulocytic cells containing abnormally large, coarse, dark purple-basophilic granules, and a hypolobated eosinophil with typical small orange-red granules. The coarse basophilic granules in immature eosinophil-lineage cells represent the characteristic abnormal eosinophils. No Auer rods are identified in this field. In the context of increased blasts, findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with inv(16)(p13.1q22)/t(16;16) CBFB::MYH11.

ddx.vs: APL promyelocytes have bilobed nuclei, heavy azurophilic granules, and bundles of Auer rods without an accompanying eosinophil lineage abnormality.
t(8;21) also increases eosinophil precursors, but they lack the large purple basophilic granules, and the blasts show salmon-colored cytoplasm with long slender Auer rods.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia or reactive eosinophilia
ddx.vs: Eosinophil precursors in CML or reactive states have normal orange granules, and blasts are not increased in chronic phase.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: This entity is separated by PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangement studies and lacks CBFB::MYH11.

exam.answer_en: AML with inv(16)/t(16;16) CBFB::MYH11 — abnormal eosinophil precursors with large dark purple-basophilic granules alongside blasts
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指含粗大紫黑色顆粒的未成熟細胞問「這是什麼」—abnormal eosinophil；與下方正常橘紅顆粒嗜酸性球對比即可答出 inv(16)。
遺傳：inv(16)(p13.1q22) 或 t(16;16)(p13.1;q22)，形成 CBFB::MYH11；屬 core-binding factor AML，預後較好。WHO 5th 此類不設 blast 門檻，ICC 2022 需 ≥10%。
inv(16) 在核型上可能不明顯，需 FISH 或 RT-PCR 確認；RT-PCR 也可用於 MRD 追蹤。常伴 KIT、NRAS 突變。
形態多為 acute myelomonocytic leukemia；異常嗜酸性球可呈 chloroacetate esterase 陽性（正常嗜酸性球為陰性）。治療常以含高劑量 cytarabine 的鞏固化療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把異常嗜酸性前驅細胞誤認為嗜鹼性球；嗜鹼性球顆粒覆蓋核且水溶性易消失，異常嗜酸性球為粗大紫黑顆粒混有典型嗜酸顆粒並見於嗜酸系成熟過程。

quiz.q: 圖中含粗大紫黑色顆粒的未成熟細胞是什麼？它強烈提示哪一個融合基因？
quiz.a: 異常嗜酸性前驅細胞（abnormal eosinophil）；CBFB::MYH11（inv(16)）

61451.recognize_zh: PML/RARA 雙色雙融合（DC-DF）探針：左下細胞可見 1 個黃色融合訊號加 2 紅 2 綠（1F2R2G），右上細胞為 2 紅 2 綠的正常型態；只有一個融合點屬非典型型態，提示可能涉及第三條染色體的複雜轉位。
features: Interphase FISH with PML (orange/red) and RARA (green) dual-color dual-fusion probe on DAPI-counterstained nuclei
Lower-left nucleus: one yellow fusion signal, two red, and two green signals (1F2R2G, atypical pattern)
Upper-right nucleus: two red and two green separate signals without fusion (2R2G, normal pattern)
Expected classic t(15;17) pattern with this probe is 2F1R1G, which is not seen here
61451.describe_en: Interphase FISH using a PML/RARA dual-color dual-fusion probe shows two nuclei. One nucleus shows a single fusion signal together with two orange (PML) and two green (RARA) signals (1F2R2G), whereas the other shows a normal 2R2G pattern. The single-fusion pattern with retained extra signals departs from the classic reciprocal 2F1R1G pattern and suggests a variant or complex (three-way) rearrangement, or an insertion, involving PML and RARA. Correlation with karyotype, metaphase FISH, and PML-RARA RT-PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Balanced reciprocal translocation gives two fusion signals with one red and one green (2F1R1G) in the dual-fusion system.
No PML-RARA fusion is formed, so a RARA break-apart probe splits while the PML/RARA fusion probe shows no fusion.
Small inserted fusion may produce one small fusion signal with otherwise normal counts, requiring RT-PCR confirmation.
Chance colocalization occurs in a low percentage of normal cells, so a cutoff established on normal controls is required.

61323.recognize_zh: 紅血球之間可見數團由數十至上百顆紫紅色顆粒狀血小板緊密聚集而成的大團塊，這種血小板凝集會讓自動血球計數機把血小板低估，形成偽性血小板低下（常見於 EDTA 抗凝管）。
features: Multiple large aggregates of densely packed platelets between red cells
Individual platelets within clumps are small, granular and purple with preserved outlines
Red cells overlap and sit on top of the clumps; morphology otherwise normocytic without schistocytes
Few free-lying single platelets outside the aggregates
Scattered dark stain precipitate over some red cells (artifact)
61323.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large platelet aggregates, each composed of numerous granular platelets clumped together between red cells. Free single platelets are sparse, and red cells show no significant schistocytes. The dark particles overlying occasional red cells are consistent with stain precipitate rather than inclusions. Platelet clumping of this degree causes spuriously low automated platelet counts; findings are consistent with pseudothrombocytopenia, most commonly EDTA-dependent, and a repeat count in citrate or heparin tubes with smear review is recommended.

ddx.vs: Shows uniformly few platelets across the smear, including the feathered edge, without clumps.
Platelets rosette around neutrophils rather than forming free-standing aggregates, though both are EDTA-related artifacts.
Platelet clumps are trapped within fibrin threads, often with a falsely low count of other lineages as well; the tube shows a visible clot.
Single large platelet or cytoplasmic fragment rather than an aggregate of many normal-sized platelets.

exam.answer_en: Pseudothrombocytopenia — large platelet clumps on smear causing spuriously low automated platelet count (usually EDTA-dependent)
pearls_zh: 考法：自動計數血小板低但病人無出血，血片看到成團血小板，問「真正原因與下一步」→ pseudothrombocytopenia；改用 citrate 或 heparin 管重抽並看血片。
機轉：EDTA 使血小板 GPIIb/IIIa 暴露隱藏抗原決定位，被自體抗體辨識而凝集；體外現象，無臨床意義。
血小板團塊可被分析儀誤判為白血球，造成 WBC 假性升高。
應檢查羽狀邊緣（feathered edge），大型血小板團常被推到片尾。
其他假性血小板低下原因：platelet satellitism（血小板圍繞 neutrophil）、採血不順導致部分凝固、巨大血小板被計為紅血球。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤當成真正血小板低下而做骨髓或停藥；若改 citrate 管後計數正常且無出血症狀，即為 EDTA-dependent pseudothrombocytopenia。

quiz.q: 血片中成團的血小板最常造成什麼檢驗假象？應改用什麼抗凝劑重測？
quiz.a: Pseudothrombocytopenia（血小板假性降低）；sodium citrate（或 heparin）

61387.recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓切片同時看到片狀漿細胞浸潤與骨小樑旁成束排列的紡錘形肥大細胞；B–D 免疫染色分別顯示瀰漫性陽性的細胞片（漿細胞）及成束的紡錘形陽性細胞（肥大細胞）；E 流式可見少量 CD117 強陽性肥大細胞共同表現 CD25 與 CD2，符合系統性肥大細胞症合併多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Panel A: hypercellular marrow with sheets of plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and a paratrabecular band of spindle-shaped cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm in streaming fascicles
Panel B: diffuse, strongly positive sheet of tumor cells on immunostain, consistent with plasma cell infiltrate
Panels C-D: immunostains highlight compact fascicles of spindled cells adjacent to bone and in aggregates, consistent with mast cell infiltrates
Panel E: CD117-bright/high-SSC mast cell gate containing 116 events (0.02%), which co-express CD25 and CD2
Specific antibodies for panels B-D are not labeled and resolution is low
61387.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (A) shows a hypercellular marrow with sheets of plasma cells and a separate paratrabecular aggregate of spindle-shaped cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm arranged in streaming fascicles. Immunohistochemical stains (B-D; antibodies not labeled in the figure) highlight a diffuse sheet-like infiltrate and compact aggregates of spindled cells, consistent with plasma cell and mast cell components, respectively. Flow cytometry (E) identifies a small CD117-bright mast cell population (0.02% of events) with aberrant co-expression of CD25 and CD2. Findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis with an associated hematologic neoplasm (plasma cell myeloma); KIT D816V testing, serum tryptase and plasma cell clonality studies should be correlated.

ddx.dx: Reactive mast cell hyperplasia in plasma cell myeloma
ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are scattered, round, CD25-negative and CD2-negative, without compact multifocal spindle-cell aggregates of 15 or more cells.
Spindled fibroblastic cells are tryptase- and CD117-negative and lack aberrant CD25/CD2 mast cells.
Lacks the tryptase-positive, CD25-positive spindle-cell aggregates and KIT D816V mutation.
Mast cells are round and fully granulated and often CD25-negative, rather than spindled CD25+/CD2+ cells.

61195.recognize_zh: CSF 細胞離心抹片中，一排細胞具偏心圓核、粗塊狀染色質與深藍色細胞質，部分可見核旁淡染區與細胞質泡狀突起，為漿細胞，出現在 CSF 提示骨髓瘤中樞神經侵犯。
features: Cluster of four medium-sized plasma cells in an otherwise acellular cytospin background
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin
Moderate to abundant deep basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear pale zone (hof) in some cells
Irregular cytoplasmic blebs/budding in some cells, possibly partly cytospin artifact
No nucleoli prominently seen; no other inflammatory cells in the field
61195.describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytospin shows a small cluster of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and abundant deep basophilic cytoplasm, some with perinuclear hofs and irregular cytoplasmic blebs. The background is otherwise clean without accompanying lymphocytes or neutrophils in this field. In a patient with known multiple myeloma and neurologic symptoms, the findings are consistent with CNS (leptomeningeal) involvement by plasma cell myeloma; confirmation by flow cytometry for light-chain restricted CD38+/CD138+ cells is recommended.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis in infectious or inflammatory meningitis
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells occur among many lymphocytes and are polytypic by flow cytometry, whereas here they appear in isolation.
Lymphoplasmacytic or marginal zone lymphomas show a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with clonal B cells expressing CD19/CD20.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and grey vacuolated cytoplasm without a perinuclear hof.

61131.recognize_zh: BAL 抹片中央是一團淡藍色泡沫狀（foamy）無細胞團塊，裡面散佈許多深藍紫色的小點狀核（trophozoite 與囊內小體），旁邊只有少數肺泡巨噬細胞核，這種泡沫狀團塊加上點狀核是 Pneumocystis 的典型表現。
features: Central acellular, pale blue, foamy/bubbly alveolar cast
Numerous tiny dark blue-purple dot-like nuclei (trophic forms and intracystic bodies) within the foamy material
Faint clustering of dots suggests cysts, but individual 8-nucleated cysts are not clearly resolved at this magnification
Adjacent macrophage/cell nuclei with coarse chromatin and pale vacuolated cytoplasm
Large round, uniformly blue structure at the bottom edge of indeterminate nature (possible contaminant or degenerated cell)
61131.describe_en: Giemsa-stained bronchoalveolar lavage smear shows a pale blue, foamy, acellular alveolar cast containing numerous small dot-like basophilic nuclei consistent with trophic forms and intracystic bodies. Scattered alveolar macrophage nuclei are present at the periphery; no significant neutrophilic inflammation is seen in this field. Cyst walls are not stained by Giemsa, and discrete 8-nucleated cysts cannot be fully resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia; confirmation with GMS, immunofluorescence or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: PAP material is granular PAS-positive lipoproteinaceous debris without dot-like organisms and is GMS negative.
Histoplasma yeasts are intracellular within macrophages with a clear halo and a crescent nucleus, not dots within extracellular foamy casts.
Mucus is streaky rather than honeycombed, and bacteria are uniform rods or cocci lacking the clustered intracystic arrangement.

exam.answer_en: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia — foamy alveolar casts containing dot-like trophic forms/intracystic bodies in BAL
pearls_zh: 考法：指著淡藍泡沫狀團塊問病原；Giemsa 只染出點狀核（trophic forms、囊內小體），囊壁本身不著色。
確認：GMS（Grocott）染囊壁呈黑色杯狀/括弧狀；亦可用直接免疫螢光或 PCR（PCR 敏感度高，但需區分帶菌）。
高危族群：HIV 且 CD4 <200/µL、長期類固醇、器官/骨髓移植、化療病人；預防與治療首選 TMP-SMX。
中重度 HIV 相關 PCP（低血氧）治療時合併類固醇可降低死亡率；血清 β-D-glucan 常升高可作輔助。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 pulmonary alveolar proteinosis 的無定形物質；PAP 為顆粒狀 PAS+ 物質、無點狀核且 GMS 陰性，PCP 泡沫團則含點狀核、GMS 可見囊體。

quiz.q: BAL 中此泡沫狀團塊內的點狀構造是哪種病原？確認常用哪種銀染？
quiz.a: Pneumocystis jirovecii；GMS (Grocott methenamine silver)

61067.recognize_zh: 周邊血片中一個大型細胞，核圓形偏於一側、有一個清楚的核仁，細胞質豐富且呈均勻深藍色，為帶有核仁的未成熟漿細胞樣細胞（plasmablastic 型）；只顯示單一細胞，無法判斷是否達到漿細胞白血病的比例。
features: Single large cell with abundant homogeneous deep blue cytoplasm
Round, eccentrically placed nucleus occupying about half of the cell
Finely granular to moderately condensed chromatin with a single distinct nucleolus (immature/plasmablastic features)
No cytoplasmic granules; perinuclear hof not clearly seen
Background red cells with rouleaux-like aggregation, refractile debris and a weakly stained preparation
61067.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large cell with an eccentric round nucleus containing a distinct nucleolus and abundant homogeneous deep blue cytoplasm, consistent with an immature circulating plasma cell. Background red cells show rouleaux-like stacking and refractile artifacts limit evaluation. Because only one cell is shown, the proportion of circulating plasma cells cannot be determined from this image. In a myeloma patient with leukocytosis, a differential count showing ≥5% circulating clonal plasma cells supports plasma cell leukemia; flow cytometry (CD38/CD138, light-chain restriction) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have a central nucleus, less abundant and less basophilic cytoplasm, may have granules/Auer rods and are CD34/CD117 positive rather than CD138 positive.
Immunoblasts are polytypic and seen with other reactive lymphocytes during infection, lacking a monotypic plasma cell population.
Morphology overlaps; the absence of a myeloma history and presence of EBV/MYC rearrangement favor plasmablastic lymphoma.

61003.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下幾乎全是密集的骨髓系細胞，從帶有核仁的卵圓核前驅細胞到彎曲或分葉核的成熟中嗜中性球都有，沒有脂肪；這代表顆粒球系明顯增生，但單憑此圖無法確立非典型慢性骨髓性白血病（aCML），須配合血片發育不良與 BCR::ABL1 陰性。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with sheets of granulocytic lineage cells and no intervening fat
Spectrum of maturation: oval to indented nuclei with small nucleoli (promyelocytes/myelocytes) through band and segmented forms
Moderate eosinophilic granular cytoplasm in many cells
Scattered erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei; megakaryocytes not evident in this field
Numerous interstitial red cells; no sheets of blasts identifiable at this power
61003.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section at high power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow composed predominantly of granulocytic cells displaying a full spectrum of maturation from myelocytes with oval, indented nuclei and small nucleoli to band and segmented forms. Erythroid precursors are relatively few, megakaryocytes are not present in this field, and no fat is seen. There are no obvious sheets of blasts, although precise blast enumeration requires aspirate and CD34 immunostaining. The findings represent marked granulocytic hyperplasia, which in the context of BCR::ABL1-negative leukocytosis with dysgranulopoiesis is consistent with atypical CML (MDS/MPN with neutrophilia).

ddx.vs: Morphologically similar hypercellularity but with small hypolobated megakaryocytes, basophilia and a BCR::ABL1 fusion; requires cytogenetic/molecular testing.
CNL shows mature neutrophils without significant dysgranulopoiesis or circulating immature granulocytes (<10%) and usually carries CSF3R mutation.
Reactive hyperplasia lacks dysplasia and clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities and resolves with the underlying cause.
CMML shows persistent absolute monocytosis >=0.5 x 10^9/L comprising >=10% of WBC, which aCML lacks.

60939.recognize_zh: 背部遍布紅色丘疹與斑塊，皮膚切片真皮層被密集、在膠原纖維間單排浸潤的大型異型細胞占據，細胞核不規則且可見核分裂，免疫染色呈瀰漫陽性，符合白血病皮膚浸潤（leukemia cutis），為次發性 AML 的表現。
features: Clinical photo: numerous erythematous papules and small plaques over the back
Low power: dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate beneath an intact epidermis
Infiltrating cells dissecting between collagen bundles in single-file and sheet-like pattern
High power: large cells with irregular, folded to lobulated nuclei, fine chromatin, nucleoli and moderate cytoplasm; mitotic figures present
IHC: diffuse strong staining of the dermal infiltrate, sparing the epidermis (marker not labeled)
60939.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows multiple erythematous papules and plaques over the back. Skin biopsy demonstrates a dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate extending between collagen bundles beneath an uninvolved epidermis. The infiltrate consists of large atypical cells with irregular, folded nuclei, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate cytoplasm, with frequent mitoses. An immunostain diffusely highlights the dermal infiltrate. In a patient with prior therapy, findings are consistent with cutaneous involvement by acute myeloid leukemia (leukemia cutis/myeloid sarcoma); confirmation with MPO, lysozyme, CD68, CD33, CD34 and CD117 is required.

ddx.vs: Tumor cells are CD20/PAX5 positive and MPO/lysozyme negative.
BPDCN involves dermis with blastoid cells but is CD4+/CD56+/CD123+/TCF4+ and lacks MPO and lysozyme.
Sweet syndrome shows papillary dermal edema with mature neutrophils rather than sheets of atypical blasts with mitoses.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Large pleomorphic cells are strongly CD30+ T cells without myeloid markers.

60875.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒（particle）幾乎由脂肪空泡與藍色間質網絡、微血管組成，其中只散布小型淋巴球與少數巨噬細胞，缺乏成群的紅系、骨髓系前驅細胞與巨核細胞，符合再生不良性貧血的低細胞性顆粒。
features: Marrow particle composed predominantly of fat cells (clear round spaces) outlined by a meshwork of blue-staining stroma
Branching capillaries lined by elongated endothelial cells running through the particle
Sparse residual cells, mostly small round lymphocytes with scattered macrophages and stromal cells
No identifiable megakaryocytes, erythroid islands or granulocytic maturation within the particle
Peripheral blood red cells in the background
60875.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly hypocellular particle composed largely of adipocytes and a prominent stromal framework, including capillaries lined by endothelial cells. The residual cellular elements are mostly small lymphocytes with occasional macrophages and stromal cells; megakaryocytes and maturing erythroid or granulocytic precursors are not identified. No abnormal infiltrate or blasts are seen. Findings are consistent with a profoundly hypocellular marrow, in keeping with aplastic anemia; a trephine biopsy is required to confirm global cellularity.

ddx.vs: A hemodilute specimen lacks particles altogether or shows cellular particles with dilution of the trails, whereas here the particle itself is fatty and devoid of hematopoiesis.
Hypoplastic MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes, dyserythropoiesis or increased blasts among residual cells, which are absent here.
Residual cells would include a population of blasts rather than predominantly mature small lymphocytes and macrophages.
Hairy cell leukemia shows mononuclear cells with 'fried-egg' spacing and hairy projections, with CD20/CD11c/CD25/CD103 positive B cells by flow.

exam.answer_en: Aplastic anemia — hypocellular fatty aspirate particle with stromal meshwork, residual lymphocytes and macrophages, no megakaryocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指抹片中的 particle，問「這顆 particle 代表什麼？抽吸是否足夠？」→ 有 particle 但本身是脂肪與間質，代表真正低細胞，而非稀釋。
抽吸抹片只能提示低細胞性，細胞量必須由 trephine biopsy 確認。
殘存細胞以淋巴球、漿細胞、巨噬細胞為主時，淋巴球比例相對上升是再生不良的間接表現，不代表淋巴增生疾病。
同步檢查：PNH flow、染色體核型/FISH（排除 MDS 相關異常）、B12/葉酸、病毒（如 hepatitis、HIV）與藥物史。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為稀釋（hemodilute）抹片：稀釋標本沒有 particle 或 particle 本身有細胞；本圖 particle 存在但幾乎全是脂肪與間質，才是真正低細胞。

quiz.q: 這顆以脂肪與間質為主、幾乎沒有造血細胞的 particle，如何與 hemodilute aspirate 區分？確認細胞量要靠什麼？
quiz.a: 稀釋抹片無 particle 或 particle 有細胞；本圖 particle 本身低細胞。需以 trephine biopsy 確認

60619.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個巨噬細胞胞質內塞滿數十顆大小一致（約 2–4 µm）的小卵圓形酵母菌，每顆中央深染、周圍有一圈透明暈（假莢膜樣），符合莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）。
features: Macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing numerous small, uniform oval yeast forms (approximately 2–4 µm)
Each organism has a dark-staining eccentric crescent or dot of cytoplasm surrounded by a clear halo (artifactual retraction, not a true capsule)
Some yeasts appear extracellular or within an adjacent vacuolated histiocyte
No true septate hyphae or central transverse septum (no binary fission) evident
Background marrow with erythroid precursors and a megakaryocyte-like nucleus
60619.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage whose cytoplasm is filled with numerous small, uniform, oval intracellular yeast forms measuring approximately 2–4 µm, each with a dark-staining crescent of cytoplasm surrounded by a clear halo. Similar organisms are present in an adjacent vacuolated histiocyte. No elongated forms with transverse septa are identified. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis (Histoplasma capsulatum); confirmation by GMS/PAS stain, culture, or urine/serum antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Talaromyces yeasts vary more in size, include elongated sausage-shaped forms and divide by fission with a central transverse septum rather than budding.
Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a clear halo, whereas Histoplasma has no kinetoplast.
C. glabrata is slightly larger, lacks the halo, and is usually accompanied by budding without intracellular packing in marrow histiocytes.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and no surrounding halo or cell wall.

exam.answer_en: Histoplasma capsulatum in bone marrow — macrophage packed with numerous uniform 2–4 µm oval intracellular yeasts with clear halos, no septate forms
pearls_zh: 考法：典型「骨髓巨噬細胞塞滿小酵母」圖，考官要你列出三個主要鑑別：Histoplasma、Leishmania、Talaromyces marneffei，並說出各自的區分特徵。
透明暈的意義：Histoplasma 周圍透明暈是固定時的收縮假象，不是真正莢膜（名稱 capsulatum 易誤導）；mucicarmine 陰性，與 Cryptococcus 不同。
確認檢查：GMS/PAS 染色陽性、尿液/血清 antigen、真菌培養；具 thermal dimorphism（25°C 黴菌、37°C 酵母）。
臨床連結：播散型見於 HIV、移植與 TNF inhibitor 使用者，可表現為發燒、全血球減少、肝脾腫大，並可誘發 HLH；治療以 amphotericin B 誘導後 itraconazole。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Leishmania amastigotes：Leishmania 有核加上棒狀 kinetoplast、無透明暈、GMS 陰性；Histoplasma 僅見月牙狀深染胞質、有透明暈、GMS 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中巨噬細胞內小酵母周圍的透明暈，是否為真正的莢膜？mucicarmine 染色結果為何？
quiz.a: 不是，屬固定收縮假象；mucicarmine 陰性（與 Cryptococcus 不同）。

60683.recognize_zh: A 圖腦部 MRI FLAIR 影像見雙側枕葉皮質下白質對稱性高訊號，典型後部可逆性腦病變症候群（PRES）；B 圖周邊血抹片有多個碎裂紅血球（schistocyte，含盔形與三角形碎片）且血小板少，代表 tacrolimus 相關血栓性微血管病變（TMA）。
features: MRI FLAIR (A): bilateral, fairly symmetric hyperintense signal in the parieto-occipital subcortical white matter and cortex
PB (B): multiple schistocytes including helmet cells, triangular fragments, and small irregular fragments
Background red cells largely normocytic with scattered microspherocyte-like dense cells
Platelets appear markedly decreased in the field
No nucleated red cells or leukemic cells seen in this field
60683.describe_en: Axial FLAIR MRI (panel A) shows bilateral, symmetric parieto-occipital hyperintensities involving subcortical white matter and cortex, characteristic of posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome. The peripheral blood smear (panel B) shows numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells and triangular fragments, with a paucity of platelets in the field. There are no nucleated red cells or blasts. In a recipient of allogeneic marrow transplant on tacrolimus, findings are consistent with calcineurin inhibitor-associated PRES accompanied by transplant-associated thrombotic microangiopathy.

ddx.vs: TTP shows the same schistocytes and thrombocytopenia but has severely reduced ADAMTS13 activity (<10%), which is typically preserved in transplant-associated TMA.
DIC also produces schistocytes but is accompanied by prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen, and markedly elevated D-dimer, which are usually normal or mild in TA-TMA.
Artifactual fragments are few and localized to thin smear edges, whereas true TMA shows reproducible schistocytes (>1%) with elevated LDH and low haptoglobin.

ddx.dx: Posterior circulation stroke or infection (e.g., PML, CNS GVHD)
ddx.vs: Posterior stroke follows a vascular territory with diffusion restriction, and PML is asymmetric without mass effect, whereas PRES is symmetric vasogenic edema that reverses after stopping tacrolimus.

exam.answer_en: Tacrolimus-associated PRES with transplant-associated TMA — parieto-occipital FLAIR hyperintensities and schistocytes with thrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：MRI 指雙側對稱頂枕葉 FLAIR 高訊號（PRES），抹片指 helmet cell/三角形碎片，問「診斷？可能藥物？」→ calcineurin inhibitor 相關 PRES 合併 TA-TMA。
Schistocyte 判讀：ICSH 建議以 >1% 作為支持 TMA 的門檻，需配合血小板下降、LDH 上升、haptoglobin 下降。
TA-TMA 與 TTP 鑑別：TTP 為 ADAMTS13 嚴重缺乏；TA-TMA 通常 ADAMTS13 未嚴重缺乏，與內皮損傷、補體活化（sC5b-9 升高）相關。
處置：停用或更換 tacrolimus/cyclosporine、控制血壓；高風險 TA-TMA 可考慮補體抑制劑 eculizumab；PRES 多可逆。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易將移植後碎裂紅血球直接當成 TTP 而做血漿置換：TA-TMA 的 ADAMTS13 通常未嚴重缺乏，治療重點在移除誘發藥物與補體路徑。

quiz.q: 抹片中頭盔狀與三角形紅血球碎片稱為什麼？配合 MRI 最可能的藥物相關診斷為何？
quiz.a: Schistocytes；tacrolimus 相關 PRES 合併 transplant-associated TMA

60747.recognize_zh: 周邊血中有小至中型淋巴球，核圓形或略不規則、染色質中度濃縮，細胞質少；骨髓切片被單一型小淋巴球瀰漫取代，大部分細胞呈強核染色（符合 cyclin D1），另一標記呈膜狀陽性，符合非結節型套細胞淋巴瘤並伴隨紅血球生成缺乏。
features: Panel A (PB): small-to-medium lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Panel A: one larger cell with more open chromatin; no prominent nucleoli
Panel B (BM H&E): diffuse replacement by a monotonous population of small lymphoid cells; erythroid precursors not evident at this magnification
Panel C: strong nuclear staining in the majority of lymphoid cells (marker unlabeled; pattern fits cyclin D1 or SOX11)
Panel D: membranous/cytoplasmic staining in a subset of infiltrating cells (marker unlabeled)
60747.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating small-to-medium lymphocytes with round to mildly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm. The bone marrow biopsy is diffusely infiltrated by monotonous small lymphoid cells with few recognizable erythroid precursors. Immunostains (markers not labeled in the figure) show strong nuclear staining in most lymphoid cells and membranous staining in a subset. In context, findings are consistent with leukemic non-nodal mantle cell lymphoma with extensive marrow involvement associated with pure red cell aplasia; confirmation by cyclin D1/SOX11 status and t(11;14) FISH is required.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are CD23+/CD200+ with smudge cells and proliferation centers and are cyclin D1 negative, although CLL is itself a common cause of PRCA.
SMZL cells may show villous projections and an intrasinusoidal marrow pattern and are CD5 and cyclin D1 negative.
T-LGL, a classic PRCA cause, shows cells with abundant cytoplasm and azurophilic granules and a CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ intrasinusoidal infiltrate.

60491.recognize_zh: 低倍下大片凝固性壞死，細胞輪廓模糊呈鬼影狀並夾雜核碎片，左下有一條管壁增厚、管腔含纖維素的血管；廣泛壞死是結外 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤常見的表現，但本圖本身無法確立診斷。
features: Extensive geographic coagulative necrosis with ghost cell outlines and eosinophilic debris
Scattered karyorrhectic nuclear dust and few viable-appearing small dark nuclei
Small vessel with thickened wall and fibrinoid/fibrin-filled lumen at lower left
Slightly more cellular band of residual lymphoid cells at right edge
No viable large atypical cells assessable at this magnification
60491.describe_en: Low-power section shows extensive geographic coagulative necrosis composed of ghost cell outlines, eosinophilic debris, and scattered karyorrhectic nuclear fragments. A small vessel with a thickened wall and fibrin-containing lumen is present at the lower left, and a thin rim of residual viable lymphoid cells is seen at the right. Viable tumor cells are not evaluable in this field, so the image alone is not diagnostic. In a nasal/upper aerodigestive tract biopsy, such zonal necrosis with vascular injury is characteristic of extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type, and additional sampling of viable tissue with CD3, CD56, cytotoxic markers, and EBER ISH is required.

ddx.vs: GPA necrosis is basophilic 'dirty' geographic necrosis rimmed by palisading histiocytes and giant cells, without EBER-positive atypical lymphoid cells.
Fungal infection shows angioinvasive hyphae on H&E or GMS/PAS stains in the necrotic tissue.
Viable tumor at the edge shows cohesive keratin-positive cells or a different lymphoma immunophenotype, and EBER is negative.

60427.recognize_zh: 這是骨髓切片的極低倍掃描圖：骨髓腔高度富含細胞、脂肪很少，沿著部分骨小樑邊緣可見顏色較深藍、密度較高的帶狀區域，提示貼著骨小樑生長的浸潤（paratrabecular）；但此倍率無法看清細胞型態，濾泡性淋巴瘤的判定需靠高倍與免疫染色確認。
features: Scanning-power view of a bone marrow core with several bony trabeculae
Markedly hypercellular marrow with little residual fat
Darker basophilic bands abutting some trabecular surfaces (e.g., central and lower trabeculae), suggestive of paratrabecular lymphoid infiltrates
Cellular detail, nuclear contours and reticulin cannot be assessed at this magnification
Crush/fragmentation artifact at the top of the core
60427.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at scanning magnification shows a hypercellular marrow with scant fat between several bony trabeculae. Denser, more basophilic cellular bands appear to hug the surfaces of some trabeculae, raising the possibility of paratrabecular infiltrates. Cytologic detail cannot be evaluated at this power, so the nature of these infiltrates must be confirmed at higher magnification with CD20, CD10, BCL2 and BCL6 immunohistochemistry. In the given context, the paratrabecular distribution is suggestive of bone marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Benign aggregates are small, well-circumscribed, and interstitial/non-paratrabecular, whereas follicular lymphoma forms elongated infiltrates hugging the trabeculae.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma or CLL/SLL marrow involvement
ddx.vs: These more often show nodular interstitial or diffuse patterns and are CD5-positive/cyclin D1-positive or LEF1-positive rather than CD10/BCL6-positive paratrabecular cleaved cells.
Normal paratrabecular granulocytic precursors form a thin rim of mixed myeloid cells and lack monotonous small cleaved lymphocytes that stain for CD20.

60363.recognize_zh: G 帶染色核型圖標示 46,XX,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)：箭頭指出 9 號染色體長臂多出一段（der(9)）與明顯變短的 22 號染色體（Philadelphia chromosome），即 BCR-ABL1 融合的細胞遺傳學證據。
features: G-banded karyotype of a female cell (XX) with 46 chromosomes
Arrow on one chromosome 9 showing an altered, lengthened 9q (der(9)) from the reciprocal translocation
Arrow on one chromosome 22 showing a shortened 22q, the Philadelphia chromosome (der(22))
Karyotype designation printed: 46,XX,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)
No additional numerical abnormalities evident in this cell
60363.describe_en: This G-banded karyogram shows a female karyotype with 46 chromosomes and a balanced reciprocal translocation between the long arms of chromosomes 9 and 22 at bands q34 and q11.2, designated 46,XX,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2). The arrows highlight the derivative chromosome 9 and the shortened derivative chromosome 22 (Philadelphia chromosome), which carries the BCR-ABL1 fusion gene. No additional clonal abnormalities are apparent in this metaphase. In the setting of B-lymphoblastic leukemia, this finding defines B-ALL with t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2); BCR-ABL1, an entity that usually expresses the p190 fusion transcript and is treated with tyrosine kinase inhibitors.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in lymphoid blast phase
ddx.vs: Carries the same translocation; separation relies on history of a chronic phase, p210 transcript, splenomegaly and BCR-ABL1 in myeloid lineages rather than on the karyotype.
Ph-like ALL has a similar gene-expression profile and kinase-activating lesions (e.g., CRLF2, ABL-class fusions) but lacks t(9;22) and BCR-ABL1 by FISH/RT-PCR.

ddx.dx: Mixed phenotype acute leukemia with t(9;22)
ddx.vs: Requires flow cytometric evidence of both B and myeloid (MPO) lineage in the blasts.

exam.answer_en: Ph-positive B-ALL karyotype — 46,XX,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2): der(9) and shortened der(22) Philadelphia chromosome carrying BCR::ABL1
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指著變短的 22 號染色體問名稱（Philadelphia chromosome, der(22)）與融合基因（BCR::ABL1），以及另一條 der(9) 帶 ABL1::BCR。
Ph+ ALL 多數為 p190（minor bcr, e1a2）轉錄本，CML 則以 p210（M-bcr）為主；karyotype 或 dual-fusion FISH 無法區分，需 RT-PCR 決定轉錄本並作 MRD 追蹤。
治療關鍵：Ph+ ALL 需在化療（或 blinatumomab）基礎上加 TKI（如 dasatinib、ponatinib）；ABL1 kinase domain T315I 突變對多數 TKI 抗藥，ponatinib 仍有效。
Ph+ ALL 常合併 IKZF1 deletion，為不良預後標記；成人 B-ALL 中 Ph+ 比例隨年齡上升。
鑑別 CML lymphoid blast crisis：需要病史、脾腫大、p210 及 myeloid lineage 帶 BCR::ABL1；單看核型無法區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 der(22) 看成單純 22q deletion，或誤認 Ph-like ALL；Ph-like ALL 基因表現相似但無 t(9;22)、BCR::ABL1 FISH/RT-PCR 陰性，靠融合基因檢測區分。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指變短的 22 號染色體稱為什麼？其形成的融合基因在 ALL 通常是哪一種轉錄本？
quiz.a: Philadelphia chromosome（der(22)）；BCR::ABL1，ALL 多為 p190（e1a2）。

60171.recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片以顆粒球系為主，混有多顆單核球（核呈摺疊或腎形、胞質灰藍並有細小空泡），部分帶狀核與分葉核嗜中性球的顆粒偏少，芽細胞並不多，符合慢性骨髓單核球性白血病（CMML-1）。
features: Myeloid-predominant cellular smear with abundant metamyelocytes, band forms and segmented neutrophils
Increased monocytes with folded, kidney-shaped or lobulated nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles
Subtle dysgranulopoiesis: some neutrophils and bands have reduced granulation
Scattered promyelocytes/myelocytes with azurophilic granules; blasts are not increased in this field
Occasional late erythroid precursors (orthochromatic normoblasts)
60171.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and myeloid predominant, with full granulocytic maturation including promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils. Monocytes are increased, with folded to kidney-shaped nuclei, delicate chromatin and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm. Some neutrophils show subtle hypogranulation, and scattered late normoblasts are present. Blasts and promonocytes are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (CMML-1, <5% marrow blasts) when correlated with persistent peripheral monocytosis.

ddx.vs: aCML has prominent dysgranulopoiesis with <10% monocytes in the blood, whereas CMML shows a distinct monocytic component.
AMML requires ≥20% blasts including promonocytes, which have delicately folded nuclei with nucleoli and are not increased here.
Reactive monocytosis lacks dysplasia and clonal mutations and shows a normal monocyte subset distribution by flow (classical monocytes <94%).
CML shows a myelocyte peak with basophilia and dwarf megakaryocytes and carries BCR::ABL1.

exam.answer_en: Chronic myelomonocytic leukemia-1 — myeloid-predominant marrow with increased mature monocytes, subtle dysgranulopoiesis and no increase in blasts/promonocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著核摺疊、胞質灰藍有空泡的細胞問是 monocyte 還是 promonocyte——promonocyte 染色質細緻、可有核仁，計入 blast equivalent；成熟 monocyte 不算。
WHO 5th 診斷：持續周邊 monocytes ≥0.5×10⁹/L 且 ≥10% WBC；CMML-1 為周邊 blasts <5% 且骨髓 <10%，CMML-2 為周邊 5–19% 或骨髓 10–19%（WHO 5th 已取消 CMML-0）。
輔助檢查：nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate）染色標示單核球；flow 中 classical monocytes（CD14+/CD16−）比例升高支持 CMML。
分子：TET2、SRSF2、ASXL1 突變常見；須排除 BCR::ABL1 與 PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 等重排。ASXL1 突變為不良預後因子。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 promonocytes 當成熟單核球而低估 blast 數，或誤診為 reactive monocytosis；promonocyte 核仁可見、染色質細緻，反應性單核球增多無 clonal 證據，需 NGS 或核型支持。

quiz.q: 在 CMML 的 blast 計數中，哪一種單核系細胞要與 myeloblast 合併計算？CMML-1 的骨髓 blast 上限是多少？
quiz.a: Promonocytes（blast equivalents）；骨髓 <10%（周邊 <5%）。

60107.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一個中型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、核質比高，最具特徵的是細胞質邊緣有多個凸出的小芽狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），提示巨核母細胞，符合唐氏症相關骨髓性白血病。
features: Medium-sized blast with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nucleus with fine, open chromatin
Scant basophilic cytoplasm with small cytoplasmic blebs/protrusions
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods evident
Background red cells show mild anisocytosis; platelets appear sparse
60107.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, a round to slightly irregular nucleus with fine open chromatin and a scant rim of basophilic cytoplasm bearing small cytoplasmic blebs. Granules and Auer rods are not seen. Platelets appear decreased in this field. The blebbed cytoplasm suggests megakaryoblastic differentiation, and in a child with Down syndrome, findings are consistent with myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts lack cytoplasmic blebs and are TdT/CD19 or CD3 positive, whereas megakaryoblasts express CD41/CD61.
TAM blasts are morphologically identical, so age (neonate) and clinical course, not morphology, separate it.
Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm that indents around red cells.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine hairy projections, oval or bean-shaped nuclei with bland chromatin and a mature B-cell CD11c/CD25/CD103 phenotype.

exam.answer_en: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome — circulating megakaryoblast with fine chromatin and cytoplasmic blebs
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這顆邊緣有小芽狀突起的母細胞，問「是哪一系的 blast」（megakaryoblast），再給臨床「唐氏症、2 歲」問診斷（ML-DS）。
Flow/IHC：megakaryoblast 表現 CD41、CD61、CD42b，常合併 CD34、CD117、CD13/CD33 與異常 CD7；MPO 陰性，因此細胞化學常看不出髓系分化。
分子：GATA1 exon 2 突變（產生 GATA1s）為 TAM 與 ML-DS 共同特徵；ML-DS 另有 cohesin、CTCF、JAK/RAS 等額外突變。
臨床：ML-DS 多發生於 4 歲以前，常先有 MDS-like 血球減少期與骨髓纖維化；對 cytarabine 敏感，採減量強度化療即有良好預後。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常被誤認為 ALL 淋巴母細胞：兩者都是高 N:C 無顆粒母細胞，但 megakaryoblast 有細胞質 blebs，flow 為 CD41/CD61 陽性、TdT 與 B/T 抗原陰性；唐氏症孩童兩種白血病都會增加，必做 flow。

quiz.q: 唐氏症 2 歲孩童周邊血出現這種帶 cytoplasmic blebs 的母細胞，應以哪些 flow 標記確認其系別？
quiz.a: CD41、CD61、CD42b（megakaryoblast），MPO 陰性。

60043.recognize_zh: 流式圖中紅色母細胞群位於 CD45 弱陽、低到中等 SSC 的母細胞區，CD34 強陽、CD13 陽性，並有部分弱陽性的 CD19 表現；髓系母細胞帶 CD19 異常表現是 t(8;21) AML 的典型免疫表型線索。
features: Red-gated blast population with dim CD45 and low-to-intermediate, somewhat broad side scatter
Bright, uniform CD34 expression
Partial dim aberrant CD19 expression on a subset of CD34-positive blasts
CD13 positive; CD33 dim (weaker than typical myeloid blasts)
CD117 dim to partial, with a subset showing partial CD15 (maturing myeloid spectrum)
60043.describe_en: Flow cytometric plots show a red-gated blast population in the CD45-dim, low-to-intermediate side scatter region. The blasts are brightly CD34 positive and CD13 positive, with dim CD33, dim-to-partial CD117, and partial CD15 expression reflecting a maturing myeloid component. A subset of the CD34-positive blasts shows aberrant dim CD19 expression, distinct from the brighter CD19-positive normal B cells (gray). This myeloid immunophenotype with aberrant CD19 expression is characteristic of, and should prompt cytogenetic or molecular confirmation for, acute myeloid leukemia with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1.

ddx.vs: MPAL requires strong CD19 with at least one other B-lineage marker (cCD79a, cCD22, CD10) plus MPO, whereas dim partial CD19 alone on myeloid blasts is an aberrancy typical of t(8;21) and does not assign B lineage.

ddx.dx: B-lymphoblastic leukemia with myeloid antigen expression
ddx.vs: B-ALL shows bright uniform CD19 with CD10, cCD79a, and CD22 and lacks MPO, whereas here CD19 is dim and partial on CD13/CD117-positive blasts.
Inv(16) AML typically shows a monocytic component (CD14, CD64, CD11b) and aberrant CD2 rather than CD19; cytogenetics separates the two core-binding factor leukemias.

exam.answer_en: AML with t(8;21); RUNX1::RUNX1T1 by flow — CD45-dim CD34-bright CD13+ myeloblasts with partial dim aberrant CD19 expression
pearls_zh: 讀圖：紅色族群在 CD45 dim/低 SSC 區，CD34 強、CD13 陽性為髓系母細胞；重點是部分 CD34+ 母細胞帶弱 CD19（比灰色正常 B 細胞弱），這是考官要你指出的異常表現。
t(8;21) 典型表型：CD34+、HLA-DR+、MPO+，CD33 相對偏弱，常異常表現 CD19、CD56 與 PAX5（IHC）；看到此組合應立即安排 RUNX1::RUNX1T1 RT-PCR 或 FISH。
CD56 陽性在 t(8;21) AML 可見，部分研究與較差預後相關；KIT 突變亦需檢測。
治療連結：CBF AML 對含高劑量 cytarabine 的鞏固治療反應佳，gemtuzumab ozogamicin 對 CD33 陽性 CBF AML 有存活效益；MRD 以 qPCR 追蹤融合轉錄本。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易被誤判為 MPAL B/myeloid：MPAL 需強 CD19 加上 CD79a、CD22 或 CD10 其中之一的 B 系證據與 MPO；t(8;21) 母細胞僅弱而部分的 CD19，不足以指定 B 系，而且有定義性遺傳異常時不診斷 MPAL。

quiz.q: 髓系母細胞（CD34+/CD13+）出現弱陽性 CD19，最應聯想到哪一種重現性遺傳異常的 AML？
quiz.a: AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1)；RUNX1::RUNX1T1。

27083.recognize_zh: 中央一顆細胞質空泡化、含棕黑色含鐵血黃素顆粒與吞噬碎片的巨噬細胞，周圍緊密環繞一圈互相擠壓成多角形的大型芽細胞；外觀模仿紅血球島（erythroblastic island），但環繞的是染色質細緻、細胞質豐富的白血病芽細胞，而非深染圓核的有核紅血球——即「芽細胞島」。
features: Central macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm, phagocytosed debris and brown-black hemosiderin granules
Rosette-like ring of tightly packed large blasts surrounding the macrophage
Blasts with moderate-to-abundant purple-gray cytoplasm, molded polygonal outlines, and fine, open chromatin
Some blasts show small cytoplasmic vacuoles; no Auer rods evident
Absence of dense round erythroblast nuclei that would be expected in a normal erythroblastic island
27083.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a central macrophage with vacuolated cytoplasm containing phagocytic debris and hemosiderin, encircled by a tight rosette of large leukemic blasts with abundant, somewhat molded cytoplasm, fine chromatin and occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles. The arrangement mimics an erythroblastic island, but the surrounding cells lack the condensed round nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm of erythroid precursors. Findings are consistent with a 'blastic island' in acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b) help confirm the monocytic lineage.

ddx.vs: A normal island is ringed by erythroblasts with round, dense nuclei and deeply basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm, not by large blasts with open chromatin.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive three-dimensional clusters without a central macrophage and are keratin-positive and CD45-negative.
HLH macrophages contain engulfed intact blood cells, and the surrounding marrow shows normal maturing elements rather than a ring of blasts.

2635.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆紅血球內有數顆粗大、深藍紫色的點狀包涵體，符合標題所示的粗嗜鹼性點彩（coarse basophilic stippling）；但這些顆粒集中在細胞下緣而非均勻散布，型態上也需與 Pappenheimer 小體鑑別。
features: Central red cell containing several coarse, dark blue-purple punctate granules
Granules clustered toward one margin of the cell rather than evenly dispersed
Occasional other red cells with faint fine stippling
Background mild anisopoikilocytosis with some elongated, folded and stomatocyte-like cells
No nucleated red cells, leukocytes or parasites in the field
2635.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mild anisopoikilocytosis with scattered folded and stomatocyte-like red cells. A central erythrocyte contains several coarse, dark blue-purple granules; they are clustered along one margin rather than distributed evenly throughout the cell, and only faint fine stippling is seen in occasional other cells. The findings are compatible with coarse basophilic stippling as labeled (as seen in lead poisoning), but the peripheral clustering also raises Pappenheimer bodies, which a Prussian blue stain would distinguish. Correlation with blood lead and zinc protoporphyrin levels is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are a few peripheral clustered granules that stain with Prussian blue, whereas basophilic stippling is iron-negative ribosomal RNA dispersed throughout the cell.
A Howell-Jolly body is usually a single, larger, round, dense DNA remnant rather than multiple small granules.
Parasites have a ring of cytoplasm with a chromatin dot and may show pigment or tetrads, unlike simple punctate granules.
An overlying platelet has a granular center with a pale cytoplasmic halo and lies in a different focal plane.

exam.answer_en: Coarse basophilic stippling as labeled (lead poisoning); granules are clustered, so Pappenheimer bodies need exclusion with Prussian blue
pearls_zh: 考法：指著中央紅血球內的深藍紫色顆粒問「是 basophilic stippling 還是 Pappenheimer bodies？如何確認？」→ 做 Prussian blue 鐵染色。
粗 basophilic stippling 常見原因：鉛中毒、thalassemia、pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase deficiency、MDS 等紅血球生成異常。
Basophilic stippling 本質為核糖體 RNA 聚集、鐵染色陰性；Pappenheimer bodies 含鐵（Prussian blue 陽性），多見於脾切除或 sideroblastic anemia。
懷疑鉛中毒時驗 blood lead level 與 zinc protoporphyrin，並詢問職業或環境暴露史。
exam.pitfall_zh: 本圖顆粒偏向細胞一側聚集，易與 Pappenheimer bodies 混淆；stippling 應均勻散布全細胞且鐵染色陰性，Pappenheimer bodies 聚於周邊且鐵染色陽性。

quiz.q: 要區分此紅血球內顆粒是 basophilic stippling 還是 Pappenheimer bodies，應加做什麼染色？
quiz.a: Prussian blue（Perls）鐵染色

3403.recognize_zh: 多個紅血球邊緣有成簇、細小不規則的藍紫色顆粒（Pappenheimer bodies），同時可見大量標靶細胞、船形／鐮刀狀紅血球與偶見單一圓點的 Howell-Jolly 小體，符合鐮刀型貧血脾功能低下。
features: Multiple small, irregular basophilic granules clustered at the periphery of many red cells (Pappenheimer bodies)
Numerous target cells
Elongated boat-shaped / sickle-form red cells
Occasional single round dense inclusion consistent with a Howell-Jolly body
Scattered crenated cells (echinocytes) and platelets in the background
3403.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows many target cells and scattered elongated boat-shaped sickle forms. Numerous erythrocytes contain small clusters of irregular basophilic granules located near the cell membrane, consistent with Pappenheimer bodies, and an occasional cell contains a single round Howell-Jolly body. A few crenated cells are present. Findings are consistent with sickle cell disease with functional hyposplenism; a Prussian blue stain would confirm the siderotic nature of the granules.

ddx.vs: Howell-Jolly bodies are single, round, smooth-edged and larger, and do not stain with Prussian blue.
Stippling is evenly distributed throughout the red cell rather than clustered at one edge, and is iron negative.
Hb C disease shows target cells and intraerythrocytic rhomboid crystals but not sickle forms.
Superimposed platelets are larger, granular and often surrounded by a pale halo.

exam.answer_en: Sickle cell disease with hyposplenism — Pappenheimer bodies, target cells, boat-shaped sickle forms and occasional Howell-Jolly bodies
pearls_zh: 考法：指著紅血球邊緣的成簇顆粒問名稱與成分 → Pappenheimer bodies（iron-containing siderosomes），再問背景細長船形細胞 → sickle cells。
SCD 病因為 β-globin 第 6 個胺基酸 glutamic acid → valine（HbS），去氧時聚合使紅血球變形。
Pappenheimer bodies 與 Howell-Jolly bodies 同時增加是 hyposplenism 的血片證據；SCD 兒童需肺炎鏈球菌疫苗與 penicillin 預防。
確認需 Hb HPLC/electrophoresis 與 Prussian blue 染色證實顆粒含鐵。
exam.pitfall_zh: 周邊聚集的 Pappenheimer bodies 易與 basophilic stippling 混淆；stippling 均勻散布全細胞且鐵染色陰性，Pappenheimer bodies 聚在一側且鐵染色陽性。

quiz.q: 此血片同時見大量標靶細胞、船形紅血球與周邊聚集的含鐵顆粒，這些顆粒增加反映脾臟的什麼狀態？
quiz.a: Hyposplenism/functional asplenia（Pappenheimer bodies 未被脾臟清除）

25163.recognize_zh: 血片中多個中型淋巴細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質均勻呈毛玻璃樣、無明顯核仁，胞質淡灰藍且量中等，細胞邊緣一圈細長毛髮狀突起，是典型的毛狀細胞白血病（hairy cell leukemia）細胞。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, roughly 1.5–2 times red cell diameter
Round to oval, occasionally slightly indented nuclei with homogeneous ground-glass chromatin
Nucleoli absent or inconspicuous
Moderate pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections
Red cells unremarkable in background
25163.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cells have a moderate amount of pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine, circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections. No blasts are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia; flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123 positivity) and BRAF V600E testing are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent central nucleolus and present with high WBC without monocytopenia, and are CD25 and CD123 negative and BRAF wild-type.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have short polar villi and more clumped chromatin, and are CD103 and annexin A1 negative.
Prolymphocytes have a single prominent nucleolus and moderately condensed chromatin without circumferential hairy projections.
CLL cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm and coarse soccer-ball chromatin, and are CD5/CD23 positive.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — medium lymphoid cells with ground-glass chromatin, no nucleoli and circumferential hairy cytoplasmic projections
pearls_zh: 考法：指著胞質邊緣毛髮狀突起的細胞問診斷與 flow 標記 → HCL，CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123 陽性；IHC annexin A1 最具特異性。
分子：幾乎所有 classic HCL 帶 BRAF V600E；細胞化學 TRAP 陽性為傳統考點。
臨床：脾腫大、全血球減少合併 monocytopenia；骨髓常 dry tap（reticulin fibrosis），切片呈 fried-egg 外觀。
第一線治療為 purine analog（cladribine 或 pentostatin），可合併 rituximab；復發難治可考慮 BRAF inhibitor。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與 HCL variant（WHO 5th 歸入 splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli）混淆；後者有明顯核仁、無 monocytopenia，CD25/annexin A1 陰性且 BRAF 野生型。

quiz.q: 這些胞質有毛髮狀突起的淋巴細胞最可能是什麼疾病？哪個基因突變幾乎必見？
quiz.a: Hairy cell leukemia；BRAF V600E

23819.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨噬細胞的細胞質裡（及破裂後散出至周圍）充滿大量 2–4 µm 的小圓形/卵圓形原蟲，每顆都有紫色的核與旁邊一條小棒狀的動基體（kinetoplast，箭頭），即為利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（amastigote）。
features: Macrophage with numerous small (2-4 um) oval intracytoplasmic organisms, some dispersed extracellularly
Each organism has a round purple nucleus and a separate small rod-shaped dark kinetoplast (arrows)
Pale blue organism cytoplasm without a surrounding clear capsule
Surrounding marrow cells include myeloid precursors and a plasmacytoid cell
Occasional red cells in the background
23819.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage containing numerous small, oval intracellular organisms, with some organisms dispersed in the adjacent background from ruptured cytoplasm. Each organism measures approximately 2-4 um and contains a round nucleus and a distinct, smaller rod-shaped kinetoplast. Surrounding hematopoietic precursors are present without other specific abnormalities. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes, diagnostic of visceral leishmaniasis in this HIV-coinfected patient with pancytopenia.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a clear halo/pseudocapsule and a single eccentric nucleus without a kinetoplast and are GMS/PAS positive.
Toxoplasma organisms are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and lack a kinetoplast.
Morphologically nearly identical with a kinetoplast, but T. cruzi favors cardiac/smooth muscle and epidemiology or PCR is needed to separate them.
Platelets and debris are granular and irregular without the consistent paired nucleus-kinetoplast structure.

exam.answer_en: Visceral leishmaniasis (HIV coinfection) — bone marrow macrophage packed with Leishman-Donovan bodies (amastigotes with nucleus + rod-shaped kinetoplast)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指巨噬細胞內或散在背景的 2–4 µm 小體，問「這是什麼、靠什麼確認」；答案關鍵是每顆都有 nucleus + kinetoplast 兩個點。
Leishmania amastigote 為原蟲，GMS/PAS 不染；Histoplasma 為酵母菌，GMS/PAS 陽性且無 kinetoplast，這是必考的鑑別方式。
確診工具：骨髓抹片、PCR、培養；脾臟抽吸敏感度最高但有出血風險。HIV 共感染者血清學（如 rK39）敏感度較低，且病原體量多，周邊血 buffy coat 也可能找到。
臨床連結：發燒、肝脾腫大、全血球低下、高 γ-globulin 血症；可繼發 HLH。治療首選 liposomal amphotericin B，HIV 共感染者復發率高，常需次級預防。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Histoplasma capsulatum：兩者都在巨噬細胞內、大小相近，但 Leishmania 有棒狀 kinetoplast、無透明 halo，GMS 染色陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中巨噬細胞內小體旁邊那條小棒狀構造叫什麼？它能幫你排除哪一種常見的鑑別診斷？
quiz.a: Kinetoplast（動基體）；可與 Histoplasma capsulatum 區分（Histoplasma 無 kinetoplast、GMS 陽性）。

15115.recognize_zh: 移植後患者上顎黏膜瀰漫性紅斑並散布許多小白點／小丘疹（A），以及硬顎上白色網狀角化斑塊與紅斑交錯（B），是口腔慢性移植物抗宿主病（cGVHD）的苔蘚樣（lichenoid）變化。
features: Panel A: diffuse erythema of hard and soft palate with numerous small pale punctate papules
Panel B: confluent white hyperkeratotic lichenoid plaques on the hard palate interspersed with erythema
White keratotic change extending along the maxillary gingiva/vestibule in panel B
No discrete deep ulcer or mass lesion visible
15115.describe_en: Clinical photographs of the palate in patients with chronic graft-versus-host disease. Panel A shows diffuse erythema of the hard and soft palate studded with numerous small pale papules; small translucent papules on the soft palate in this setting can represent superficial mucoceles from minor salivary gland involvement. Panel B shows confluent white hyperkeratotic, lichenoid plaques admixed with erythematous mucosa over the hard palate and adjacent gingiva. No mass lesion or deep ulceration is evident. Findings are consistent with oral mucosal cGVHD with lichenoid features.

ddx.vs: Candidal plaques wipe off to leave a raw base and show yeasts/pseudohyphae on KOH or PAS, whereas lichenoid cGVHD keratosis is fixed.
Clinically and histologically similar lichenoid interface change, separated mainly by the transplant history and associated multi-organ cGVHD manifestations.
Smoker's palate shows keratotic white mucosa with central red dots at minor salivary duct orifices, lacking the erythematous lichenoid plaques and transplant context.

3019.recognize_zh: 這張圖只見三個早期骨髓系前驅細胞（前骨髓細胞樣），胞質藍灰、細顆粒散佈覆蓋核上，核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻；形態本身不具專一性，須結合嗜中性球低下、胰臟外分泌不全與 SBDS 基因檢測才能診斷 Shwachman-Diamond 症候群。
features: Three large immature myeloid precursors with round to oval nuclei and moderate N:C ratio
Finely dispersed chromatin without distinct nucleoli at this magnification
Grayish-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic/purple granules scattered over the cytoplasm and nucleus
Irregular granule distribution with relatively hypogranular peripheral cytoplasm in one cell
No mature neutrophils in the field; background red cells only
3019.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow aspirate shows three early myeloid precursors with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and bluish cytoplasm containing fine purple granules that overlie the nucleus. No mature granulocytes are present in this field, and no Auer rods are identified. These appearances are non-specific; a myeloid maturation arrest-like or dysgranulopoietic pattern may be seen in Shwachman-Diamond syndrome, but the diagnosis rests on neutropenia, exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, skeletal findings and biallelic SBDS mutation. Findings are suggestive of, but not diagnostic for, Shwachman-Diamond syndrome in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: SCN shows maturation arrest at the promyelocyte stage with near-absent later forms and lacks pancreatic insufficiency; distinction requires genetic testing.
APL promyelocytes are numerous with bilobed nuclei, heavy granulation, Auer rod bundles and PML::RARA, not scattered dysgranular precursors in a hypocellular marrow.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic neoplasm / AML evolving from SDS
ddx.vs: Clonal evolution shows increased blasts, multilineage dysplasia and acquired TP53 or chromosome 7 abnormalities beyond baseline SDS changes.

13835.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抽吸碎粒中有正常的骨髓系、紅血球系前驅細胞與小淋巴樣細胞混合，箭頭指向一個小型淋巴樣細胞；在此放大倍率下核裂痕不易辨認，僅能提示淋巴球增加，須配合流式細胞與切片才能確認濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Cellular aspirate particle with mixed trilineage hematopoietic cells
Scattered small lymphoid cells with dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm, one indicated by the arrow
Myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils, and erythroblasts present in normal proportions at low power
Nuclear contour irregularity of the lymphoid cells cannot be reliably resolved at this magnification
No blast sheets or megakaryocyte abnormality evident
13835.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle containing maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors admixed with small lymphoid cells, one of which is indicated by the arrow. The lymphoid cells have dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm, but nuclear clefts cannot be confidently resolved at this magnification. No increase in blasts is evident. Findings are compatible with, but not in themselves diagnostic of, marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma; flow cytometry for a CD10-positive clonal B-cell population and trephine biopsy for paratrabecular aggregates are required.

ddx.vs: Hematogones are polytypic with a maturing CD10/CD20/CD34 pattern on flow cytometry, whereas follicular lymphoma shows a light-chain-restricted CD10+ population.
CLL cells are round with block-like chromatin and are CD5+ CD23+ rather than CD10+ cleaved cells.
Mantle cell lymphoma shows CD5+ cyclin D1+ cells with t(11;14).

11723.recognize_zh: CSF 細胞離心抹片可見一群中大型異常淋巴細胞，核深度凹陷、摺疊或切痕，染色質細緻、可見小核仁，胞質淡藍，數量與異型性都不是反應性淋巴球，符合被套細胞淋巴瘤（常為母細胞樣／多形性型）中樞神經侵犯。
features: Monotonous population of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells (cytospin flattening accentuates size)
Irregular, deeply indented, cleaved to folded nuclear contours
Finely dispersed to slightly vesicular chromatin with small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale blue agranular cytoplasm with occasional blebs
Clean background without accompanying neutrophils or monocytes
11723.describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytospin shows a cellular specimen composed of a monotonous population of medium- to large-sized atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have irregular, cleaved to folded nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, and a moderate rim of pale agranular cytoplasm. Reactive small lymphocytes, monocytes and neutrophils are not prominent. In a patient with mantle cell lymphoma, findings are consistent with leptomeningeal involvement, likely with blastoid or pleomorphic cytology; flow cytometry confirming a CD5-positive, light chain restricted B-cell population supports the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive CSF contains a mixed population of small lymphocytes, activated forms and monocytes with polytypic B cells, rather than a monotonous cleaved-cell population.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and very fine chromatin and are TdT-positive, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT-negative and cyclin D1-positive.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in CSF
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells may look similar but are cyclin D1-negative and usually CD5-negative, so immunophenotyping is required.

3915.recognize_zh: 中央大細胞核呈雙葉、染色質中度凝集，外圍一圈窄而深藍、幾乎無顆粒的細胞質，體積明顯大於周圍骨髓前驅細胞，屬未成熟巨核細胞。
features: Large cell, several times the size of surrounding myeloid precursors, with a high N:C ratio
Bilobed nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin and no distinct nucleoli
Narrow rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with a slightly irregular border
Absence of the abundant granular cytoplasm and multilobation of mature megakaryocytes
Background of maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands), an eosinophilic myelocyte, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
3915.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large immature megakaryocyte with a bilobed nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm. The surrounding marrow shows orderly granulocytic maturation with eosinophilic precursors and erythroid cells. No dysplastic separated nuclear lobes or blast clusters are present. Findings are consistent with an immature megakaryocyte, a feature that increases with high platelet turnover.

ddx.vs: A megakaryoblast is smaller, with a single round nucleus, fine chromatin, nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebs, rather than a bilobed nucleus with condensing chromatin.
Micromegakaryocytes are small, about promyelocyte-sized, with a single round nucleus and mature pink granular cytoplasm, unlike this large basophilic cell.
Proerythroblasts are smaller, with a single round nucleus, visible nucleoli and deep blue cytoplasm with a perinuclear clear zone, and lack nuclear lobation.

3723.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆體積極大的巨核細胞，單一大核高度分葉、染色質粗，細胞質豐富且顆粒細緻，細胞質內可見紅血球（emperipolesis），尺寸遠大於一般成熟巨核細胞，屬巨大巨核細胞（giant megakaryocyte）。
features: Giant megakaryocyte occupying most of the field, far larger than surrounding precursors
Low N:C ratio with a large, deeply lobulated, hyperlobated nucleus with contiguous lobes
Coarse clumped chromatin without nucleoli
Abundant finely granular lilac cytoplasm with a paler peripheral zone
Red cells within the cytoplasm, consistent with emperipolesis
Surrounding maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors
3723.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant megakaryocyte with a large hyperlobated nucleus with coarse chromatin and abundant finely granular cytoplasm. Red cells are present within the cytoplasm, consistent with emperipolesis. The surrounding marrow shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. A single giant megakaryocyte is not diagnostic; findings may be seen in reactive thrombopoiesis but, when numerous or clustered, are suggestive of a myeloproliferative neoplasm such as essential thrombocythemia, and should be correlated with the biopsy, blood counts and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing.

ddx.vs: ET shows many giant megakaryocytes with hyperlobated staghorn nuclei in loose clusters on the biopsy with sustained thrombocytosis and a driver mutation.
PMF megakaryocytes are pleomorphic with hyperchromatic, bulbous cloud-like nuclei and abnormal N:C ratio, forming tight clusters with fibrosis.
Osteoclasts contain many separate uniform round nuclei rather than a single hyperlobated nucleus.
CML megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated (dwarf megakaryocytes), not giant hyperlobated forms.

1227.recognize_zh: 兩顆帶狀/少分葉嗜中性球的細胞質中，靠近細胞膜邊緣處有小片淡藍灰色、邊界模糊的包涵體（Döhle body，殘留粗面內質網），同時伴隨明顯的毒性顆粒（toxic granulation），提示感染或發炎。
features: Two neutrophils (band/hyposegmented forms) with small, pale gray-blue, ill-defined peripheral cytoplasmic inclusions (Döhle bodies)
Prominent coarse azurophilic toxic granulation throughout the cytoplasm
Nuclei band-shaped to bilobed with condensed chromatin
Background normocytic red cells with an occasional echinocyte
Platelets normal in size and appearance
1227.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils, band to hyposegmented in form, with coarse toxic granulation and small pale blue-gray, poorly circumscribed inclusions at the periphery of the cytoplasm, consistent with Döhle bodies. Red cells are largely unremarkable apart from an occasional echinocyte, and platelets are normal in size. Findings are consistent with reactive (toxic) neutrophil changes, typically seen in infection, inflammation, burns, pregnancy or G-CSF therapy.

ddx.vs: May-Hegglin inclusions are larger, sharper, spindle-shaped, occur in most neutrophils without toxic granulation, and are accompanied by giant platelets and thrombocytopenia.
Morulae are dense, stippled, purple-blue berry-like clusters of organisms, not pale homogeneous blue patches.
Chédiak-Higashi shows giant discrete red-purple granules rather than pale blue ribosomal inclusions.
Alder-Reilly shows dark coarse granules in all leukocytes without Döhle bodies and without clinical infection.

exam.answer_en: Döhle bodies with toxic granulation — pale blue-grey peripheral cytoplasmic inclusions in band/hyposegmented neutrophils, indicating infection or inflammation
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指靠近胞膜邊緣的淡藍灰斑塊，問名稱（Döhle body，殘留粗面內質網）與同時可見的毒性變化（toxic granulation、vacuolation、left shift）。
臨床意義：常見於細菌感染/敗血症、燒燙傷、發炎、懷孕，以及 G-CSF 治療後；toxic changes 伴空泡化時需提高敗血症警覺。
反應性 vs 腫瘤性：leukemoid reaction 有毒性變化、LAP 高、無 BCR::ABL1；CML 則有嗜鹼性球增加與 myelocyte 高峰、無明顯毒性顆粒。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 MYH9-related disorder（May-Hegglin anomaly）的 Döhle-like 包涵體混淆：後者包涵體較大清楚、常呈梭狀，合併巨大血小板與血小板低下，且無毒性顆粒；本圖伴毒性顆粒屬反應性。

quiz.q: 圖中嗜中性球胞膜邊緣的淡藍灰色斑塊叫什麼？若同時見巨大血小板與血小板低下且無毒性顆粒，應想到什麼？
quiz.a: Döhle bodies；MYH9-related disorder（May-Hegglin anomaly）。

1099.recognize_zh: 單一視野的周邊血中就有六顆以上嗜酸性球，細胞質充滿橘紅色顆粒、核多為雙葉或多葉，部分顆粒分布不均；嗜酸性球明顯增多是懷疑高嗜酸性球症候群（HES）的起點，但形態無法區分反應性或克隆性。
features: Marked eosinophilia with at least six eosinophils in a single field
Mature eosinophils with bilobed to multilobed nuclei
Orange-red cytoplasmic granules, with some cells showing uneven or partially reduced granulation
Occasional small lymphocyte; no blasts identified
Crowded, overlapping red cells without significant poikilocytosis
1099.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked increase in eosinophils, most of which are mature with bilobed to multilobed nuclei and orange-red granules; a few show uneven or partially reduced granulation. An occasional small lymphocyte is present and no blasts or immature myeloid cells are seen. Red cells are unremarkable apart from overlapping in a thick area. Findings are consistent with eosinophilia; a diagnosis of idiopathic hypereosinophilic syndrome requires persistent eosinophilia (≥1.5 × 10^9/L) with organ damage after exclusion of reactive causes, clonal myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms with PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangements, and lymphocytic variant HES.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical mature eosinophils; distinguished by history, stool/serology testing and resolution after treating the cause.
May show similar eosinophils with increased mast cells; FIP1L1::PDGFRA detection by FISH or RT-PCR separates it.
Requires clonality or increased blasts (>2% PB or 5-19% BM) with dysplasia, not evident in this field.
Driven by aberrant cytokine-producing T cells (e.g., CD3-CD4+) demonstrable by flow cytometry and TCR clonality.

1355.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片幾乎整片被一致的小型深染淋巴球取代，呈瀰漫性（diffuse）浸潤、正常造血與脂肪幾乎消失，只在邊緣殘留骨小樑，符合慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）骨髓廣泛侵犯，可解釋血小板低下。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow core with near-total effacement of fat and hematopoiesis
Diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous small round lymphoid cells with dense nuclei
No well-formed paratrabecular nodules; pattern is diffuse rather than nodular or interstitial
Residual bony trabeculae and a small area of hemorrhagic/residual marrow at the edges
Pale areas suggestive of proliferation centers are not clearly resolved at this magnification
1355.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power is markedly hypercellular, with near-complete replacement of marrow fat and normal trilineage hematopoiesis by a diffuse infiltrate of small, monotonous lymphoid cells. Bony trabeculae are present at the periphery, with only a narrow rim of residual marrow elements. Cytologic detail and proliferation centers cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with extensive diffuse marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma, a pattern that correlates with marrow failure and cytopenias.

ddx.vs: Can look identical at low power; cyclin D1/SOX11 positivity and CD23 negativity distinguish it from CLL.
Tends to show nodular/intrasinusoidal infiltrates with monocytoid cells and is CD5-negative, CD23-negative by immunophenotype.
Shows admixed plasmacytoid cells, plasma cells and mast cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.
Packed marrow is composed of larger blasts with fine chromatin and mitoses rather than small mature lymphocytes; TdT is positive.

2123.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結免疫組化中，多個淡染陰性的濾泡周圍與濾泡間可見成簇的褐色陽性細胞密集聚集，副皮質區有大量散在陽性細胞，顯示 T 細胞區擴張；配合臨床可支持 ALPS，但標記未標示。
features: Low-power IHC of lymph node with multiple pale, negative-staining follicles
Dense clusters of positive (brown) cells around and between follicles
Numerous scattered positive cells diffusely distributed through the expanded paracortex
Preserved nodal architecture without effacement
Antibody not labeled; staining is nuclear/cytoplasmic granular at this magnification
2123.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of lymph node shows preserved architecture with negative follicles and an expanded interfollicular/paracortical compartment containing numerous scattered positive cells and dense perifollicular clusters. The antibody is not identified, so the lineage of the positive cells cannot be assigned with certainty from this image alone. A T-zone expansion pattern of this type is compatible with autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome in the appropriate clinical setting; confirmation requires CD3/CD4/CD8 staining showing double-negative T cells, flow cytometric quantitation of TCRαβ+ DNT cells, and FAS-pathway genetic testing.

ddx.vs: T cells retain CD4 or CD8 expression and double-negative T cells are not increased.
Contains CD30/CD15-positive Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells within the interfollicular infiltrate.
Effaces architecture with atypical, clonal T cells and aberrant antigen loss.

1867.recognize_zh: 兩顆大型反應性淋巴球，細胞質豐富淡藍，邊緣被相鄰紅血球擠壓成扇貝狀，且接觸紅血球處嗜鹼性加深（箭頭），核染色質細緻、無明顯核仁，這是傳染性單核球增多症典型的 Downey II 型反應性淋巴球。
features: Large lymphocytes with low-to-moderate N:C ratio and abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Cytoplasmic borders scalloped around adjacent red cells with peripheral basophilia at points of contact (arrows)
Oval to irregular nuclei with relatively fine but mature chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Few small cytoplasmic vacuoles and a rare azurophilic granule
Heterogeneous appearance between the two cells (one paler, one more basophilic)
1867.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows large reactive lymphocytes with abundant pale to moderately basophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasmic margins are scalloped by adjacent red cells and show condensation of basophilia at the points of contact (arrows). Nuclei are oval to irregular with fine but mature chromatin and no prominent nucleoli. No blasts are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with reactive (Downey type II) lymphocytes, as seen in infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: Blasts have a high N:C ratio, fine immature chromatin with nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm, and they form a monotonous population rather than the heterogeneous cells here.
Monocytes have folded or lobulated nuclei with lacy chromatin and grey cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles, without scalloping and peripheral basophilia around red cells.
LGLs have distinct azurophilic granules and do not show red-cell hugging peripheral basophilia.
Lymphoma cells are monomorphous with nuclear irregularity or clefting and are clonal by flow cytometry, while reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous and polyclonal.

exam.answer_en: Infectious mononucleosis — reactive (Downey type II) lymphocytes with abundant cytoplasm scalloped around red cells with peripheral basophilia
pearls_zh: 考法：指著胞質包圍紅血球、邊緣變深藍的大淋巴球問細胞名稱；答 reactive / atypical lymphocyte（Downey II），重點特徵是 RBC 處 scalloping 與 peripheral basophilia。
EBV 感染的是 B 細胞，但血片上的 reactive lymphocytes 主要是 activated CD8+ T 細胞，是常考的機轉陷阱。
血清學：heterophile antibody（Monospot）陽性；早期或兒童可能偽陰性，此時查 EBV VCA IgM；EBNA 抗體出現代表過去感染。
臨床：發燒、咽炎、頸部淋巴結腫大、脾腫大；應避免接觸性運動以防 splenic rupture，使用 ampicillin/amoxicillin 常出現皮疹。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 lymphoblast 或淋巴瘤細胞；反應性淋巴球形態不一、胞質豐富、染色質成熟無明顯核仁，blasts 則為單一族群、N:C 比高、染色質細緻有核仁。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質被紅血球擠壓成扇貝狀、接觸處嗜鹼性加深的大淋巴球叫什麼？其主要免疫表型為何？
quiz.a: Reactive（atypical, Downey type II）lymphocyte；主要為 activated CD8+ T cells

2251.recognize_zh: 淋巴結中可見上半部富含嗜中性球、核碎片與壞死的化膿性中心，下半部被淡粉紅色、梭形拉長的類上皮組織球呈柵欄狀排列包圍，這種「中央化膿壞死＋外圍類上皮組織球」的化膿性肉芽腫是兔熱病（tularemia）淋巴結炎的重要線索。
features: Central suppurative zone rich in neutrophils, karyorrhectic nuclear debris, and necrosis (upper field)
