Peripheral rim of elongated epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to spindled nuclei, arranged in a vaguely palisading pattern (lower field)
Transition zone with mixed neutrophils, histiocytes, and scattered lymphocytes
Many cells with clear halos consistent with degenerating neutrophils and apoptotic bodies
No well-formed multinucleated giant cells or organisms identifiable at this magnification
2251.describe_en: Lymph node section shows necrotizing suppurative granulomatous inflammation. The upper portion consists of a central abscess-like zone containing abundant neutrophils, karyorrhectic debris, and necrosis, bordered below by a rim of elongated, palisading epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Multinucleated giant cells and microorganisms are not identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with suppurative granulomatous lymphadenitis, a pattern seen in tularemia, cat-scratch disease, and lymphogranuloma venereum; Francisella tularensis serology or PCR and special stains for organisms are recommended.

ddx.vs: Cat-scratch disease produces an identical stellate suppurative granuloma, so the distinction relies on exposure history, Warthin-Starry or Bartonella immunostain, and serology.
Tuberculous granulomas show caseous rather than neutrophil-rich necrosis with Langhans giant cells and acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Kikuchi necrosis is rich in karyorrhexis and crescentic histiocytes but characteristically lacks neutrophils.
LGV shows similar stellate abscesses but involves inguinal nodes with Chlamydia trachomatis L1-L3 detected by PCR.

1547.recognize_zh: 箭頭標出的紅血球前驅細胞明顯變大，核染色質呈細緻的篩網狀、疏鬆（sieve-like chromatin），和旁邊核致密深染的正常晚期正染性紅血球母細胞（normoblast）對比明顯，符合巨母紅血球變化（megaloblastic change）。
features: Enlarged erythroid precursors (megaloblasts) with abundant cytoplasm, larger than adjacent normoblasts
Nuclei with fine, open, stippled 'sieve-like' chromatin despite maturing cytoplasm (nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony)
Cytoplasm ranges from basophilic to grey-pink hemoglobinized, indicating maturation lagging behind in the nucleus
Mitotic figure in a large erythroid precursor (arrow)
Small normoblasts with dense pyknotic nuclei present for size comparison
1547.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid precursors that are markedly enlarged compared with adjacent normally maturing normoblasts. The megaloblasts have finely dispersed, open 'sieve-like' chromatin that is immature relative to their partially hemoglobinized cytoplasm, reflecting nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony; a mitotic erythroid precursor is also present. No blast population or dysplastic ring sideroblast-type features can be assessed in this field. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis, as seen in pernicious anemia.

ddx.vs: MDS megaloblastoid precursors often show irregular nuclear budding, multinucleation and ring sideroblasts with normal B12/folate, whereas true megaloblasts have uniformly fine sieve-like chromatin and correct with vitamin replacement.

Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm making up the majority of marrow cells, rather than a full spectrum of enlarged but maturing erythroid precursors.
Morphology is identical; history of antimetabolite exposure and normal B12/folate levels separate it from pernicious anemia.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic erythropoiesis (pernicious anemia) — enlarged erythroid precursors with sieve-like chromatin compared with normal normoblasts
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭細胞與旁邊小而核濃縮的 normoblast 做對比，考官問「兩者差別」；答體積變大、染色質細緻篩網狀、核質發育不同步。
惡性貧血的抗體：anti-intrinsic factor antibody 特異性高但敏感度約一半；anti-parietal cell antibody 敏感但不特異；Schilling test 已不再臨床使用。
B12 補充途徑：傳統為肌肉注射；即使 intrinsic factor 缺乏，高劑量口服仍可經被動擴散吸收一部分，因此高劑量口服也是選項。
Pernicious anemia 需長期追蹤：atrophic gastritis 帶來 gastric neuroendocrine tumor 與胃癌風險，也常合併缺鐵，補 B12 後缺鐵可能顯現。
exam.pitfall_zh: 有絲分裂中的大型紅系細胞易被誤認為白血病 blasts；megaloblastic 骨髓中可見完整成熟梯度與正常 normoblast 可比較，blasts 並未增加。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指的紅系前驅細胞與旁邊正常 normoblast 比較，有哪兩項形態差異？
quiz.a: 細胞明顯變大；核染色質細緻篩網狀、落後於胞質成熟（nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony，megaloblast）

1163.recognize_zh: 紅色箭頭指的細胞比周圍顆粒球略大，核圓、染色質較細，胞質深藍且邊緣呈毛絨狀、有血小板樣小突起脫落；這是早期未成熟巨核細胞（megakaryoblast/promegakaryocyte），背景是成熟完整的顆粒球系，屬反應性高轉換狀態。
features: Arrowed cell: large immature megakaryocyte with round nucleus, relatively dense chromatin and high N:C ratio
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a frayed, blebby border shedding platelet-like fragments
Background of orderly granulocytic maturation: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Normal secondary granulation in neutrophil precursors without obvious dysplasia
Occasional erythroid precursors; no blast excess evident
1163.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field with orderly, full-spectrum granulocytic maturation including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band forms and segmented neutrophils with normal granulation. The arrowed cell is an immature megakaryocyte (megakaryoblast/promegakaryocyte stage) with a round nucleus, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with frayed blebbing margins and early platelet-like budding. No dysplastic features or blast excess are evident in this field. Findings represent immature megakaryocytes as seen in states of increased platelet turnover.

ddx.vs: AMKL shows sheets of megakaryoblasts and >=20% blasts, whereas here a single immature megakaryocyte sits within normal granulocytic maturation.
Dysplastic micromegakaryocytes are small with mature, pink granular cytoplasm and a condensed monolobated nucleus, not basophilic immature cytoplasm.
Basophils and mast cells contain discrete dark metachromatic granules, rather than basophilic cytoplasm with blebs and platelet budding.

1291.recognize_zh: 大型淋巴球有豐富的淡藍色細胞質，邊緣呈深藍色並「擁抱」鄰近紅血球（Downey II 型），核染色質較鬆散，是反應性淋巴球的典型樣貌。
features: Large lymphocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and a deeper basophilic rim at the periphery
Cytoplasmic borders indented by and scalloping around adjacent red cells (Downey type II)
Round to oval nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Low to moderate N:C ratio
Background red cells normocytic; no blasts or smudge cells in this field
1291.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large lymphocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm that deepens in basophilia toward the periphery and scallops around adjacent red cells. Nuclei are round to oval with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Red cells appear normocytic, and no blasts or smudge cells are seen. Findings are consistent with reactive (atypical) lymphocytes, as seen in infectious mononucleosis and other viral infections.

ddx.vs: Blasts have a high N:C ratio, fine immature chromatin and scant cytoplasm, whereas reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm with mature chromatin.
Lymphoma cells form a monotonous population with irregular or cleaved nuclei and are clonal by flow cytometry, whereas reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm without the peripheral basophilic rim hugging red cells.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin, a perinuclear hof and uniformly deep blue cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Reactive (atypical) lymphocytes, Downey type II — abundant pale blue cytoplasm with deeper basophilic rim scalloping around adjacent red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著大淋巴球問「胞質邊緣包覆紅血球的特徵叫什麼？」答 Downey type II（ballerina skirt），並說出最常見病因。
最典型為 EBV 傳染性單核球增多症；反應性淋巴球多為 CD8+ 細胞毒性 T 細胞（反應 EBV 感染的 B 細胞），並非 B 細胞本身。
EBV 檢查：heterophile antibody（Monospot）早期可偽陰性，兒童陽性率低；可驗 EBV VCA IgM、EBNA 抗體。其他原因包括 CMV、急性 HIV、toxoplasma、藥物反應。
反應性淋巴球為多形性（大小、形狀、胞質量各不同），flow 無單株性；若細胞單一形態則要懷疑淋巴瘤或白血病。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為淋巴母細胞或單核球；反應性淋巴球染色質較凝集、無明顯核仁、胞質邊緣深藍且形態多樣，淋巴母細胞則染色質細緻、N:C 比高、形態單一。

quiz.q: 圖中淋巴球胞質邊緣深藍並包覆鄰近紅血球，屬於 Downey 分類第幾型？這類細胞多為哪一種淋巴球亞群？
quiz.a: Downey type II；多為活化的 CD8+ T 細胞

4235.recognize_zh: 三顆中型單核細胞，核呈圓到橢圓、染色質均勻細緻，胞質淡灰藍且邊緣有細毛狀突起（hairy projections），與旁邊的分葉嗜中性球對照，符合毛狀細胞（hairy cell）。
features: Medium-sized mononuclear cells, larger than small lymphocytes, with moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei with evenly dispersed, finely stippled chromatin and no conspicuous nucleoli
Pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine, irregular hair-like circumferential projections
Adjacent segmented neutrophil for size comparison; background red cells unremarkable
4235.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin without prominent nucleoli, and moderate amounts of pale gray-blue cytoplasm bearing fine, irregular hair-like projections. A segmented neutrophil is present for comparison, and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with hairy cells, suggestive of hairy cell leukemia; flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes have short polar villi, more condensed chromatin, and sometimes a small nucleolus, and are CD103/CD123 negative and BRAF wild-type.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant/splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: HCL-variant cells have prominent nucleoli, often leukocytosis without monocytopenia, and are CD25/annexin A1 negative and BRAF V600E negative.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles rather than circumferential hair-like projections.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — hairy cells with oval nuclei, pale gray-blue cytoplasm and fine circumferential projections (neutrophil for size)
pearls_zh: 考法：與旁邊分葉中性球比大小並辨認 hairy cells；可能追問要送的 flow panel（CD11c/CD25/CD103/CD123）。
HCL 典型 CBC 為 monocytopenia；flow 上 hairy cells 因高 side scatter 可落在 monocyte 區域，判讀時須注意。
HCL variant 在 WHO 5th 已不再為獨立名稱，併入 splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli；其 CD25、annexin A1 陰性、無 BRAF V600E，對 cladribine 反應差。
骨髓切片：細胞間有清楚胞質形成 fried-egg 外觀、reticulin 增加，免疫染色 CD20、annexin A1、BRAF V600E（VE1）有助確認浸潤程度。
exam.pitfall_zh: 毛狀突起可能被當成抹片乾燥假象或 reactive lymphocyte；hairy cell 突起是細絲狀環繞全周且染色質細緻均一，reactive lymphocyte 胞質會包住紅血球、邊緣嗜鹼性且無細毛。

quiz.q: HCL 病人 CBC 最具特徵的白血球亞群異常是什麼？
quiz.a: Monocytopenia（單核球減少）

1035.recognize_zh: 抹片中大量中型單核細胞成片或成群分布，細胞核圓、染色質細、細胞質淡藍，另有數團深色色素或碎屑；此視野看不到吞噬血球的組織球，無法單憑此圖確認噬血現象。
features: Numerous medium-sized mononuclear cells arranged singly and in loose aggregates
Round to slightly indented nuclei with fine to moderately condensed chromatin
Scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm; some cells slightly larger with more cytoplasm
Several dark clumps of pigment or debris associated with cells
No convincing macrophage containing phagocytosed hematopoietic cells in this field
1035.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a cellular population dominated by medium-sized mononuclear cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and pale blue cytoplasm, arranged singly and in loose aggregates. Several dark pigment or debris clumps are present, and occasional larger cells with more cytoplasm are seen. No definite hemophagocytic histiocytes are identified in this field. The image does not by itself demonstrate hemophagocytosis; the identity of the dominant population should be established with immunophenotyping and review of other fields.

ddx.vs: Blasts show nucleoli and fine chromatin with high N:C ratio and are confirmed by flow cytometry; a reactive population is heterogeneous.
A monotonous lymphoid population with clonal immunophenotype would favor lymphoma over a reactive process.
HLH requires macrophages containing engulfed red cells or nucleated cells, which are not demonstrated here.

4043.recognize_zh: 抹片中成群的大型細胞，細胞質豐富灰藍色並充滿大量清楚的小空泡，核呈腎形或摺疊、染色質細緻並可見核仁，兼具單核母細胞與組織球的特徵，符合伴組織球分化的 AML。
features: Cluster of large cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Numerous uniform, discrete clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Reniform, folded or indented nuclei
Fine, lacy chromatin with visible nucleoli in some cells
Absence of Auer rods and granules in this field
4043.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a cluster of large cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing numerous discrete clear vacuoles, and folded or reniform nuclei with fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli. Granules and Auer rods are not seen. The cells combine monoblastic/promonocytic nuclear features with histiocyte-like vacuolated cytoplasm. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic and histiocytic differentiation; nonspecific esterase and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD163) are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive histiocytes have mature condensed chromatin without nucleoli and may contain phagocytosed cells, without an accompanying blast population.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with vacuoles, round nuclei with coarse chromatin and a B-cell phenotype rather than folded nuclei.
Histiocytic sarcoma is a tissue-based neoplasm lacking marrow blast involvement and immature myeloid markers such as CD34/CD117.

4171.recognize_zh: 厚且散開不佳的骨髓顆粒，被大量大小不一的脂肪空泡與基質網絡占據，造血細胞稀少、呈聚集團塊；可辨認的是化療後低細胞、以基質為主的顆粒，感染的具體證據無法在這張圖上看到。
features: Thick marrow particle with numerous variably sized fat vacuoles
Stromal/reticular network with clumped, poorly spread cells within the particle
Relatively few individually recognizable hematopoietic precursors, suggesting reduced cellularity
Scattered lymphocytes and occasional neutrophils at the edge of the particle
Thick preparation and overlapping cells limit cytologic evaluation; no organisms identified
4171.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a thick marrow particle composed largely of fat vacuoles and a stromal network with clustered, poorly spread cells. Individually identifiable hematopoietic precursors are sparse, and scattered lymphocytes and occasional neutrophils are present at the particle periphery. No microorganisms, granulomas, or blast population can be identified, although the thickness of the preparation limits cytologic assessment. Findings suggest a hypocellular, stroma-rich post-chemotherapy marrow; specific features of infection are not demonstrable in this image and would require stains, cultures, and biopsy correlation.

ddx.vs: Also shows fat-rich hypocellular particles, but occurs without chemotherapy history and with a particle composed of lymphocytes, plasma cells and mast cells alone.
Shows pink-purple amorphous extracellular ground substance with fat cell atrophy rather than intact fat vacuoles.
Would show epithelioid histiocyte clusters or organisms within macrophages, which are not identified here.
Requires identification of blasts or abnormal cells, better evaluated on well-spread areas, flow cytometry and biopsy.

4107.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的兩顆細胞核偏心、染色質呈粗塊狀、核旁有淡染的高爾基區（hof），細胞質深藍且含小空泡，是典型的漿細胞（plasma cell）。
features: Oval cells (arrows) with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric round nuclei
Coarsely clumped chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Pale perinuclear hof adjacent to the nucleus
Fine cytoplasmic vacuoles in the plasma cells
Background of maturing myeloid precursors, a lymphocyte and erythroid cells in a bloody aspirate
4107.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed hematopoietic population with maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Two plasma cells are highlighted, each with an eccentric round nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin, a perinuclear hof, and abundant basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm. The plasma cells appear mature without nucleoli or multinucleation in this field. Findings illustrate plasma cell morphology; distinguishing reactive from neoplastic plasma cells requires quantitation, CD138 immunohistochemistry, and light-chain restriction.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts are larger, occur in clusters, and have the hof located away from the nucleus rather than directly adjacent to it.
They have azurophilic or specific granules and a Golgi zone, but the cytoplasm is less deeply basophilic and granulated rather than vacuolated.
They are smaller with less cytoplasm and a less distinct hof, and are CD20-positive.
They have central round nuclei with checkerboard chromatin and a narrow rim of deep blue cytoplasm without a hof.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cells in BM aspirate — eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin, perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭兩顆細胞問名稱與辨識要點；答 plasma cells：核偏位、粗塊染色質、核旁 hof（Golgi）、深藍胞質。
計數漿細胞比例是必考：MM 診斷以 clonal BMPC ≥10% 為門檻之一；抽吸片可能因分布不均低估，應對照切片 CD138 IHC。
Flow 區分正常與腫瘤漿細胞：腫瘤性常 CD19−、CD45−、CD56+、CD27 減弱，並呈 κ/λ 限制性。
反應性漿細胞增多見於感染、自體免疫、肝病、HIV；多株、形態成熟。
exam.pitfall_zh: 骨髓抽吸片最常被誤認為漿細胞的是 osteoblasts：osteoblast 較大、成群出現，淡染區與核分離而非緊貼核旁，核常偏到細胞邊緣。

quiz.q: 圖中箭頭所指細胞為何？核旁淡染區代表哪個胞器？
quiz.a: Plasma cells；Golgi apparatus（perinuclear hof）

3787.recognize_zh: 箭頭標出的兩個細胞是深染、邊緣平直、兩端呈方形的長方形棒狀結晶，第三個（雙箭頭）是摺疊成船形的緻密紅血球；周圍有多個標靶細胞。這種平行邊緣的六角／長方形結晶是血紅素 C 結晶（HbC crystals）的典型外觀。
features: Two dense, dark-staining rectangular crystals with parallel straight sides and blunt ends (single arrows)
A dense, folded boat-shaped cell (double arrow)
Crystal-containing cells appear devoid of surrounding pale hemoglobin
Several target cells and a few crenated/echinocytic cells in the background
No sickle cells present in this field
3787.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows target cells with occasional crenated red cells. Two red cells are replaced by dense, dark-staining rectangular crystals with straight parallel edges and blunt ends (arrows), and a third shows a dense folded, boat-shaped configuration (double arrow). Sickle cells are not identified. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin C crystals, characteristic of hemoglobin C disease; hemoglobin HPLC/electrophoresis is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HbSC crystals are more irregular and angulated, often with finger-like projections or multiple knobs, and coexist with occasional sickle forms.
Sickle cells are crescentic with tapered pointed ends rather than straight-sided, blunt-ended rectangles.
Elliptocytes remain pale-centered ovals and do not show the homogeneous dense staining and sharp parallel edges of HbC crystals.

exam.answer_en: Hemoglobin C crystals — dense rectangular blunt-ended intraerythrocytic crystals (arrows) and folded boat-shaped cell, with target cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官分別指單箭頭與雙箭頭，問「哪個是 HbC crystal、哪個是 folded cell」；結晶呈平行直邊、兩端鈍方，周圍血紅素淡化，folded cell 則是摺成船形的緻密紅血球。
HbC trait（AC）通常無症狀、無貧血，抹片只有少量 target cells；結晶主要見於 HbCC、HbSC 與脾切除後。
HbSC disease 雖然貧血較 HbSS 輕，但 proliferative retinopathy、avascular necrosis 等血管阻塞併發症仍常見，需定期眼底檢查。
HbC 合併 β-thalassemia（HbC/β-thal）可有較明顯小球性貧血，判讀 HPLC 時需同時看 HbA 是否存在及 HbA2 比例。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 HbC 結晶誤認為鐮刀細胞；鐮刀細胞呈新月形、兩端尖細，HbC 結晶是平行直邊、兩端鈍方的深染長方體。

quiz.q: 單箭頭所指的深染長方形結構是什麼？背景常伴隨哪種紅血球？
quiz.a: Hemoglobin C crystals；target cells

3595.recognize_zh: 細胞大、細胞質豐富且為灰藍色毛玻璃樣，邊緣有少數小空泡；核呈腎形凹折、染色質細緻花邊狀；這是典型的成熟單核球。
features: Large cell, about 2-2.5 times RBC diameter, with abundant cytoplasm
Kidney-shaped/folded nucleus with fine lacy chromatin; no nucleoli
Grey-blue ground-glass cytoplasm with fine azurophilic dust
Multiple small clear vacuoles at the cytoplasmic periphery
Irregular cell outline molding against adjacent RBCs
3595.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large mononuclear cell with a folded, kidney-shaped nucleus and fine lacy chromatin without nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant, grey-blue, and finely granular, with several small peripheral vacuoles. Surrounding red cells are normochromic. Findings are consistent with a mature monocyte.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have a round-oval nucleus with more condensed chromatin and clear blue cytoplasm with a basophilic rim rather than ground-glass grey cytoplasm.
Metamyelocytes have clumped chromatin and pink cytoplasm with specific granules.
Promonocytes have more delicate chromatin, subtle nuclear folding, and sometimes nucleoli.

exam.answer_en: Mature monocyte — large cell with kidney-shaped folded nucleus, lacy chromatin and vacuolated grey-blue cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官常把單核球與反應性淋巴球並列考，要說出腎形核、花邊狀染色質、毛玻璃灰藍細胞質與空泡四個關鍵。
成熟單核球 vs promonocyte：promonocyte 染色質更細、可見核仁、核只輕微凹折；在 AML 中 promonocyte 計入 blast equivalent。
Flow 上成熟單核球 CD14 強陽性、CD64 陽性、HLA-DR 陽性；CMML 中經典單核球（CD14+CD16−）比例升高可支持診斷。
反應性單核球增多見於慢性感染（如結核）、自體免疫、脾切除後與骨髓恢復期，須與 CMML 區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 細胞質含空泡時易被誤認為反應性淋巴球或巨噬細胞；單核球細胞質是灰藍毛玻璃樣且有細塵狀顆粒，淋巴球細胞質則較透明藍、核圓不凹折。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞為何種白血球？flow cytometry 上哪一個標記最常用來辨認成熟單核球？
quiz.a: 成熟單核球（monocyte）；CD14。

3659.recognize_zh: 低倍下幾個骨髓顆粒中可見十顆左右深紫色的大型巨核細胞，分布在顆粒內與邊緣，數量明顯超出正常，提示巨核細胞增生。
features: Low-power view of several marrow particles with abundant interspersed fat
Numerous large megakaryocytes (roughly 8–10 in the field) within and along the particles
Megakaryocytes appear as large dark purple cells; lobation and size detail limited at this power
Moderately cellular particles with background hematopoietic cells
Peripheral blood red cells streaming between particles
3659.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows several moderately cellular particles containing abundant fat. Megakaryocytes are increased, with many large cells distributed within and at the edges of the particles. Megakaryocyte nuclear morphology and dysplasia cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic hyperplasia; higher-power evaluation and clinical correlation (platelet count, ITP, reactive thrombocytosis, MPN) are needed.

ddx.vs: Increased megakaryocytes with thrombocytopenia and peripheral destruction, separated from other causes by clinical and CBC correlation rather than by this low-power view.
Shows large hyperlobulated or atypical hyperchromatic megakaryocytes in tight clusters on biopsy, with driver mutations (JAK2/CALR/MPL).
Megakaryocytes are small hypolobated or micromegakaryocytes with separated nuclear lobes on high power, often with dysplasia in other lineages.

3467.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大多為中大型原始細胞（blasts），核圓或略有凹摺、染色質細緻、部分可見小核仁，細胞質量少到中等、淡灰藍且無明顯顆粒，與少數成熟桿狀中性球並存；此形態可見於 ALL 也可見於單核球性白血病，必須靠流式或細胞化學區分。
features: Increased medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to indented/folded nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin
Small nucleoli visible in some cells
Scant to moderate agranular pale gray-blue cytoplasm without Auer rods
Admixed small dark lymphocytes/erythroid precursors and occasional band neutrophils
3467.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a predominance of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratios, round to indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and scant to moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm. Auer rods are not seen, and there are scattered band neutrophils and small mature-appearing cells. The blasts lack definitive lineage-specific features. Morphology alone cannot distinguish lymphoblasts from monoblasts/promonocytes in this image; flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, cCD79a, CD34, TdT versus CD14, CD64, CD11b, lysozyme) and cytochemistry (MPO, nonspecific esterase) are required for classification.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts usually have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles or granules, delicate nuclear folds and are nonspecific esterase positive and CD14/CD64 positive, while lymphoblasts are TdT and CD19 or cCD3 positive.
Minimally differentiated myeloblasts are morphologically similar but express CD13/CD33/CD117 and MPO by flow while lacking B- or T-lineage markers.
Hematogones have homogeneous condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm and show a maturing CD10/CD20/CD34 continuum rather than a discrete blast population.

3211.recognize_zh: 疏鬆水腫的組織中散在大型異型細胞，核大、空泡狀染色質、核仁明顯，混雜小淋巴球與溢出的紅血球；但本視野無法清楚看出這些大細胞侷限於血管腔內，需以 CD34 等血管標記確認。
features: Scattered large atypical cells with enlarged vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli
Irregular nuclear contours with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes and extravasated red cells
Loose, edematous stroma with thin-walled capillary channels
Intravascular location of the large cells not clearly demonstrated at this magnification
3211.describe_en: Tissue section shows loose, edematous stroma containing a mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes and scattered large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei, irregular nuclear contours and prominent nucleoli. Thin-walled capillary channels and extravasated red cells are present. The large cells appear to lie in and around small vascular spaces, but a strictly intravascular distribution cannot be confirmed on this H&E field alone. The findings are compatible with involvement by intravascular large B-cell lymphoma in the appropriate context; CD20 with CD34 or CD31 immunostaining is recommended to demonstrate intraluminal localization.

ddx.vs: Conventional DLBCL forms extravascular sheets or masses, whereas IVLBCL cells are confined to vessel lumina on CD34/CD31 staining.
Reactive immunoblasts are admixed with plasma cells and a polymorphous background and are polytypic without clonal B-cell restriction.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in vessels
ddx.vs: Tumor emboli are cohesive and keratin+ or S100/SOX10+, rather than discohesive CD20+ CD45+ lymphoid cells.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+ CD15+ with weak PAX5 and are set within a rich inflammatory background forming nodules, not intravascular.

3147.recognize_zh: 中央一顆小型淋巴樣細胞，胞質極少、只剩薄薄一層，染色質均勻濃縮且平滑、不見核仁，形狀受周圍紅血球擠壓成多角形，符合血原母細胞（hematogone）；右側為分葉嗜中性球，左下為小型晚期紅血球母細胞。
features: Small lymphoid cell only slightly larger than a red cell, molded into a polygonal shape
Extremely scant, barely visible rim of pale cytoplasm
Homogeneous, smooth condensed chromatin with faint linear streaks
No visible nucleoli
Nearby segmented neutrophil and a small orthochromatic erythroblast with dense pyknotic nucleus in the lower left
3147.describe_en: Smear shows a small lymphoid cell with an extremely high N:C ratio, a barely perceptible rim of cytoplasm and homogeneous smooth condensed chromatin without nucleoli, molded by adjacent red cells. A segmented neutrophil and an orthochromatic erythroblast are also present. The cell has the morphology of a hematogone (normal B-lymphocyte precursor); because hematogones overlap morphologically with lymphoblasts, flow cytometric maturation pattern analysis is needed when they are numerous.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts tend to be larger with finer, more dispersed chromatin and occasional nucleoli, and show an aberrant maturation-arrested immunophenotype on flow cytometry.
Erythroblasts have a round, very dense pyknotic nucleus surrounded by hemoglobinized orange-pink cytoplasm, as seen in the lower left cell.
Mature lymphocytes have coarser, clumped chromatin and slightly more visible blue cytoplasm and lack CD10/CD34/TdT.

exam.answer_en: Hematogone — small lymphoid cell with extremely scant cytoplasm and smooth condensed chromatin without nucleoli
pearls_zh: 考法：同視野有 hematogone、neutrophil、orthochromatic erythroblast，考官會逐顆指認；左下深染小圓核那顆是晚期紅血球母細胞，不是淋巴球。
Hematogone 為正常 B 淋巴前驅細胞，flow 分階段：Stage I CD34+ TdT+ CD10+；Stage II CD10+ CD20 漸增；Stage III CD20+ sIg+ 近成熟 B 細胞。
兒童骨髓 hematogone 比例可相當高；成人明顯增加多見於再生狀態。
計數母細胞時不應把 hematogone 計入 blast，否則會誤判復發或 MDS 母細胞增加。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 orthochromatic erythroblast；後者核極緻密圓形、周圍為粉橘色含血紅素胞質，hematogone 胞質極少且淡藍。

quiz.q: 圖中央這顆胞質極少、染色質平滑且無核仁的小型細胞，最可能是什麼？
quiz.a: Hematogone（正常 B 淋巴前驅細胞）

3083.recognize_zh: 高倍下一群有核仁、胞質多空泡的大型上皮樣細胞周圍，有三顆胞質塞滿粗大紫紅色異染性顆粒、核圓的肥大細胞，其中上方一顆顆粒部分散出（脫顆粒）。
features: Cluster of large epithelioid cells with round to lobulated nuclei, visible nucleoli, and finely vacuolated blue cytoplasm with knobby borders
Three mast cells with round nuclei partly obscured by coarse purple-red metachromatic granules
Degranulation with granules spilling into the background around the upper mast cell
Two small lymphocytes with dense nuclei
Small cell fragment with golden-brown material at upper left
3083.describe_en: High-power view of a pleural fluid cytocentrifuge preparation shows a cluster of large epithelioid cells with round to lobulated nuclei, distinct nucleoli, and abundant finely vacuolated cytoplasm with knobby borders. Three mast cells with round nuclei and cytoplasm packed with coarse metachromatic granules surround the cluster, one showing degranulation. Two small lymphocytes are present. The epithelioid cells favor reactive mesothelial cells on morphology but metastatic carcinoma cannot be excluded without immunostains. Findings demonstrate mast cells in pleural fluid.

ddx.vs: Basophils have segmented nuclei and sparser, larger granules, whereas these cells have round nuclei with densely packed granules.
Neoplastic mast cells are often spindled and hypogranular with CD25/CD2 expression and KIT D816V, unlike these round well-granulated cells.
Adenocarcinoma cells form three-dimensional clusters with greater nuclear pleomorphism and are claudin-4/MOC-31 positive, calretinin negative.

2699.recognize_zh: 這是低倍掃描視野，只看得到散在紅血球間的幾顆小而緻密的白血球核，看起來未明顯分葉；但解析度太低，無法可靠判斷核的分葉型態，需換高倍確認 Pelger-Huët 異常。
features: Very low-power view of a well-spread peripheral blood smear
Scattered leukocytes with compact, dense, apparently non-lobulated nuclei
Nuclear segmentation and granulation cannot be assessed at this magnification
Red cells evenly distributed without clumping
Platelets not reliably assessable
2699.describe_en: Very low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows an evenly spread monolayer of red cells with a few scattered leukocytes. The leukocyte nuclei appear compact and dense, but nuclear lobation, chromatin pattern, and cytoplasmic granulation cannot be evaluated at this magnification. This field is useful for choosing an area for high-power review rather than for diagnosis. Findings are nonspecific; Pelger-Huët anomaly requires high-power demonstration of bilobed or non-segmented neutrophils with mature chromatin across the neutrophil population.

ddx.vs: Separation requires high-power review for hypogranularity and other dysplasia and clinical context, not assessable at scanning power.
At low power small lymphocytes and hyposegmented neutrophils both appear as round dense nuclei; high power shows the neutrophilic cytoplasmic granules.

2571.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一顆大型細胞，核為單一圓形、未分葉，胞質灰藍帶顆粒並有突出小泡（bleb），屬單核／低分葉的異常巨核細胞（dysplastic megakaryocyte），支持 MDS 的巨核系發育不良。
features: Large cell (roughly 2-3 times a red cell diameter) with a single round, non-lobated nucleus
Coarsely clumped, reticular chromatin without visible nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue, finely granular cytoplasm with a peripheral cytoplasmic bleb/budding
Adjacent bare reniform nucleus with similar chromatin and a small lymphocyte
No definite multilobation of the megakaryocyte nucleus in this field
2571.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a large megakaryocytic cell with a single round, non-lobated nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin and grey-blue granular cytoplasm with a cytoplasmic bleb. An adjacent bare reniform nucleus and a small lymphocyte are present. The non-lobated (monolobated) nuclear configuration is a form of dysmegakaryopoiesis. In the appropriate context of a hypocellular marrow with cytopenias, findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia of myelodysplastic syndrome; cellularity cannot be assessed from this single-cell field.

ddx.vs: MDS with isolated del(5q) typically shows many small hypolobated/monolobated megakaryocytes in a normo- to hypercellular marrow, requiring karyotype to separate from other MDS.

ddx.dx: Immature (stage II) megakaryocyte in reactive marrow
ddx.vs: Normal maturing megakaryocytes show progressive lobulation as cytoplasm matures, whereas a mature granular cytoplasm with a still non-lobated nucleus indicates dysplasia.
Aplastic anemia is hypocellular with markedly reduced megakaryocytes but lacks dysplastic megakaryocytes, and blasts or cytogenetic abnormalities favor hypocellular MDS.
Megakaryoblasts have finer chromatin, nucleoli and agranular basophilic cytoplasm, unlike the clumped chromatin and granular cytoplasm here.

2443.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一個原始淋巴球：比紅血球稍大、核質比高、胞質只剩一圈淡藍色邊、染色質細緻均勻且核輪廓略不規則，無顆粒；外觀屬 L1 型原始淋巴球，T 細胞系需靠流式確認。
features: Single blast about 1.5 times red cell diameter
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nucleus with subtle indentation
Finely stippled chromatin, nucleoli inconspicuous
Background normochromic red cells without other abnormalities
2443.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single small-to-medium blast with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, a thin rim of agranular pale blue cytoplasm, finely stippled chromatin and a slightly irregular nuclear contour with inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods are seen. The surrounding red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a circulating lymphoblast; T-lymphoblastic leukemia requires confirmation by flow cytometry showing TdT and cytoplasmic CD3 expression.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; B-lineage blasts express CD19, CD79a and CD10 and lack cytoplasmic CD3.
Mature lymphocytes have coarse, block-like clumped chromatin and are TdT negative.
Myeloblasts usually have more cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli and may contain granules or Auer rods, with MPO positivity.

2315.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中布滿大型母細胞，染色質細緻、核仁明顯、細胞質藍灰色，並夾雜嗜酸性骨髓細胞、嗜鹼性顆粒細胞及一個分裂中細胞，符合 CML 急性轉化。
features: Predominance of large blasts with fine chromatin, conspicuous nucleoli and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm
Some blasts with irregular, folded or elongated nuclei
A mitotic figure with condensed chromosomes (upper left)
Admixed granulocytic precursors including an eosinophilic myelocyte and a cell with coarse dark basophilic granules
Few red cells; scattered free granules in background
2315.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous large blasts with fine chromatin, prominent nucleoli and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm, some with irregular or folded nuclear contours. A mitotic figure is present, and scattered residual granulocytic precursors include an eosinophilic myelocyte and a basophil-type cell. Findings are consistent with blast phase of CML, BCR-ABL1-positive, with lineage to be confirmed by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Inv(16) AML shows abnormal eosinophils with large basophilic granules and monocytic differentiation, and lacks BCR-ABL1.
Myelomonocytic blasts show NSE positivity and monocytic immunophenotype, whereas diagnosis here rests on CML history and BCR-ABL1.
Chronic phase marrow shows a full maturation spectrum with myelocyte and neutrophil predominance, not sheets of blasts.

2187.recognize_zh: 組織被小至中型、核輪廓不規則的淋巴球瀰漫取代，其間散布較大、核空泡狀有核仁的細胞，並有組織球與小血管；細胞大小呈連續譜系而非雙相，是 PTCL, NOS 較常見的表現。
features: Diffuse infiltrate dominated by small-to-medium lymphocytes
Irregular, angulated nuclear contours in many small cells
Scattered larger cells with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli
Admixed epithelioid histiocytes and small vessels with plump endothelium
No follicles, granulomas or Reed-Sternberg-like cells in this field
2187.describe_en: Section shows diffuse effacement by a lymphoid infiltrate composed predominantly of small-to-medium lymphocytes with irregular nuclear contours, admixed with scattered larger cells showing vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli. Epithelioid histiocytes and small vessels with plump endothelial cells are interspersed. No follicles, granulomas or classic Reed-Sternberg cells are identified in this field. Findings are suggestive of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified; immunohistochemistry to confirm an aberrant T-cell phenotype and exclude TFH-derived lymphoma, along with TCR clonality testing, is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia preserves nodal architecture with a polymorphous population of immunoblasts and plasma cells, without aberrant T-cell antigen loss or clonal TCR.
The Lennert variant shows numerous clustered epithelioid histiocytes with small CD8+ T cells, a pattern only partly suggested here.
AITL has prominent arborizing HEVs, perivascular clear cells and expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks with PD1/CXCL13 expression.

2059.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 淋巴結中，原本結構被模糊、大小相近的結節（nodule）取代，結節邊界不清、缺乏明顯的外套區（mantle zone）與亮暗分區，是濾泡性淋巴瘤低倍下的線索。
features: Effacement of nodal architecture by vaguely nodular, closely packed lymphoid nodules
Nodules are poorly delineated with attenuated or absent mantle zones
Nodules appear relatively uniform in size and staining, without visible polarization or tingible-body macrophages at this power
Thin vessels coursing between nodules; little interfollicular tissue
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
2059.describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows architectural effacement by closely packed, vaguely nodular lymphoid proliferation. The nodules are ill-defined and relatively monotonous, with thin or absent mantle zones and no discernible polarization at this magnification. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed. The pattern is suggestive of follicular lymphoma, which should be confirmed by higher-power cytology and immunohistochemistry (CD10, BCL6, BCL2, CD21).

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, have well-formed mantle zones, polarization and tingible-body macrophages, and are BCL2 negative in germinal centers.
NLPBL nodules are large, pale and composed of small lymphocytes with scattered LP (popcorn) cells rather than centrocytes and centroblasts.
MCL nodules consist of monotonous small cells without centroblasts and are cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: NMZL shows pale marginal-zone cells around residual follicles and is CD10 negative, while follicular colonization shows disrupted CD21 meshworks.

1931.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見兩顆核有深折痕、凹陷的異型淋巴球：中央那顆中型細胞的核有明顯溝紋與折疊（大型 Sézary 細胞），右上那顆核呈不規則折疊；左側另有一顆小而深染的淋巴球作為大小對照。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cell (center) with a deeply indented, grooved and folded nucleus and a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Larger atypical lymphoid cell (upper right) with an irregularly folded nucleus, dense chromatin and pale cytoplasm with adherent granular material
Small mature-appearing lymphocyte with dense round nucleus at left for size comparison
Dense chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli in the atypical cells
Normochromic red cells with scattered platelets
1931.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows atypical lymphoid cells of varying size, including a medium-sized cell with a deeply grooved and folded nucleus and a thin rim of pale cytoplasm, and a larger cell with an irregularly convoluted nucleus. The chromatin is dense and nucleoli are not conspicuous. A small mature lymphocyte is present for comparison, and red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with circulating Sezary cells, including large forms, in Sezary syndrome; flow cytometric confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells have multilobated petal-like nuclei with deep separations rather than fine cerebriform grooves, and occur with HTLV-1 infection.
Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant basophilic cytoplasm that indents around red cells and lack convoluted nuclear grooves.
Monocytes have folded nuclei but with lacy, less dense chromatin and abundant grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm.
Mantle cell lymphoma cells can have cleaved nuclei but are CD5-positive B cells with cyclin D1 expression.

exam.answer_en: Sézary syndrome — circulating Sézary cells including large forms with deeply grooved, convoluted nuclei and dense chromatin
pearls_zh: 考法：同視野放大小不同的異型淋巴球與正常小淋巴球，問「哪兩顆是 Sézary cells？大型與小型的差別？」大型 Sézary cell 比中性球略大或相當、核折疊更明顯。
臨床定義：Sézary syndrome = erythroderma + 淋巴結腫大 + 周邊血有同一克隆的 Sézary cells；與 mycosis fungoides 分期同採 TNMB 系統，血液侵犯為 B2。
Flow：CD4+ 且 CD7 與/或 CD26 丟失；比較周邊血與皮膚的 TCR 克隆是否相同可支持診斷。
鑑別 HTLV-1 相關 ATLL：台灣、日本需考慮；ATLL 細胞為 CD4+、CD25+ 多分葉花瓣狀核，常伴高血鈣與溶骨病灶。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 ATLL flower cells：flower cells 為深裂成多葉的花瓣核；Sézary 細胞為單一核上細密腦迴狀溝紋。應查 HTLV-1 抗體並看是否有紅皮症。

quiz.q: 若此病人 HTLV-1 抗體陽性、細胞核呈花瓣狀多葉，應改考慮哪個診斷？
quiz.a: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma（ATLL）

1803.recognize_zh: 低倍骨切片：右側為骨小樑，左側為緻密平行排列的膠原纖維組織，中間骨髓腔被細胞密集的浸潤取代、看不到正常脂肪與造血組織；低倍下只能看出骨髓被取代，淋巴瘤的細胞型態需搭配高倍與免疫染色確認。
features: Bone trabeculae (right) with an intertrabecular space densely filled by a cellular infiltrate
Loss of normal fat and trilineage hematopoiesis within the involved marrow space
Discohesive medium to large cells in the upper marrow compartment at this magnification
Dense, parallel-oriented fibrocollagenous tissue on the left (periosteum/soft tissue)
Spindled, crushed dark cells at the lower interface; fine cytologic detail not assessable at low power
1803.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone biopsy shows bony trabeculae with an intertrabecular marrow space that is replaced by a dense cellular infiltrate, with loss of normal fat and hematopoietic elements. Dense parallel fibrocollagenous tissue is present at the left, and crushed spindled cells are seen at the lower interface. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification, so the cell type cannot be determined from this field alone. In the clinical context, findings are compatible with marrow and bone involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, which requires high-power morphology and immunohistochemistry for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Forms cohesive nests often with desmoplastic stroma and is keratin-positive, CD45-negative.
Sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, CD138 positivity and monotypic cytoplasmic light chains.
Same DLBCL morphology but confined to bone without nodal or systemic disease on staging.
Infiltrate is mixed neutrophils, plasma cells and lymphocytes with necrotic bone rather than monotonous atypical cells.

1419.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀 CD45 對側向散射（SS）圖：主要族群落在 CD45 弱至中度表現、低 SS 的「芽細胞閘」內（標為 A），另有一群 CD45 強陽性、低 SS 的成熟淋巴球；這種 CD45 dim 芽細胞群是急性白血病（此處為 T-ALL）的線索。
features: Flow cytometry density plot of CD45 PE-Cy5 (x-axis, log) versus side scatter (y-axis, linear)
Dominant population with dim to intermediate CD45 and low side scatter, enclosed in gate A (blast region)
Smaller separate population with bright CD45 and low side scatter (mature lymphocytes)
Only sparse events in the high side-scatter granulocyte region, indicating reduced maturing myeloid cells
Low-CD45 debris/erythroid events at the left of the plot
1419.describe_en: Flow cytometric CD45 versus side scatter plot shows a dominant population with dim to intermediate CD45 expression and low side scatter, gated as A in the blast region, separate from a smaller population of CD45-bright, low side scatter mature lymphocytes. Maturing granulocytes in the high side scatter region are sparse. This pattern indicates a predominance of blasts; lineage assignment requires additional markers, and in the context of T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma the gated blasts would be expected to express cytoplasmic CD3, CD7 and TdT.

60811.recognize_zh: 許多紅血球中央有深染圓點、外圍一圈淡區再一圈深染（標靶細胞 target cells），上方有一顆帶數根長短不一、不規則尖刺的細胞（spur cell／acanthocyte），合併出現提示肝病。
features: Numerous target cells with central hemoglobin condensation surrounded by a pale ring
One spur cell (acanthocyte) at upper right with a few irregular, unevenly spaced, long spiculated projections
Many crenated red cells with regular short projections (echinocytes/burr cells)
Occasional red cells with irregular or elongated shapes, including a spiculated elongated form at upper left
Mild anisocytosis; rare platelets and no leukocytes in the field
60811.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells with central hemoglobin condensation and a peripheral pale ring. A spur cell (acanthocyte) with a few irregular, unevenly distributed projections is present at the upper right, and many red cells show regular short crenations consistent with echinocytes. Mild anisocytosis is noted, with rare platelets and no leukocytes in this field. Findings are consistent with target cells and a spur cell, suggestive of acquired membrane lipid changes of liver disease; iron deficiency and hemoglobinopathy may also contribute to targeting.

ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10-30 short, evenly spaced projections around the circumference, whereas spur cells have fewer irregular projections of varying length.
Target cells alone cannot separate these; hemoglobin electrophoresis/HPLC and red cell indices distinguish them from liver disease.
Fragmented cells show horn-like paired projections or sharp torn edges rather than spicules on an intact dense cell.

exam.answer_en: Liver disease red cell changes — numerous target cells with a spur cell (acanthocyte) with few irregular long projections
pearls_zh: 考法：考官分別指 target cell 與上方那顆不規則尖刺細胞，要求說出名稱，並問「兩者合併提示什麼疾病？」答肝病。
肝病的 target cell 源於膜上膽固醇與磷脂質增加、表面積相對增大；spur cell 則見於嚴重肝病，與膜膽固醇／磷脂比例升高有關。
Spur cell anemia 是晚期肝硬化的溶血性貧血，提示預後差；脾臟會進一步清除這些僵硬紅血球。
Target cell 的其他常考原因：HbC、thalassemia、HbE、缺鐵、脾切除後；單靠形態無法區分，需 Hb 電泳／HPLC 與血清鐵檢查。
Acanthocyte 的其他原因：abetalipoproteinemia、McLeod phenotype、neuroacanthocytosis、脾切除後。
exam.pitfall_zh: Spur cell 常被誤認為 echinocyte（burr cell）：echinocyte 有 10–30 個短而均勻分布的突起；spur cell 突起數少、長短不一且分布不規則。

quiz.q: 圖中中央深染、外圍淡環的紅血球與帶不規則長刺的紅血球分別叫什麼？合併出現最常見於哪種臨床情境？
quiz.a: Target cell 與 spur cell（acanthocyte）；肝病（肝硬化）

60299.recognize_zh: 與左側淋巴球的核相比，大多數紅血球明顯偏小、中央淡染區擴大（hypochromia），並夾雜靶形細胞與少數細長細胞，符合小球性低色素紅血球（microcytosis）。
features: Red cells predominantly smaller than the nucleus of the lymphocyte (microcytosis)
Widened central pallor in many cells (hypochromia)
Scattered target cells and occasional elongated or teardrop poikilocytes
A lymphocyte and a monocyte provide size reference
Platelets are readily seen in the background
60299.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of red cells that are mostly smaller than the nucleus of a lymphocyte, with increased central pallor. Mild to moderate poikilocytosis is present, including target cells and occasional elongated and teardrop forms. A lymphocyte and a monocyte are seen, and platelets are adequate to increased. Findings are consistent with microcytic, hypochromic red cells, as seen in iron deficiency or thalassemia; iron studies and hemoglobin analysis are needed to distinguish them.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency favors pencil cells, marked anisocytosis and thrombocytosis with low ferritin, while morphology overlaps with thalassemia.
The presence of target cells raises thalassemia, which typically has a higher red cell count, lower RDW, basophilic stippling and abnormal HbA2 or globin gene testing.
Normocytic red cells approximate the diameter of a small lymphocyte nucleus with central pallor of about one-third, unlike the smaller hypochromic cells here.

exam.answer_en: Microcytic hypochromic red cells — RBCs smaller than a lymphocyte nucleus with widened pallor and target cells (iron deficiency vs thalassemia)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官以淋巴球核作尺比較紅血球大小，並指出 target cells，問「缺鐵還是 thalassemia？下一步做什麼？」
先驗 ferritin 與 transferrin saturation；鐵正常或偏高再做 Hb electrophoresis／HPLC。
β-thalassemia trait：HbA2 升高（通常 >3.5%）；α-thalassemia trait HbA2 正常或偏低，需 DNA 檢測（台灣常見 SEA deletion）。
缺鐵會使 HbA2 下降，可能掩蓋合併的 β-thalassemia trait；補鐵後需重驗。
台灣產前遺傳諮詢重點：夫妻皆為同型 thalassemia 帶因者時，需評估胎兒重型（如 Hb Bart's hydrops fetalis、β-thal major）風險。
exam.pitfall_zh: 單看形態無法分 IDA 與 thalassemia trait：target cells 與 RBC 數高、RDW 正常偏向 thalassemia；pencil cells、RDW 高、血小板增加偏向缺鐵，但需鐵學與 Hb 分析確認。

quiz.q: 小球性病人鐵學檢查正常，HPLC 顯示 HbA2 正常，下一步最可能需要什麼檢查？
quiz.a: α-globin 基因檢測（例如 SEA deletion），評估 α-thalassemia trait

139.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片中真皮全層被中至大型、核不規則且有細緻核摺痕的非黏著性單形細胞浸潤，於膠原纖維間呈單列穿插，表皮下保留一條無浸潤帶（grenz zone）；免疫染色 NPM1 呈細胞質異位表現，NGS 見 NPM1 4 鹼基插入，符合 NPM1 突變的骨髓肉瘤。
features: Dense diffuse dermal infiltrate extending through the full biopsy depth, with a narrow uninvolved subepidermal zone (grenz zone)
Discohesive intermediate to large cells dissecting between collagen bundles, singly and in cords
Irregular, folded or indented nuclei with fine chromatin, some with small distinct nucleoli; moderate pale to amphophilic cytoplasm
Immunostains show diffuse strong positivity in the infiltrate (membranous and cytoplasmic patterns) with a partial granular histiocytic-marker pattern
NPM1 immunostain with cytoplasmic as well as nuclear staining (aberrant cytoplasmic localization)
NGS read alignment (IGV) showing a 4-base (TAGG) insertion in NPM1 exon 12 at the W288 codon
139.describe_en: Skin punch biopsy shows a dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate occupying the full thickness of the specimen with sparing of a narrow subepidermal zone. The infiltrate consists of discohesive intermediate to large cells that dissect between collagen bundles and have irregular, folded nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and moderate cytoplasm; epidermotropism is not seen. Immunohistochemistry shows diffuse expression of the illustrated markers, reported as CD4, CD56, CD33, lysozyme, CD68 and partial CD163, with negative B-, T-cell, CD34, CD117, MPO, CD123 and TCL1 (individual panels are not labeled), and NPM1 shows aberrant cytoplasmic localization. Next-generation sequencing shows a 4-base insertion in NPM1 exon 12. Findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma with monocytic differentiation and NPM1 mutation (leukemia cutis).

ddx.vs: BPDCN is also CD4+/CD56+ and dermal with grenz zone, but it expresses CD123, TCL1 and TCF4 and lacks lysozyme/CD68 monocytic markers and cytoplasmic NPM1, which are the reverse of this case.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma or blastoid mantle cell lymphoma involving skin
ddx.vs: These can look identical on H&E but express CD20/PAX5 (and cyclin D1 in MCL) and are negative for lysozyme, CD33 and cytoplasmic NPM1.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous extranodal NK/T-cell or peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: T/NK lymphomas show CD3, cytotoxic markers or EBER positivity and often angiocentric necrosis, whereas this infiltrate lacks T-cell markers and shows myelomonocytic antigens.

ddx.dx: Merkel cell carcinoma or other small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Merkel cell carcinoma has salt-and-pepper chromatin, nuclear molding and CK20 dot-like and neuroendocrine marker positivity, and lacks CD45 and myeloid markers.

captions: Skin biopsy H&E: diffuse dermal infiltrate with grenz zone (A-B) and discohesive cells with folded nuclei between collagen (C-D)
IGV view of NGS reads: 4-bp TAGG insertion in NPM1 exon 12 (W288)
Immunostains (unlabeled panels A-D) showing diffuse positivity of the infiltrate
Immunostains (A-C) and NPM1 with aberrant cytoplasmic staining (D)

exam.answer_en: Myeloid sarcoma (leukemia cutis) — diffuse dermal infiltrate of discohesive blasts with grenz zone, aberrant cytoplasmic NPM1, NPM1 insertion
pearls_zh: 考法：皮膚切片看似淋巴瘤，考官問要加哪些染色；答案是 MPO、lysozyme、CD33、CD117、CD68/CD163，加上 CD3/CD20 陰性。
骨髓肉瘤本身即等同 AML 診斷，不論骨髓芽細胞多寡；應完整做骨髓檢查與基因分型，依 AML 治療。
NPM1 突變與皮膚/髓外侵犯及單核球分化相關；NPM1 IHC 顯示細胞質異位即可作為突變替代指標。
單核球分化的骨髓肉瘤 MPO 可陰性，需靠 lysozyme、CD68、CD163、CD14 等證明骨髓來源。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤診為 DLBCL 或 lymphoblastic lymphoma；以 CD3/CD20/TdT 陰性而 MPO、lysozyme、CD33 陽性區分，CD43 陽性本身不具特異性。

quiz.q: NPM1 免疫染色出現在細胞質代表什麼？此病變在臨床上等同什麼診斷？
quiz.a: NPM1 突變（異位到細胞質）；等同 AML，需依 AML 處理

75.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片見成片漿細胞：核偏位、深藍色細胞質、核旁淡染區（hof），部分有明顯核仁；周邊血可見紅血球錢串（rouleaux）；流式顯示 CD38+CD138+ 細胞 CD19 陰性、CD56 陽性，且輕鏈限制為 kappa。
features: Bone marrow aspirate with sheets of plasma cells of variable size, including large immature forms
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse to open chromatin; many cells show a distinct nucleolus
Abundant deep-blue cytoplasm with perinuclear hof and scattered fine vacuoles
Hypercellular trephine with diffuse sheets of plasmacytoid cells replacing normal hematopoiesis and fat
Peripheral blood with prominent rouleaux formation
Flow cytometry: CD38+/CD138+ population, CD19-negative, aberrant CD56-positive, cytoplasmic kappa-restricted (kappa 99.6%, lambda 0.09%)
75.describe_en: MRI of the thoracolumbar spine shows heterogeneous, multifocal vertebral marrow signal abnormality; the axial image shows abnormal soft tissue involving the vertebral body and spinal canal region. The peripheral blood smear shows prominent rouleaux formation. The bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with diffuse sheets of plasma cells replacing normal marrow elements, and the aspirate shows numerous atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, perinuclear hofs, and frequent prominent nucleoli, including large immature forms. Flow cytometry identifies a CD38+/CD138+ plasma cell population (24% of live events) that is CD19-negative, aberrantly CD56-positive, and cytoplasmic kappa light chain restricted. Findings are consistent with involvement by kappa-restricted plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, scattered rather than in sheets, polytypic, and retain CD19 without CD56 expression.

LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with a CD19+/CD20+ clonal B-cell component, usually IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, rather than pure sheets of CD19-negative plasma cells.

Plasmablastic lymphoma is a diffuse large-cell immunoblastic proliferation, often EBER-positive and extramedullary in immunocompromised patients, without the serum M-protein/CRAB profile and mature-plasma-cell spectrum seen here.

ddx.dx: Monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance / smoldering myeloma
ddx.vs: These have <10% (MGUS) or no myeloma-defining events, whereas this case shows marrow sheets, lytic/epidural disease and hypercalcemia.

captions: Sagittal MRI of the lumbar spine showing heterogeneous, multifocal vertebral marrow signal abnormality
Axial MRI of a thoracic vertebra showing abnormal marrow signal with soft tissue in the vertebral body and canal region
Sagittal fluid-sensitive MRI of the thoracic spine with heterogeneous vertebral marrow signal
Sagittal T1-weighted MRI of the thoracic spine with multiple focal vertebral body signal abnormalities
Marrow core biopsy, low power (H&E): hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheets of plasma cells
Marrow core biopsy, high power (H&E): sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and occasional nucleoli
Peripheral blood smear showing rouleaux formation
Marrow aspirate: numerous plasma cells with basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs among residual myeloid cells
Marrow aspirate, high power: atypical plasma cells with prominent nucleoli and cytoplasmic vacuoles
Marrow aspirate, high power: sheets of atypical plasma cells including large immature forms
Flow cytometry CD45 vs side scatter plot with lymphocyte gate (4.70%)
Flow cytometry CD138 vs CD38 plot gating CD38+/CD138+ plasma cells (24.23%)
Gated plasma cells are CD19-negative and CD56-positive (81.08%)
Gated plasma cells show cytoplasmic kappa light chain restriction (kappa 99.60%, lambda 0.09%)

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma involving marrow — sheets of immature plasma cells with perinuclear hof, rouleaux; CD38+/CD138+, CD19−, CD56+, kappa-restricted
pearls_zh: 考法：指著核偏位、核旁淡染區的漿細胞問名稱，並指血片紅血球疊錢狀（rouleaux）與 M 蛋白的關聯。
流式判讀：正常漿細胞 CD19+、CD56−、多株；腫瘤性漿細胞常 CD19−、CD56+、CD27/CD81 低表現，胞質單一輕鏈限制。
IMWG：克隆性漿細胞 ≥10% 或 plasmacytoma，加上 CRAB 或 SLiM（漿細胞 ≥60%、FLC 比 ≥100、MRI >1 處 ≥5 mm 病灶）。
FISH 高風險：t(4;14)、t(14;16)、t(14;20)、del(17p)、1q gain/amp；t(11;14) 與 venetoclax 反應相關。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與反應性漿細胞增多混淆；反應性者多株（kappa/lambda 混合）、CD19+ CD56−、成熟型態，常環繞血管分布。

quiz.q: 流式如何區分腫瘤性與正常漿細胞？列出兩個抗原表現差異。
quiz.a: 腫瘤性常 CD19 陰性、CD56 陽性（加輕鏈限制）；正常為 CD19+、CD56−

11.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片白血球與血小板極稀少，只見單顆淋巴球；骨髓切片幾乎全為脂肪、造血細胞近乎消失；流式在顆粒球上 CD55/CD59 與 FLAER 皆陰性（>98%），代表再生不良性貧血合併大型 PNH 克隆。
features: PB: marked leukopenia with only a rare small lymphocyte per field and no platelets seen
PB red cells largely normocytic and normochromic with mild anisopoikilocytosis; no blasts or dysplastic neutrophils
BM aspirate particle: fatty spicule composed almost entirely of adipocytes with scant hematopoietic cells
BM biopsy: profoundly hypocellular marrow (<5%) replaced by fat with residual stromal cells, lymphocytes and capillaries; no fibrosis or infiltrate
Flow: granulocytes (CD15 gate) lack GPI-linked CD55/CD59 and FLAER in 98.6% of cells versus 99.75% positive in normal control
11.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukopenia with only rare small lymphocytes and no platelets identified; red cells are predominantly normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes, blasts or dysplastic neutrophils. The bone marrow aspirate particles are fatty with scant hematopoietic elements, and the core biopsy is profoundly hypocellular, consisting almost entirely of adipose tissue with residual stromal cells and scattered lymphocytes, without fibrosis, granulomas or neoplastic infiltrate. Flow cytometry of peripheral blood granulocytes shows loss of CD55/CD59 and FLAER in 98.6% of cells, indicating a large PNH clone. Findings are consistent with severe aplastic anemia with an associated PNH clone.

ddx.vs: Hypoplastic MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes or granulocytes, possible increased blasts and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, whereas this marrow is an empty fatty marrow without dysplasia.
Classic PNH has a normo- to hypercellular marrow with erythroid hyperplasia and hemolysis (high reticulocytes, LDH), unlike the aplastic marrow and low reticulocyte count here.

ddx.dx: Inherited bone marrow failure (Fanconi anemia, telomere biology disorder)
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar; chromosome breakage testing, telomere length and germline sequencing separate them, and PNH clones are uncommon in inherited failure.

ddx.dx: Hypocellular acute leukemia or marrow infiltration
ddx.vs: Hypocellular AML/ALL shows clusters of blasts on biopsy (CD34/TdT), which are absent in this fat-replaced marrow.

captions: Peripheral blood, low power: striking leukopenia with a single lymphocyte and no visible platelets
Peripheral blood, high power: normocytic red cells and a small lymphocyte; platelets absent
Bone marrow aspirate particle: fatty spicule with scant hematopoietic cells
Bone marrow biopsy (H&E): profoundly hypocellular marrow replaced by fat
Flow cytometry: PNH granulocytes negative for CD55/CD59 and FLAER (98.6%) versus normal control

exam.answer_en: Severe aplastic anemia with large PNH clone — profoundly hypocellular fatty marrow and FLAER/CD55/CD59-negative granulocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：骨髓切片問細胞密度（近乎全脂肪、無浸潤或纖維化）；流式圖問哪個族群代表 PNH 克隆（FLAER 與 CD55/CD59 皆陰性）。
Severe AA（Camitta）：骨髓密度 <25%（或 25–50% 且殘存造血細胞 <30%），加上 ANC <0.5、PLT <20、網狀紅血球低三項中 ≥2 項；ANC <0.2 為 very severe。
高敏感 PNH 流式以顆粒球與單核球 FLAER 為主；紅血球 CD59 會因溶血與輸血低估克隆大小。
AA 中常可測到 PNH 克隆，被認為與免疫機轉相關；治療為 allo-HSCT 或 IST（ATG + cyclosporine ± eltrombopag），大克隆需監測溶血與血栓。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 hypocellular MDS 混淆；AA 無明顯發育不良、芽細胞與 CD34+ 細胞不增加、巨核細胞幾乎消失，細胞遺傳學通常正常。

quiz.q: 流式中 FLAER 與 CD55/CD59 皆陰性的顆粒球代表什麼？
quiz.a: GPI-anchor 蛋白缺失的 PNH 克隆（PIGA 突變）

64331.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下，正常造血組織被瀰漫、單調的小至中型淋巴樣細胞取代，細胞質稀少、核深染且輪廓不規則、呈角狀或拉長，間質帶粉紅色纖維；此形態可支持被套細胞淋巴瘤（mantle cell lymphoma）浸潤，但需 cyclin D1/SOX11 免疫染色確認。
features: Diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of small to intermediate lymphoid cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
Scant cytoplasm with high N:C ratio
Hyperchromatic nuclei with irregular, angulated to elongated (cleaved-appearing) contours
Inconspicuous nucleoli; no large centroblast-like or immunoblastic cells and no proliferation centers identified
Pink fibrillary stroma with some spindled/stretched nuclei suggesting crush artifact; no fat or normal trilineage elements in the field
64331.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows diffuse replacement of the marrow space by a monotonous infiltrate of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm. The nuclei are hyperchromatic with irregular, angulated and focally elongated contours, and nucleoli are inconspicuous; there are no proliferation centers or admixed large transformed cells in this field. The stroma is pink and fibrillary, with some spindled nuclei attributable to crush artifact, and residual normal hematopoiesis is not seen. Image quality (photographed through the eyepiece) limits assessment of chromatin detail and mitotic activity. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a small B-cell lymphoma such as mantle cell lymphoma, pending immunohistochemistry for CD5, cyclin D1 and SOX11.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL cells have round nuclei with clumped 'soccer-ball' chromatin, form paler proliferation centers with prolymphocytes, and are LEF1+/CD23+ but cyclin D1-negative.
Follicular lymphoma shows paratrabecular aggregates of cleaved centrocytes with admixed centroblasts and is CD10+/BCL6+/BCL2+ with t(14;18), not cyclin D1+.
Lymphoblasts have finely dispersed blastic chromatin with brisk mitoses and express TdT, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT-negative and cyclin D1-positive.
Marginal zone lymphoma cells have more abundant pale cytoplasm and a nodular or intrasinusoidal pattern, often with plasmacytic differentiation, and lack CD5 and cyclin D1.
